items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋйсѧ, Прⷭ҇то́ле ѻ҆́гненный, * ра́дꙋйсѧ, Свѣ́щниче всезлаты́й, * ра́дꙋйсѧ, свѣ́та Ѻ҆́блаче, * ра́дꙋйсѧ, Пала́то Сло́ва, * и҆ ѡ҆дꙋшевнаѧ Трапе́зо, Хлѣ́бъ жи́зни досто́йнѡ Хр҃та̀ носи́вшаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Judge not according to appearance, ye Jews! the Master cried teaching, when He came into the temple, as it is written, at Mid-Pentecost of the lawful feast.[^785]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь г҃. І҆рмо́съ: Оу҆тверди́сѧ се́рдце моѐ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Judge not according to appearance, ye Jews! for Christ is come, Whom the Prophets foretold, coming forth from Zion, and calling the world.[^786]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Не и҆́же на лицѐ сꙋ́дъ сꙋди́те І҆ꙋде́є: * оу҆ча̀ гла́ше Вл҃ка, * є҆гда̀ прїи́де во ст҃и́лище, ꙗ҆́коже пи́сано є҆́сть, * преполови́вшꙋсѧ зако́нномꙋ пра́здникꙋ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Even if ye believe not His words, ye Jews, believe the works of the Master; why are ye deceived, rejecting the Holy One, concerning Whom Moses wrote in the law?[^787]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Не и҆́же на лицѐ сꙋ́дъ сꙋди́те І҆ꙋде́є: * Хрⷭ҇то́съ бо прїи́де, є҆го́же нарица́хꙋ Пррѡ́цы, * ѿ Сїѡ́на грѧдꙋ́ща, и҆ мі́ръ взыва́юща.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Being One of the Trinity, Thou wast seen as flesh, without changing Thy essence, O Lord, nor burning the incorrupt womb of her that bore Thee, being wholly God and fire!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ, І҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: My heart was established in the Lord, Who gives prayer unto him that prays; for the bow of the mighty hath grown weak, and the feeble have girded themselves with strength.[^788]

provenance.verbatim_source: My heart was established in the Lord, Who gives prayer unto him that prays; for the bow of the mighty hath grown weak, and the feeble have girded themselves with strength.[^788]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆тверди́сѧ се́рдце моѐ въ Гдѣ́, * даю́щемъ моли́твꙋ молѧ́щемꙋсѧ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ лꙋ́къ си́льныхъ и҆знемо́же, * и҆ немощствꙋ́ющїи препоѧса́шасѧ си́лою.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Willingly wast Thou lifted up upon the Tree, O Word; and beholding it, the stones were rent, and all creation bowed down, and the dead arose from the tombs as if from sleep![^789]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Willingly wast Thou lifted up upon the Tree, O Word; and beholding it, the stones were rent, and all creation bowed down, and the dead arose from the tombs as if from sleep![^789]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Во́лею на дре́во возне́слсѧ є҆сѝ Сло́ве, * и҆ зрѧ́ще распада́хꙋсѧ ка́менїе, * и҆ тва́рь преклоня́шесѧ всѧ̀, * и҆ ме́ртвїи и҆з̾ гро́бѡвъ, ꙗ҆́коже ѿ сна̀ воста́хꙋ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beholding Thee having come into hades with Thy soul, O Word, all the souls of the righteous were loosed from their eternal bonds, singing of Thy power which is beyond understanding![^790]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Beholding Thee having come into hades with Thy soul, O Word, all the souls of the righteous were loosed from their eternal bonds, singing of Thy power which is beyond understanding![^790]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Съ дꙋше́ю тѧ̀ прише́дша во а҆́дъ Сло́ве, * ви́дѣвше всѧ̑ дꙋ́шы прпⷣбныхъ, * ѿ вѣ́чныхъ оу҆́зъ ѿрѣша́хꙋсѧ, * пѣсносло́вѧще ꙗ҆́же па́че оу҆ма̀ си́лꙋ твою̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Why are ye amazed? Why seek ye the Master in the tomb with myrrh, O women? He is risen, and hath raised up the world together with Himself! the flashing Angel cried unto the Myrrh-bearing women.[^791]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Что̀ оу҆диви́стесѧ; что̀ во гро́бѣ вы̀ и҆́щете съ мѵ́ромъ жены̀ Вл҃кꙋ; * воста̀, и҆ мі́ръ совоздви́же, * А҆́гг҃лъ блиста́ѧйсѧ Мѷроно́сицамъ вѣща́ше.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Being Life, O Lord, and the Fountain of immortality, Thou didst sit by the fountain, O Compassionate One, and with Thy all-wise waters didst fill the Samaritan woman who asked and sang unto Thee.[^792]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Тро́иченъ:
items.english_text: One God over all in the Trinity is hymned, the Father, and the Son, and the Divine Spirit, Whom the heavenly ranks glorify with fear, clearly crying out: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O Lord![^793]

provenance.verbatim_source: One God over all in the Trinity is hymned, the Father, and the Son, and the Divine Spirit, Whom the heavenly ranks glorify with fear, clearly crying out: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O Lord![^793]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: Having ineffably conceived in thy womb the God of all, O Virgin Mother, thou didst give birth beyond thought and word, remaining a Virgin even as before childbirth, O Bride of God!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having ineffably conceived in thy womb the God of all, O Virgin Mother, thou didst give birth beyond thought and word, remaining a Virgin even as before childbirth, O Bride of God!

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Несказа́ннѡ заче́нши во оу҆тро́бѣ твое́й всѣ́хъ Бг҃а, Дв҃о-Мт҃и, * па́че мы́сли и҆ сло́ва родила̀ є҆сѝ, * пребы́вши Дв҃а, ꙗ҆́кѡ пре́жде Ржⷭ҇тва̀, Бг҃оневѣ́сто.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn of the Samaritan Woman, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross" (Вознесы́йсѧ):* *Kontakion of Mid-Pentecost, and the Ikos: (see fol. 371).*[^794] Let heaven rejoice, let earthly things be glad, for Christ hath appeared from the Virgin as man, and hath delivered all humanity from corruption by His death; and shining forth with miracles unto the Samaritan woman who asked for water, He grants a fountain of healings, as the only Immortal One![^795]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion of Mid-Pentecost, and the Ikos: (see fol. 371).*[^794]  
*Sessional Hymn of the Samaritan Woman, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*  
Let heaven rejoice, let earthly things be glad, for Christ hath appeared from the Virgin as man, and hath delivered all humanity from corruption by His death; and shining forth with miracles unto the Samaritan woman who asked for water, He grants a fountain of healings, as the only Immortal One![^795]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ Самарѧ́ныни, Гла́съ д҃: Подо́бенъ: Вознесы́йсѧ:
items.english_text: O Bestower of wisdom and Master, Thou didst present Thyself at the lawful feast, and sitting in the temple, Thou didst teach, saying thus unto all: Come, ye that thirst, drink the water which I now give, whereby all men shall enjoy life from God and delight![^796]

provenance.verbatim_source: O Bestower of wisdom and Master, Thou didst present Thyself at the lawful feast, and sitting in the temple, Thou didst teach, saying thus unto all: Come, ye that thirst, drink the water which I now give, whereby all men shall enjoy life from God and delight![^796]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Да ра́дꙋетсѧ нб҃о, да ликовствꙋ́ютъ земна̑ѧ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ Хрⷭ҇то́съ ѿ Дв҃ы ꙗ҆ви́сѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃вѣ́къ, * и҆зба́ви и҆з̾ и҆стлѣ́нїѧ всѐ человѣ́чество свое́ю сме́ртїю: * чꙋдесы́ же возсїѧ́вый женѣ̀ Самарѧны́нѣ воды̀ просѧ́щей, * подае́тъ и҆сто́чникъ и҆сцѣле́нїй, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ безсме́ртенъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* The Prophet Habakkuk:[^797]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*  
The Prophet Habakkuk:[^797]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ д҃. Подо́бенъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* If the Messiah must come, and Christ is the Messiah, O lawless ones, why believe ye Him not? Behold, He is come, and the things that He does bear witness: He made water into wine; He strengthened the paralytic by His word![^798]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
If the Messiah must come, and Christ is the Messiah, O lawless ones, why believe ye Him not? Behold, He is come, and the things that He does bear witness: He made water into wine; He strengthened the paralytic by His word![^798]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Премꙋ́дрости пода́телю и҆ Вл҃ко, * пра́здникꙋ зако́нномꙋ предста́лъ є҆сѝ, * во ст҃и́лищи сѣ́дъ, оу҆чи́лъ є҆сѝ, гл҃ѧ си́це всѣ̑мъ: * грѧди́те жа́ждꙋщїи, пі́йте во́дꙋ, ю҆́же а҆́зъ ны́нѣ подаю̀, * є҆́юже жи́зни ѿ Бг҃а и҆ пи́щи наслади́теся всѝ человѣ́цы.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Not understanding the Scriptures, ye are all deceived, ye lawless Hebrews; for truly Christ is come and hath enlightened all, and among you hath shown forth many signs and wonders, yet ye deny yourselves true Life![^799]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Not understanding the Scriptures, ye are all deceived, ye lawless Hebrews; for truly Christ is come and hath enlightened all, and among you hath shown forth many signs and wonders, yet ye deny yourselves true Life![^799]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Въ Недѣ́лю ѡ҆ Самарѧны́ни
items.english_text: *Troparion:* One work have I shown you, and ye all already marvel, cried Christ unto the Jews: Ye circumcise a man even on the Sabbath, He said: why then do ye slander Me further, Who raised up the paralytic by a word?[^800]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
One work have I shown you, and ye all already marvel, cried Christ unto the Jews: Ye circumcise a man even on the Sabbath, He said: why then do ye slander Me further, Who raised up the paralytic by a word?[^800]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Є҆ди́но дѣ́ло показа́хъ ва́мъ, и҆ всѝ оу҆жѐ диви́теся, * взыва́ше і҆ꙋде́ѡмъ Хрⷭ҇то́съ: * вы̀ ѡ҆брѣ́зꙋете и҆ въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ человѣ́ка, речѐ: * менѐ же что̀ ѡ҆клевета́ете про́чее, воздви́гшаго сло́вомъ разсла́бленнаго;
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Many works have I done, and for which work do ye stone Me with stones? cried Christ rebuking the Jews: Is it because I made an entire man whole by a word? Judge not according to appearance, O men![^801]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Many works have I done, and for which work do ye stone Me with stones? cried Christ rebuking the Jews: Is it because I made an entire man whole by a word? Judge not according to appearance, O men![^801]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: I heard Thy report, O God, and was afraid; I considered Thy works and was terrified, O Lord; for the earth is full of Thy praise.[^802]

provenance.verbatim_source: I heard Thy report, O God, and was afraid; I considered Thy works and was terrified, O Lord; for the earth is full of Thy praise.[^802]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ Бж҃е слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ оу҆боѧ́хсѧ, * разꙋмѣ́хъ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, и҆ оу҆жасо́хсѧ Гд҃и: * ꙗ҆́кѡ твоегѡ̀ хвале́нїѧ и҆спо́лнь землѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Let the heavens be glad, let all creation keep festival: the Lord is risen, and hath appeared unto all His all-wise Apostles!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Let the heavens be glad, let all creation keep festival: the Lord is risen, and hath appeared unto all His all-wise Apostles!

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Нб҃са̀ да веселѧ́тсѧ, да пра́зднꙋетъ тва́рь всѧ̀: * воста̀ Гд҃ь, и҆ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ всѣ̑мъ премꙋ́дрымъ А҆пⷭ҇лѡмъ свои̑мъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy strength was swallowed up, O death, for Christ having died, the dead went forth from the tombs by His Arising, as if from bridal chambers![^803]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thy strength was swallowed up, O death, for Christ having died, the dead went forth from the tombs by His Arising, as if from bridal chambers![^803]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Поже́рта бы́сть, сме́рте, твоѧ̀ си́ла, * Хр҃тꙋ̀ бо оу҆ме́ршꙋ, ме́ртвїи, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ черто́гѡвъ, * Воста́нїемъ сегѡ̀, ѿ гро́бѡвъ и҆зыдо́ша.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Why weep ye, O women? Why seek ye the Immortal One with myrrh? He is risen, even as He said! the Angel spoke unto the Myrrh-bearing women.[^804]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Why weep ye, O women? Why seek ye the Immortal One with myrrh? He is risen, even as He said! the Angel spoke unto the Myrrh-bearing women.[^804]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Что̀ рыда́ете Ѽ жены̀; что̀ съ мѵ́ры и҆́щете Безсме́ртнагѡ; * воста̀, ꙗ҆́коже речѐ, * Мѷроно́сицамъ глаго́ла А҆́гг҃лъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto the Samaritan woman who asked, O Lord, Thou didst give water, the knowledge of Thy dominion; therefore unto the ages she shall not thirst, singing praise unto Thee![^805]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Unto the Samaritan woman who asked, O Lord, Thou didst give water, the knowledge of Thy dominion; therefore unto the ages she shall not thirst, singing praise unto Thee![^805]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, Тро́иченъ:
items.english_text: O transcendent Trinity, Father, Word, and Divine Spirit, of one power, co-unoriginate: save us all who hymn Thee with faith!

provenance.verbatim_source: O transcendent Trinity, Father, Word, and Divine Spirit, of one power, co-unoriginate: save us all who hymn Thee with faith!

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: The lawgiver of old beheld thee as the unburned bush, and Daniel contemplated the holy mountain, O only Virgin Mother, Sovereign Lady![^806]

provenance.verbatim_source: The lawgiver of old beheld thee as the unburned bush, and Daniel contemplated the holy mountain, O only Virgin Mother, Sovereign Lady![^806]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Неѡпали́мꙋю кꙋпинꙋ̀ тѧ̀ законоположи́тель зра́ше дре́вле, * Данїи́лъ же го́рꙋ ст҃ꙋ́ю смотра́ше, * є҆ди́на Мт҃и-Дв҃о, Вл҃чце.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Lord our God, peace:[^807]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*  
O Lord our God, peace:[^807]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь є҃. І҆рмо́съ: Гд҃и Бж҃е на́шъ, ми́ръ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With wonders hast Thou adorned Thine Apostles, marvelous hast Thou magnified Thy disciples, having glorified them in all the world, O our Savior, and having given unto them Thy Kingdom![^808]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
With wonders hast Thou adorned Thine Apostles, marvelous hast Thou magnified Thy disciples, having glorified them in all the world, O our Savior, and having given unto them Thy Kingdom![^808]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋдесы̀ оу҆краси́лъ є҆сѝ А҆пⷭ҇лы твоѧ̑, * ди́вны возвели́чилъ є҆сѝ оу҆чени́ки, * во все́мъ мі́рѣ просла́вивъ Сп҃се на́шъ, * и҆ да́въ и҆̀мъ Црⷭ҇твїе твоѐ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The disciples enlightened all the ends of the earth by wonders and teachings, and in various manners proclaimed the word of Thy Kingdom, O Christ Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The disciples enlightened all the ends of the earth by wonders and teachings, and in various manners proclaimed the word of Thy Kingdom, O Christ Savior!

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Всѧ̑ просвѣти́ша землѝ концы̑ оу҆чн҃цы чꙋдесы̀ и҆ оу҆че́ньми, * и҆ разли́чными ѻ҆́бразы сло́во проповѣ́давше, * Хр҃тѐ Сп҃се, Црⷭ҇твїѧ твоегѡ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Praise we send up unto Thy Kingdom, and hymnody we offer unto Thee, Who didst appear upon earth for our sake, and didst enlighten the world, and didst recall Adam!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Praise we send up unto Thy Kingdom, and hymnody we offer unto Thee, Who didst appear upon earth for our sake, and didst enlighten the world, and didst recall Adam!

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Хвалꙋ̀ возсыла́емъ Црⷭ҇твїю твоемꙋ̀, * пѣ́нїе же Тебѣ̀ прино́симъ, * на́съ ра́ди на землѝ ꙗ҆ви́вшемꙋсѧ, * и҆ мі́ръ просвѣти́вшемꙋ, и҆ А҆да́ма воззва́вшемꙋ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thy womb became a Holy Table, having the Heavenly Bread; of which whosoever eats dies not, even as the Nourisher of all hath said, O Mother of God![^809]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thy womb became a Holy Table, having the Heavenly Bread; of which whosoever eats dies not, even as the Nourisher of all hath said, O Mother of God![^809]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ, І҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: Make the light of Thy commandments shine upon me, O Lord, for unto Thee my spirit rises early and sings unto Thee; for Thou art our God, and unto Thee do I flee, O King of peace![^810]

provenance.verbatim_source: Make the light of Thy commandments shine upon me, O Lord, for unto Thee my spirit rises early and sings unto Thee; for Thou art our God, and unto Thee do I flee, O King of peace![^810]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Возсїѧ́й мѝ Гд҃и свѣ́тъ повелѣ́нїй твои́хъ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ къ тебѣ̀ дꙋ́хъ мо́й оу҆́тренюетъ, и҆ пое́тъ тѧ̀: * ты́ бо є҆сѝ Бг҃ъ на́шъ, * и҆ къ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ю Цр҃ю̀ ми́ра.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having reached Thy holy tomb very early in the morning, the Myrrh-bearing women beheld a young man flashing with light, and were terrified, having learned of Thy Divine Arising, O Christ![^811]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having reached Thy holy tomb very early in the morning, the Myrrh-bearing women beheld a young man flashing with light, and were terrified, having learned of Thy Divine Arising, O Christ![^811]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Гро́бъ тво́й ст҃ы́й дости́гше оу҆́транивша Мѷроно́сицы, * блиста́ющасѧ ви́дѣша ю҆́ношꙋ и҆ оу҆жасо́шасѧ, * твое́мꙋ навчи́вшесѧ Бж҃е́ственномꙋ Воста́нїю Хр҃тѐ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Death is put to death, hades is despoiled, those in bonds are set free by Christ's Resurrection; let us rejoice and clap our hands, celebrating radiantly![^812]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Death is put to death, hades is despoiled, those in bonds are set free by Christ's Resurrection; let us rejoice and clap our hands, celebrating radiantly![^812]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Сме́рть оу҆мертви́сѧ, а҆́дъ плѣни́сѧ, * сꙋ́щїи во оу҆́захъ свободи́шасѧ Хр҃то́вымъ Воскресе́нїемъ: * возра́дꙋимсѧ и҆ рꙋка́ми воспле́щимъ, пра́зднꙋюще свѣ́тлѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Leap for joy, ye Apostles, and dance, ye Angels; let all earthborn mortals rejoice: the Lord is risen, corruption is overthrown, and sorrow hath ceased, and Adam leaps for joy!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Leap for joy, ye Apostles, and dance, ye Angels; let all earthborn mortals rejoice: the Lord is risen, corruption is overthrown, and sorrow hath ceased, and Adam leaps for joy!

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: А҆пⷭ҇ли взыгра́йте, и҆ А҆́гг҃ли ликꙋ́йте, * земноро́днїи всѝ возра́дꙋйтеся: * Гд҃ь воскре́се, тлѧ̀ и҆спрове́ржесѧ, * и҆ печа́ль преста̀, и҆ ликовствꙋ́етъ А҆да́мъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Being the Fountain of life, O Lord, Thou didst grant the water of remission and understanding unto the woman who asked of old, the Samaritan woman; therefore we sing of Thine ineffable compassions![^813]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*

items.slavonic_text: Всѧ̑ содержа́й концы̑, возше́лъ є҆сѝ І҆и҃се, * и҆ оу҆чи́лъ є҆сѝ во ст҃и́лищи наро́ды сло́вꙋ и҆́стины, * пра́здникꙋ преполови́вшꙋсѧ, ꙗ҆́коже І҆ѡа́ннъ вопїе́тъ.

items.slavonic_text: Дв҃ꙋ по Ржⷭ҇твѣ̀ пое́мъ тѧ̀, Дв҃ꙋ и҆ Мт҃рь сла́вимъ, * тебѐ є҆ди́нꙋ, Чⷭ҇таѧ Бг҃оневѣ́сто Ѻ҆трокови́це: * и҆з̾ тебе́ бо вои́стиннꙋ Бг҃ъ воплоти́сѧ, ѡ҆бнови́въ на́съ.
items.english_text: Let not the waterflood drown me, neither let the deep swallow me up; for I am cast into the depths of the heart of the sea of my evils; therefore I cry as Jonah: Let my life arise from corruption unto Thee, O God![^819]

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Стїхѝ: Во́дꙋ прїѧ́ти прише́дши тлѣ́ннꙋю, же́но: Живꙋ́ю почерпа́еши, є҆́юже скве́рны дꙋше́вныѧ ѡ҆мыва́еши.
items.english_text: On this same day, the Fifth Sunday after Pascha, we celebrate the feast of the Samaritan Woman; because unto her Christ plainly confessed Himself to be the Messiah, which is Christ: [or the Anointed.][^828] For with the Hebrews the measure is oil; therefore, I think, it was appointed also for the week of Mid-Pentecost. And even as in the Sunday prior to this He worked a miracle at the pool,[^829] so in this present one, Christ conversed with the woman over Jacob’s well, which well Jacob himself dug and gave to Joseph his son;[^830] for this was an excellent place, where also near the existing Mount Somor, the Samaritans inhabited many cities. And Christ comes into Sychar, where Jacob had dwelt of old with his sons and with Dinah his daughter. Shechem, son of Hamor the Horrite, lusted after her, and having violated her, was with her; and from that cause her brothers, being provoked to great jealousy, suddenly entered into the city and killed them all together, both that Shechem and Hamor his father.[^831] Jacob therefore dwelt there, and dug the present well. Yet the Samaritans did not dwell near that mountain previously, but the Israelites, having provoked that anger, in the reign of Pekah, during the first and second captivities, when the Assyrians came, were subjected to tribute by them; and afterward, in the reign of Hoshea, they attached themselves to the Ethiopians; which when the Assyrian king learned, he deported them to Babylon. And he commanded various nations to dwell in that place; but God let loose lions upon those foreigners. And the Assyrian king, having learned this in turn, sent unto them priests from among the Jews, (for they were still captives there,) that they might also receive the laws of God. And from the idols indeed they quickly broke away. But only...[^832] the five books of Moses did they accept, rejecting the Prophets and the rest of the Scripture.[^833] These were also called Samaritans, as being from Mount Somor; and they were hated by the Hebrews returning from captivity, because they Judaized only in part and would not eat with them, abominating them unyieldingly; therefore also they often called Christ a Samaritan, as one who despised and broke certain things of the Law even as they did.[^834]

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Па́теры кни́ги Мѡѷсе́ѡвы пріѧ́ша, ѿмета́ющесѧ Проро́къ, и҆ про́чагѡ Писа́нїѧ. Сїи и҆ Самаря́не зово́ми бѧ́хꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ горы̀ Сомѡ́ры, и҆ ненавиди́ми бѧ́хꙋ Є҆вре́ями, ѿ плѣне́нїѧ возвраща́ющимисѧ, занѐ и҆сполꙋ̀ і҆ꙋде́йствовахꙋ, и҆ не ꙗ҆да́хꙋ съ ни́ми, ме́рзостны ѧ҆ непребо́рнѡ, тѣ́мже и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ Самаранѧни́на мно́гажды нарица́хꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ нѣ́каѧ ѿ зако́нныхъ оу҆́бѡ презира́юща и҆ разрꙋша́юща ꙗ҆́коже сїѝ. Прихо́дитъ оу҆́бѡ въ Сѷха́рь Гдⷭ҇ь, а҆ оу҆трꙋди́всѧ ѿ пꙋтеше́ствїѧ, сѣ́де ѡ҆ часѣ̀ шесто́мъ днѐ. Жена́ же нѣ́каѧ ѿ гра́да прїи́де почерпстѝ воды̀, оу҆чени́кѡмъ ше́дшымъ на кꙋ́плю пи́щи: про́ситъ оу҆́бѡ воды̀ І҆и҃съ. Ѻ҆на́ же не прикаса́тися предлага́етъ, позна́вши бо є҆го̀ и҆ ѿ гла́са, и҆ ѿ ѡ҆де́жды. Ѻ҆́нъ же возво́дитъ ю҆̀, дꙋхо́внꙋю во́дꙋ приносѧ̀ на сре́дꙋ, ю҆́же неѡскꙋднꙋю и҆ чисти́тельнꙋю показꙋетъ: Дх҃ъ бо водѣ̀ и҆ ѻ҆гню̀ при́снѡ оу҆подоблѧ́етсѧ. Жена́ же неѡ̀стꙋ́пнѡ прилѣжа́щи, не и҆мѣ́ти ѻ҆но́мꙋ во́дꙋ тако́вꙋю, за є҆́же почерпа́ла не носи́ти, и҆ стꙋденцꙋ бы́ти І҆а́кѡвꙋ прилаго́летъ, та́же и҆ на пра́ѻтца І҆а́кѡва возно́ситъ сло́во, ꙗ҆́кѡ са́мъ стꙋде́нецъ и҆скопа̀: и҆ си́хъ, и҆ ѻ҆́вцы є҆гѡ̀ ѿ негѡ̀ пїѧ́хꙋ, бога́тое ѡ҆би́лїе и҆сто́чниковъ пред̾ставлѧ́ющи, и҆ є҆́же и҆́накѡ бл҃гопотре́бнꙋю и҆ стꙋде́нь. Хрⷭ҇то́съ оу҆́бѡ не бо́льша себѐ да́етъ І҆а́кѡва, да не женꙋ̀ оу҆страши́тъ, но ѡ҆ водѣ̀ глаго́летъ, представлѧ́ѧ ѻ҆́бїлїе тоѧ̀ пред̾ѻ́бразное: пїѧ́й бо воды̀ ѻ҆́ноѧ ника́коже вжа́ждетъ. Про́ситъ же воды̀ жена̀. Ѻ҆́нъ же гла́голетъ, своего̀ е́й мꙋ́жа пригласи́ти, ꙗ҆́кѡ тверди́йшихъ слове́съ тре́бꙋющи разꙋмѣ́нїѧ. Ѻ҆на́ же ѿри́четсѧ не и҆мѣ́ти мꙋ́жа. Вѣ́дый же всѧ̑, гла́голетъ: до́брѣ рекла̀ є҆сѝ, пѧ́ть бо и҆мѣ́ла є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆́коже зако́нъ повелѣва́етъ, а҆ є҆го́же ны́нѣ и҆́маши шеста́го, ꙗ҆́кѡ беззако́ннѡ ѻ҆́номꙋ сожи́тельствꙋющаѧ, нѣ́сть тѝ мꙋ́жъ. [Нѣ́цыи оу҆́бѡ пѧ́ть мꙋже́й, пѧ́ть кни́гъ Мѡѷсе́овыхъ непщева́ша бы́ти, ꙗ҆́же Самаря́не прїе́млѧхꙋ: шеста́го же та̀ словеса̀ Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ва, ꙗ҆́же не бы́ша ещѐ ѻ҆́ныѧ: оу҆́бо не оу҆̀ бл҃года́ть и҆злїѧ́на бѣ̀. Дрꙋзи́и же, да̑ныѧ пѧ́ть зако́ны ѿ Бг҃а: и҆́же въ раѝ, и҆ по и҆згна́нїи: и҆́же при Нѡ́и: и҆́же при Ѧ҆враа́мѣ: и҆́же при Мѡѷсе́и, шесты́й же Е҆ѵⷢ҇лїе, є҆́же и҆ ещѐ не и҆мѧ́ше. Сꙋ́ть же и҆́же и҆ пѧ́ть чꙋ́вствїй глаго́лютъ.] Ѿвѣщава́етъ є҆мꙋ̀ жена̀, Проро́ка є҆го̀ и҆менꙋ́ющи. Та́же вопроша́етъ є҆го̀ и҆ ѡ҆ горѣ̀, гдѣ̀ подоба́етъ кла́нѧтисѧ, въ Сомѡ́рѣ ли, и҆лѝ во І҆ерꙋсали́мѣ; Не мнѧ́хꙋ бо Самаря́не, ꙗ҆́кѡ соверше́ннѡ вездѣ̀ Бг҃ꙋ бы́ти, но та́мѡ пребыва́ти то́чїю Бг҃ꙋ, и҆дѣ́же и҆ покланѧ́хꙋсѧ, въ Гаризи́нѣ ꙗ҆́кѡ горѣ̀, за є҆́же та́мѡ да́тисѧ бл҃гослове́нїю ѿ Бг҃а. И҆лѝ занѐ та́мѡ пе́рвый І҆и҃ль жертво́вникъ создꙋзѝ Бг҃ꙋ, ꙗ҆́коже І҆ꙋде́и па́ки глаго́лахꙋ: во І҆ерꙋсали́мѣ подоба́етъ покланѧ́тисѧ є҆ди́номꙋ Бг҃ꙋ: тѣ́мже и҆́же и҆ ѿвсю́дꙋ къ пра́здникꙋ та́мѡ собира́хꙋсѧ. Хрⷭ҇то́съ же ѿвѣщава́етъ: Ѽ І҆ꙋде́й, гла́голетъ, спасе́нїе мї́рови: ѻ҆ба́че речѐ, Бг҃ъ невеще́ственный є҆́сть, и҆ покланѧ́тисѧ сподо́блшимсѧ, не въ же́ртвахъ оу҆́же покланѧ́тисѧ, но въ дꙋсѣ̀ и҆ и҆́стинѣ. И҆лѝ и҆ си́це Бг҃а позна́ютъ, не є҆ди́наго, но въ Дꙋсѣ̀ ст҃о́мъ и҆ Сн҃ѣ, то́й бо И҆́стина. Жена́ па́ки глаго́летъ: слы́шимъ ѿ Писа́нїй, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мессї́а грѧде́тъ, є҆́же є҆́сть Хрⷭ҇то́съ. І҆и҃съ же гла́голетъ: А҆́зъ є҆́смь: бл҃гообра́зїе жены̀ разꙋмѣ́въ. Вѣ́даша же Самаря́не и҆ ѡ҆ Мессї́и ѿ Мѡѷсе́йскихъ кни́гъ, и҆зрѧ́днѣе же ѿ сегѡ̀: Є҆́же Проро́ка ва́мъ возста́витъ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ, и҆ ѿ и҆ны́хъ мно́гихъ. Скончава́ющейсѧ же бесѣ́дѣ, и҆ оу҆чн҃цы̀ прихо́дѧтъ, и҆ кра́йнемꙋ оу҆дивла́ютсѧ схожде́нїю, ка́кѡ съ жено́ю гла́голаше. Ѻ҆ба́че же молѧ́хꙋ є҆го̀ ꙗ҆́сти, бы́вшꙋ оу҆́бѡ за є҆́же потрꙋди́тисѧ, и҆ за вре́менъ зно́йное. Ѻ҆́нъ же ѡ҆ вѣ́чной пи́щи тѣ̑мъ гла́голетъ, человѣ́ческагѡ ꙗ҆́кѡ спасенїѧ, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ подоба́етъ и҆̀мъ Проро́чєскїѧ труды̀ пожа́ти. Но женѣ̀ ко гра́дꙋ дости́гшей, и҆ ꙗ҆́же ѡ҆ себѣ̀ сказа́вшей, всѝ воздви́гшесѧ, и҆ ко Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ прихо́дѧтъ вѣ́ровавше: ꙗ҆́кѡ не бы̀ жена̀ себѐ посрами́ла, а҆́ще не бы̀ велико̀ что̀ разꙋмѣ́ла. И҆ моли́въ оу҆моли́ша, томо̀ пребы́ти оу҆ ни́хъ, ко днѝ дво́ю оу҆моли́ваютъ є҆го̀. И҆ пребы́въ, мнѡ́жайша содѣ́ѧ чꙋдеса̀, ꙗ҆́же оу҆́бѡ ѿ мно́жества во Е҆ѵⷢ҇лїи не писа́шасѧ. Сїѧ́ же є҆́сть Самаранѧ́нына, послѣ́дѝ ѿ Хрⷭ҇та̀ Фѡтині́а и҆менова́ннаѧ, ꙗ҆́же и҆ мч҃че́нїѧ вѣнце́мъ оу҆вѧзе́сѧ при Не́рѡнѣ ке́сарѣ, и҆ со седми́ю свои́ми сыны̀, по мно́зѣ ѡ҆бволоче́нїи и҆ строга́нїи, и҆ сосцꙋ̀ ѿрѣ́занїи, сокрꙋше́нїи рꙋ́къ, и҆ тросте́й то́нкихъ под̾ но́гти влага́нїи, и҆ ѻ҆́лова напое́нїи, и҆ и҆ны́хъ безчи́сленныхъ мꙋ́къ и҆стѧза́нїи, на коне́цъ въ дво́ю фа́нꙋ привѧза́нїи и҆ расторгнꙋ́ти. Вѣ́домо же бꙋ́ди, ꙗ҆́кѡ стꙋденца̀ ѻ҆́нагѡ гора́ндице, си́рѣчь оу҆́стїе, ца́рь І҆ꙋстїнїа́нъ че́стнѣ ѿтꙋ́дꙋ принесѐ, къ Бж҃їѧ Сло́ва вели́комъ хра́мѣ ст҃ы́ѧ Софі́и положѝ: но и҆ ка́мень, на не́мже Хрⷭ҇то́съ сѣдѧ̀ Самаранѧнини бесѣ́доваше, и҆ досе́лѣ ѻ҆́болъ пребыва́ютъ пред̾ па́пертомъ ѿ восто́ка, къ хра́мꙋ входѧ́щымъ на лѣ́вой странѣ̀, всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ и҆сцѣлѧ́юща, па́че же ѿ ѻ҆гне́нныхъ страда́ти приключа́ющымсѧ, и҆ трѧса́вицею вла́ємымъ, ѡ҆чища́ютъ же и҆ ѿго́нѧтъ и҆ чарова́нїа быва́ємаѧ. Твоеѧ̀ мч҃ченицы Фѡти́нїи м҃лтвами, Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е поми́лꙋй на́съ, а҆ми́нь.
items.english_text: The Lord therefore comes into Sychar, and being weary from the journey, He sat down about the sixth hour of the day. And a certain woman from the city came to draw water, the disciples having gone away to buy food; Jesus therefore asks water. But she proposes not to touch Him, having recognized Him both from His speech and from His apparel. But He leads her upward, bringing spiritual water into the midst, which He shows to be inexhaustible and cleansing; for the Spirit is ever likened unto water and fire. But the woman, persisting importunately, that He had no such water, so as not to carry a vessel for drawing, and that the well belonged to Jacob, she replies; furthermore she also raises word concerning the forefather Jacob, that he himself dug the well, and he and his sheep drank of it, setting forth the rich abundance of the springs, and that the well was otherwise well-suited.[^835]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь з҃. І҆рмо́съ: Халде́йскаѧ пе́щь:
items.english_text: Christ therefore does not make Himself greater than Jacob, lest He terrify the woman, but speaks concerning the water, setting forth the abundance thereof prefiguratively: for he who drinks of that water shall by no means thirst.[^836] And the woman asks for the water. But He tells her to summon her husband, as she was in need of understanding more solid words. But she denies that she has a husband. And He Who knows all things says: Thou hast well said, for five husbands hast thou had, as the Law commands, and he whom thou now hast as the sixth, because thou cohabitest with him unlawfully, is not thy husband.[^837]

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Самарѧны́ни, Гдⷭ҇и, женѣ̀ бесѣ́довалъ є҆сѝ, * ѡ҆блича́ѧ безꙋ́мїе беззако́нныхъ є҆вре́ѡвъ: * Ѻ҆на́ оу҆́бѡ вѣ́рова, Сн҃а тѧ̀ бы́ти Бж҃їа, * сі́и же ѿверго́шасѧ.
items.english_text: The woman answers Him, calling Him a Prophet. Then she also questions Him concerning the mountain, where it is proper to worship: in Somor or in Jerusalem? For the Samaritans did not deem that God is completely everywhere, but that God abides only there where they also worshiped, on Mount Gerizim, because the blessing was given there from God; or because there Israel first built an altar unto God; even as the Jews said in turn: In Jerusalem it is proper to worship the one God; therefore also those from all quarters gathered there for the feast.[^839]

items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Хлѣ́бъ ꙗ҆ды́й Пло́ти Гдⷭ҇ни, * и҆ Кро́вь прїе́млюще Ребра̀ рꙋчна̀, * ѡ҆бновле́нїемъ Дх҃а да жи́телствꙋимъ, * живꙋ́ще бл҃года́тїю.
items.english_text: And Christ answers: Salvation for the world, He says, is of the Jews; yet He said: God is immaterial, and those deemed worthy to worship Him are no longer to worship in sacrifices, but in spirit and in truth; or they shall know God thus: not as solitary, but in the Holy Spirit and the Son, for He is the Truth.[^840]

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Во чре́вѣ твое́мъ вмѣсти́ла є҆сѝ невмѣсти́мое Сло́во, * ѿ твои́хъ сосцє́въ дои́ла є҆сѝ мї́рови Пита́телѧ, * на ѡ҆б̾ѧ́тїи носи́ла є҆сѝ Творца̀ на́шего, * Бг҃ороди́тельнице чⷭ҇таѧ.
items.english_text: The woman says again: We hear from the Scriptures that Messiah comes, Who is called Christ. And Jesus says: I am He; having understood the noble disposition of the woman.[^841]

provenance.verbatim_source: The woman says again: We hear from the Scriptures that Messiah comes, Who is called Christ. And Jesus says: I am He; having understood the noble disposition of the woman.[^841]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: And the Samaritans knew also concerning the Messiah from the books of Moses, and especially from this: A Prophet shall the Lord God raise up unto you; and from many other passages.[^842]

provenance.verbatim_source: And the Samaritans knew also concerning the Messiah from the books of Moses, and especially from this: A Prophet shall the Lord God raise up unto you; and from many other passages.[^842]

items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: And as the conversation was ending, the disciples also come, and they marvel exceedingly at His condescension, how He was speaking with a woman. Nevertheless they entreat Him to eat, both because He had toiled and because of the heat of the season. But He speaks unto them of eternal food, that is the salvation of mankind, and that they ought to reap the labors of the Prophets.[^843]

items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: And when the woman reached the city and related what had befallen her, all were stirred up and came unto Christ, having believed; for the woman would not have put herself to shame unless she had understood something great. And having entreatingly besought Him to abide with them, they persuade Him to stay for two days. And having tarried, He wrought very many miracles, which indeed by reason of their multitude were not written in the Gospel.[^844]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: And this is that Samaritan woman, who was afterward named Photina by Christ, who also was crowned with the wreath of martyrdom under Nero Caesar, together with her seven sons, after much dragging about, scraping, cutting off of breasts, crushing of hands, inserting of sharp reeds under fingernails, pouring of molten lead, and countless other torments, and at the end was tied to two trees and torn asunder.[^845]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: Be it known also that the well-curb of that well, that is, its mouth, Emperor Justinian honorably brought thence, and placed it in the Great Church of the Word of God, Hagia Sophia; and the stone also whereon Christ sat as He conversed with the Samaritan woman; and both abide unto this day before the narthex from the east, on the left side to those entering the temple, healing every disease, and especially those who happen to suffer from burning fevers and are tossed with the ague, and they cleanse and drive away enchantments that are wrought.[^846]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* In thy womb thou didst contain the uncontainable Word, from thy breasts thou didst suckle the Nourisher of the world, in thine embrace thou didst bear our Creator, O pure Mother of God!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Со беззако́нными, Хрⷭ҇тѐ ще́дре, во́лею вмѣни́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * во вре́мѧ Бж҃ественныѧ Стрⷭ҇ти: * и҆ сїѧ̑ ви́дѧщи, колеба́шесѧ землѧ̀, * и҆ ка́менїе вседѣ́тельнымъ манове́нїемъ распада́шесѧ, Непостижи́ме, * и҆ воста́ша ме́ртвїи и҆́же ѿ вѣ́ка.
items.english_text: Forsake us not utterly for Thy name's sake, neither disannul Thou Thy covenant, and cause not Thy mercy to depart from us, O Lord, the God of our fathers, praised and exalted above all unto the ages![^850]

provenance.verbatim_source: Forsake us not utterly for Thy name's sake, neither disannul Thou Thy covenant, and cause not Thy mercy to depart from us, O Lord, the God of our fathers, praised and exalted above all unto the ages![^850]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Съ дꙋше́ю соше́дъ во страны̑ преиспо́днїѧ а҆́да, * возве́лъ є҆сѝ мꙋ́жествомъ, свѧ́занныѧ всѧ̑, * ꙗ҆́же ѿ вѣ́ка сме́рть прїѧ́тъ, го́рькїй мꙋчи́тель, * вопїю́щыѧ тебѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е: * сла́ва твоемꙋ̀ стра́шномꙋ смотре́нїю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With the lawless, O compassionate Christ, of Thine own will wast Thou numbered at the time of Thy divine Passion; and beholding these things, the earth was shaken, and the rocks were rent by Thine all-working nod, O Incomprehensible One, and the dead from the ages arose![^851]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
With the lawless, O compassionate Christ, of Thine own will wast Thou numbered at the time of Thy divine Passion; and beholding these things, the earth was shaken, and the rocks were rent by Thine all-working nod, O Incomprehensible One, and the dead from the ages arose![^851]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Съ ме́ртвыми что̀ вы̀ и҆́щете Живꙋ́щагѡ во вѣ́ки; * воста̀ ꙗ҆́коже речѐ: * сѐ ꙗ҆́коже ви́дите пра́здны плащани́цы, и҆стоще́нъ гро́бъ, * ꙗ҆вле́йсѧ глаго́лаше Мѷроно́сицамъ ю҆́ноша: * ско́рѡ ше́дше рцы́те А҆пⷭ҇толѡмъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having descended with Thy soul into the nethermost parts of hades, with courage hast Thou led up all the bound whom death, that bitter tormentor, had seized from the ages, who cry unto Thee, O Christ God: Glory to Thy dread dispensation![^852]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
Having descended with Thy soul into the nethermost parts of hades, with courage hast Thou led up all the bound whom death, that bitter tormentor, had seized from the ages, who cry unto Thee, O Christ God: Glory to Thy dread dispensation![^852]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Вода̀ є҆сѝ жи́зни, вопїѧ́ше Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ Самарѧны́на: * напо́й мѧ̀ оу҆́бѡ Сло́ве жа́ждꙋщꙋ всегда̀ твоеѧ̀ Бж҃ественныѧ бл҃года́ти, * ꙗ҆́кѡ да не ктомꙋ̀, І҆и҃се Гдⷭ҇и, невѣ́дѣнїа содержи́тсѧ зно́емъ, * но проповѣ́дꙋю твоѧ̑ вели́чїѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Why seek ye the Living among the dead unto the ages? He is risen, even as He said: behold, as ye see, the winding sheets are empty, the tomb is emptied! cried the radiant young man who appeared unto the Myrrh-bearing women: go quickly, tell the Apostles![^853]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
Why seek ye the Living among the dead unto the ages? He is risen, even as He said: behold, as ye see, the winding sheets are empty, the tomb is emptied! cried the radiant young man who appeared unto the Myrrh-bearing women: go quickly, tell the Apostles![^853]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, Трⷪ҇ченъ: Ѻ҆ц҃а̀, и҆ Сн҃а, и҆ Бж҃ественнаго воспѣва́емъ Дх҃а, * нераздѣ́льнꙋю Трⷪ҇цꙋ є҆стество́мъ сꙋ́щꙋю, * раздѣле́нꙋю ли́цы, * є҆ди́но Сꙋщество̀, сра́сленное, безнача́льное, * Творца̀ всѣ́хъ и҆ Бг҃а: * є҆го́же всѝ нбⷭ҇нїи пою́тъ чи́нове.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou art the Water of life, cried the Samaritan woman unto Christ: give me to drink therefore, O Word, who ever thirst for Thy divine grace, that I no longer, O Lord Jesus, be held by the scorching heat of ignorance, but proclaim Thy majesty![^854]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
Thou art the Water of life, cried the Samaritan woman unto Christ: give me to drink therefore, O Word, who ever thirst for Thy divine grace, that I no longer, O Lord Jesus, be held by the scorching heat of ignorance, but proclaim Thy majesty![^854]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь и҃. І҆рмо́съ: А҆́гг҃ли и҆ нб҃са̀ на Прⷭ҇то́лѣ:
items.english_text: We hymn the Father, and the Son, and the divine Spirit: the Trinity indivisible in essence, divided in Persons, one Substance, co-natural, unoriginate, Creator of all and God, Whom all the heavenly ranks do hymn!

provenance.verbatim_source: We hymn the Father, and the Son, and the divine Spirit: the Trinity indivisible in essence, divided in Persons, one Substance, co-natural, unoriginate, Creator of all and God, Whom all the heavenly ranks do hymn!

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ є҆сѝ вои́стиннꙋ Хрⷭ҇то́съ, * въ мі́ръ се́й прише́дый, * и҆з̾ негѡ́же спасе́нїе, и҆ ѡ҆ставле́нїе ѻ҆те́ческихъ согрѣше́нїй, * ты̀ є҆сѝ вои́стиннꙋ Живо́тъ къ тѧ̀ вѣ́ровавшымъ.
items.english_text: After thy dread childbirth, O pure Virgin, thou hast remained preserved, O holy Mother of God; therefore all the angelic choirs and all the generations of mankind hymn thee with unceasing voices, O pure dwelling-place of the Incomprehensible One!

provenance.verbatim_source: After thy dread childbirth, O pure Virgin, thou hast remained preserved, O holy Mother of God; therefore all the angelic choirs and all the generations of mankind hymn thee with unceasing voices, O pure dwelling-place of the Incomprehensible One!

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Премꙋ́дрость Бж҃їѧ, преполови́вшꙋсѧ пра́здникꙋ, * ꙗ҆́коже пи́сано є҆́сть, ко Ст҃и́лищи предста̀ и҆ оу҆ча́ше: * ꙗ҆́кѡ вои́стиннꙋ се́й на́ше Мессї́а Хрⷭ҇то́съ, и҆́мже спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Angels and the heavens upon the Throne...[^855]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*  
Angels and the heavens upon the Throne...[^855]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ка́кѡ родила̀ є҆сѝ, рцы̀, * ѿ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ беза́ктивнѡ Просїѧ́вшаго, * и҆ со ст҃ы́мъ Дх҃омъ воспѣва́емаго; * и҆лѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всѣ́хъ Є҆ди́нъ, бл҃говоли́вый и҆з̾ тебѐ роди́тисѧ Бцⷣе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Come, behold, ye people, Him Who is hymned upon the Throne of glory, blasphemed by the lawless people; and beholding, sing ye unto the Messiah foretold in the Prophets![^856]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
Come, behold, ye people, Him Who is hymned upon the Throne of glory, blasphemed by the lawless people; and beholding, sing ye unto the Messiah foretold in the Prophets![^856]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ: Ве́лическаѧ Рꙋко́ю премꙋ́дростїю соста́вилъ є҆сѝ, * земли́ же па́ки оу҆тверди́лъ є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆́коже вѣ́си, дно̀, * ѡ҆снова́нїемъ воздрꙋзи́вый на вода́хъ безмѣ́рныхъ, * тѣ́мъ всѝ вопїе́мъ, воспѣва́юще: * бл҃гослови́те дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇нѧ непреста́ннѡ Гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Truly Thou art Christ Who didst come into this world, from Whom is salvation and the remission of our ancestral transgressions; truly Thou art Life unto those who believe in Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
Truly Thou art Christ Who didst come into this world, from Whom is salvation and the remission of our ancestral transgressions; truly Thou art Life unto those who believe in Thee!

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Сме́рть претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, Є҆ди́не Безсме́ртне, во́лею, * а҆́да плѣни́лъ дѣ́ла Гдⷭ҇ни, врага̀ мѣ́днаѧ сте́рлъ є҆сѝ, Цр҃ю̀ нбⷭ҇ный, * и҆ и҆́з̾ѧлъ є҆сѝ оу҆́зники ѿ вѣ́ка та́мѡ сꙋ́щыѧ, * воспѣва́ющыѧ держа́вꙋ непреста́ннѡ твоеѧ̀ бл҃гости.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When the feast was at Mid-point, as it is written, the Wisdom of God stood in the Sanctuary and taught: Truly this is our Messiah, Christ, by Whom is salvation![^857]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
When the feast was at Mid-point, as it is written, the Wisdom of God stood in the Sanctuary and taught: Truly this is our Messiah, Christ, by Whom is salvation![^857]

items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Сме́рть претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, Є҆ди́не Безсме́ртне, во́лею, * а҆́да плѣни́лъ дѣ́ла Гдⷭ҇ни, врага̀ мѣ́днаѧ сте́рлъ є҆сѝ, Цр҃ю̀ нбⷭ҇ный, * и҆ и҆́з̾ѧлъ є҆сѝ оу҆́зники ѿ вѣ́ка та́мѡ сꙋ́щыѧ, * воспѣва́ющыѧ держа́вꙋ непреста́ннѡ твоеѧ̀ бл҃гости.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* How gavest thou birth, speak, unto Him Who shone forth timelessly from the Father, and is hymned with the Holy Spirit? Even as He Who is One of all, Who was well-pleased to be born of thee, O Mother of God!

provenance.verbatim_source:

How gavest thou birth, speak, unto Him Who shone forth timelessly from the Father, and is hymned with the Holy Spirit? Even as He Who is One of all, Who was well-pleased to be born of thee, O Mother of God!

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Сме́рть претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, Є҆ди́не Безсме́ртне, во́лею, * а҆́да плѣни́лъ дѣ́ла Гдⷭ҇ни, врага̀ мѣ́днаѧ сте́рлъ є҆сѝ, Цр҃ю̀ нбⷭ҇ный, * и҆ и҆́з̾ѧлъ є҆сѝ оу҆́зники ѿ вѣ́ка та́мѡ сꙋ́щыѧ, * воспѣва́ющыѧ держа́вꙋ непреста́ннѡ твоеѧ̀ бл҃гости.
items.english_text: With Thy majestic hand hast Thou framed all things in wisdom, and again hast Thou established the base of the earth as Thou knowest, setting the foundation upon the boundless waters; therefore we all cry aloud, chanting: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, unceasingly![^858]

provenance.verbatim_source: With Thy majestic hand hast Thou framed all things in wisdom, and again hast Thou established the base of the earth as Thou knowest, setting the foundation upon the boundless waters; therefore we all cry aloud, chanting: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, unceasingly![^858]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Сме́рть претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, Є҆ди́не Безсме́ртне, во́лею, * а҆́да плѣни́лъ дѣ́ла Гдⷭ҇ни, врага̀ мѣ́днаѧ сте́рлъ є҆сѝ, Цр҃ю̀ нбⷭ҇ный, * и҆ и҆́з̾ѧлъ є҆сѝ оу҆́зники ѿ вѣ́ка та́мѡ сꙋ́щыѧ, * воспѣва́ющыѧ держа́вꙋ непреста́ннѡ твоеѧ̀ бл҃гости.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Death hast Thou endured of Thine own will, O Thou Who alone art immortal; Thou hast plundered hades, O Lord, and crushed the gates of brass, O heavenly King, and delivered the prisoners who were there from the ages, who unceasingly hymn the dominion of Thy goodness![^859]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
Death hast Thou endured of Thine own will, O Thou Who alone art immortal; Thou hast plundered hades, O Lord, and crushed the gates of brass, O heavenly King, and delivered the prisoners who were there from the ages, who unceasingly hymn the dominion of Thy goodness![^859]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Возне́слсѧ є҆сѝ, Долготерпѣли́ве, во́лею на дре́во, * и҆ ка́менїе распаде́сѧ, и҆ Сл҃нце оу҆гасѐ, * и҆ завѣ́са цр҃ко́внаѧ раздра́сѧ, и҆ землѧ̀ поколеба́сѧ, * и҆ потрепета̀ всепоглоща́нный а҆́дъ, * и҆ всѧ̑ оу҆́зники разрѣши́.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree of Thine own will, O Long-suffering One; and the rocks were rent, and the sun grew dark, and the veil of the temple was torn in twain, and the earth was shaken, and all-devouring hades trembled, and released all the prisoners![^860]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree of Thine own will, O Long-suffering One; and the rocks were rent, and the sun grew dark, and the veil of the temple was torn in twain, and the earth was shaken, and all-devouring hades trembled, and released all the prisoners![^860]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и во тмѣ̀ сѣдѧ́щымъ, * Свѣ́тъ сы́й незаходи́мый, и҆ Живо́тъ всѣ́хъ: * тѣ́мже тѧ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣ пра́ведныхъ со́нмъ, * взыгра́сѧ Сло́ве и҆ возопѝ: * прише́лъ є҆сѝ всѧ̑ ѿ оу҆́зъ разрѣши́ти, пою́щыѧ держа́вꙋ твою̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast appeared unto those sitting in darkness, O Lord, Who art the unwaning Light and the Life of all; therefore when the assembly of the righteous beheld Thee, O Word, they leaped for joy and cried aloud: Thou hast come to release all from bonds who hymn Thy dominion![^861]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
Thou hast appeared unto those sitting in darkness, O Lord, Who art the unwaning Light and the Life of all; therefore when the assembly of the righteous beheld Thee, O Word, they leaped for joy and cried aloud: Thou hast come to release all from bonds who hymn Thy dominion![^861]

items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Бли́зъ сѣ́лъ є҆сѝ и҆сто́чника, въ ча́съ, Сп҃се, шесты́й, * и҆ Самарѧны́ни во́дꙋ живꙋ́ю пода́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ ра́зꙋма во́ды, за мно́гое бл҃гоꙋтро́бїе: * съ не́юже всѝ вопїе́мъ воспѣва́юще: * бл҃гослови́те дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇нѧ непреста́ннѡ Гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst sit near the well, O Savior, at the sixth hour, and didst grant unto the Samaritan woman living water and the waters of understanding, by reason of Thine abundant tender mercy; with her we all cry aloud, chanting: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, unceasingly![^862]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
Thou didst sit near the well, O Savior, at the sixth hour, and didst grant unto the Samaritan woman living water and the waters of understanding, by reason of Thine abundant tender mercy; with her we all cry aloud, chanting: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, unceasingly![^862]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆́глемъ ѡ҆чища́етсѧ И҆са́їа, * пред̾проповѣ́дꙋѧ мы́сленнаго Оу҆́глѧ, воплоща́ема, Дв҃о, и҆з̾ тебѐ па́че мы́сли, * ѡ҆палѧ́юща человѣ́кѡвъ всѧ̑ ве́щныѧ грѣхѝ, * и҆ ѡ҆божа́юща за млⷭ҇рдїе є҆стество̀ на́ше, Всенепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: We hymn the unoriginate Father, the co-unoriginate Son, and the Holy Spirit: God, One in Three, unconfused, undivided, Creator of all, of one equal power, sovereign Dominion, and we cry aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, unceasingly!

provenance.verbatim_source: We hymn the unoriginate Father, the co-unoriginate Son, and the Holy Spirit: God, One in Three, unconfused, undivided, Creator of all, of one equal power, sovereign Dominion, and we cry aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, unceasingly!

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь ѳ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Чꙋ́жде ма́теремъ:
items.english_text: With a live coal was Isaiah cleansed, prefiguring the spiritual Coal Who is incarnate from thee beyond comprehension, O Virgin, consuming all the material sins of mankind, and through mercy deifying our nature, O all-blameless Lady![^863]

provenance.verbatim_source: With a live coal was Isaiah cleansed, prefiguring the spiritual Coal Who is incarnate from thee beyond comprehension, O Virgin, consuming all the material sins of mankind, and through mercy deifying our nature, O all-blameless Lady![^863]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Вмѣсти́ла є҆сѝ во чре́вѣ твое́мъ, Дв҃о-Мт҃и, * є҆ди́наго ѿ Трⷪ҇цы, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Жизнода́вца: * є҆го́же пое́тъ всѧ̀ тва́рь, и҆ трепе́щꙋтъ го́рнїи прⷭ҇то́ли: * того̀ молѝ, Всебл҃же́ннаѧ, спастѝ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Alien to mothers is virginity...[^864]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos:*  
Alien to mothers is virginity...[^864]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ: Сотворѝ держа́вꙋ мы́шцею свое́ю, * низложѝ бо си́лныѧ со прⷭ҇то́лъ, и҆ вознесѐ смире́нныѧ Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ, * въ ни́хже посѣтѝ на́съ Восто́къ съ высоты̀, * и҆ напра́вилъ ны̀ є҆́сть на пꙋ́ть ми́ра.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When the Jewish feast was at Mid-point, Thou didst go up into Thy Sanctuary, O my Savior, and didst teach all; and the Jews marveled, saying: Whence knows this man letters, having never learned?[^865]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
When the Jewish feast was at Mid-point, Thou didst go up into Thy Sanctuary, O my Savior, and didst teach all; and the Jews marveled, saying: Whence knows this man letters, having never learned?[^865]

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Pouring forth gifts of healing, my Redeemer wrought wonders and signs, driving away diseases and healing the infirm; but the Jews were maddened by the multitude of His wonders![^866]

items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ: Сотворѝ держа́вꙋ мы́шцею свое́ю, * низложѝ бо си́лныѧ со прⷭ҇то́лъ, и҆ вознесѐ смире́нныѧ Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ, * въ ни́хже посѣтѝ на́съ Восто́къ съ высоты̀, * и҆ напра́вилъ ны̀ є҆́сть на пꙋ́ть ми́ра.
items.english_text: He hath showed strength with His arm, for He hath put down the mighty from their thrones and exalted the humble, the God of Israel, wherein the Dayspring from on high hath visited us, and hath guided us into the way of peace![^868]

provenance.verbatim_source: He hath showed strength with His arm, for He hath put down the mighty from their thrones and exalted the humble, the God of Israel, wherein the Dayspring from on high hath visited us, and hath guided us into the way of peace![^868]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ ви́дѣнъ бы́сть Живо́тъ всѣ́хъ Хрⷭ҇то́съ, * повѣ́шенъ во́лею на дре́вѣ: * и҆ сїѧ̑ ви́дѧщи землѧ̀, потрясе́сѧ, * и҆ мнѡ́га ст҃ы́хъ воста́ша ꙗ҆́вѣ тѣлеса̀ оу҆со́пшихъ, * и҆ оу҆зохрани́лища а҆́дова поколеба́шасѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Behold, Christ the Life of all was seen, hanging of His own will upon the Tree; and beholding this, the earth trembled, and many bodies of the sleeping saints visibly arose, and the strongholds of hades were shaken![^869]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
Behold, Christ the Life of all was seen, hanging of His own will upon the Tree; and beholding this, the earth trembled, and many bodies of the sleeping saints visibly arose, and the strongholds of hades were shaken![^869]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Кра́сенъ и҆з̾ гро́ба, ꙗ҆́кѡ жени́хъ ѿ черто́га, и҆зше́лъ є҆сѝ, * сме́рти разори́вый мꙋчи́телство, Хрⷭ҇тѐ, * и҆ а҆́довы вереѝ сокрꙋши́вый си́лою Бж҃ественною, * и҆ Воста́нїа твоегѡ̀ свѣ́томъ оу҆́мнымъ просвѣти́вый мі́ръ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Fair as a bridegroom from the chamber didst Thou come forth from the tomb, having overthrown the tyranny of death, O Christ, and shattered the bars of hades by divine power, and enlightened the world with the spiritual light of Thy Resurrection![^870]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
Fair as a bridegroom from the chamber didst Thou come forth from the tomb, having overthrown the tyranny of death, O Christ, and shattered the bars of hades by divine power, and enlightened the world with the spiritual light of Thy Resurrection![^870]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Соста́вимъ всѝ ны́нѣ ли́ки дх҃ѡвныѧ, и҆ да зове́мъ: * Гдⷭ҇ь воскре́се! да ра́дꙋетсѧ землѧ̀, да весели́тсѧ нб҃о, * ѡ҆́блацы да кропѧ́тъ на́мъ пра́вды тꙋ́чы, * пра́зднꙋющымъ свѣ́тлѡ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ пою́щымъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Let us all now form spiritual choirs, and let us cry: The Lord is risen! Let the earth rejoice, let heaven be glad, let the clouds drop down showers of righteousness for us who celebrate radiantly and hymn Christ![^871]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
Let us all now form spiritual choirs, and let us cry: The Lord is risen! Let the earth rejoice, let heaven be glad, let the clouds drop down showers of righteousness for us who celebrate radiantly and hymn Christ![^871]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь живꙋ́щихъ, И҆сто́чникъ бл҃ги́хъ Гдⷭ҇ь, * бога́тнѡ и҆сточа́ѧй во́дꙋ оу҆че́нїй, вопїе́тъ женѣ̀: * пода́ждь ми во́дꙋ пи́ти, ꙗ҆́кѡ да пода́мъ тѝ во́дꙋ, * грѣхѡ́въ твои́хъ и҆сто́чники и҆зсꙋша́ющꙋю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Lord, the Life of the living, the Fountain of good things, richly pouring forth the water of teachings, cries unto the woman: Give Me water to drink, that I may give thee water which dris up the fountains of thy sins![^872]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
The Lord, the Life of the living, the Fountain of good things, richly pouring forth the water of teachings, cries unto the woman: Give Me water to drink, that I may give thee water which dris up the fountains of thy sins![^872]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: Свѣ́тꙋ бы́вши жили́ще, Чи́стаѧ, * ѡ҆зарѝ зѣ́ницы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ ѡ҆мраче́нныѧ мнѡ́гими ко́знми врага̀, * и҆ ви́дѣти сподо́би ꙗ҆́снѡ, * ѿ тебѐ возсїѧ́вшїй Свѣ́тъ, па́че мы́сли, чи́стымъ се́рдцемъ.
items.english_text: One Light indivisible, Trinity in three suns, unoriginate Father, Son, and Spirit, one Godhead, Life and Creator of all: Him let us, the faithful, hymn with the bodiless powers, sacredly chanting with thrice-holy hymns!

provenance.verbatim_source: One Light indivisible, Trinity in three suns, unoriginate Father, Son, and Spirit, one Godhead, Life and Creator of all: Him let us, the faithful, hymn with the bodiless powers, sacredly chanting with thrice-holy hymns!

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, Самарѧны́ни Подо́бенъ: Жены̀: Въ Самарі́ю прише́лъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се мо́й всеси́льне, * и҆ женѣ̀ бесѣ́довавъ, проси́лъ є҆сѝ воды̀ пи́ти, * є҆вре́емъ во́ды и҆сточи́вый и҆з̾ ка́мене несѣко́магѡ: * ю҆́же къ вѣ́рѣ совоспрїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ ны́нѣ жи́зни наслажда́етсѧ, на нб҃сѣ́хъ вѣ́чнѡ.
items.english_text: Having become the dwelling-place of Light, O Pure One, illumine the eyes of my soul which are darkened by the many snares of the enemy, and make me worthy to behold clearly with a pure heart the Light that shone forth from thee beyond understanding!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having become the dwelling-place of Light, O Pure One, illumine the eyes of my soul which are darkened by the many snares of the enemy, and make me worthy to behold clearly with a pure heart the Light that shone forth from thee beyond understanding!

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Преполока́нїю. Подо́бенъ: Преполови́вшꙋсѧ прише́лъ є҆сѝ пра́здникꙋ, Чл҃вѣколю́бче, * во Ст҃и́лище, и҆ глаго́лалъ є҆сѝ: * жа́жды и҆спо́лненнїи ко мнѣ̀ прїиди́те, * и҆ почерпи́те во́дꙋ живꙋ́ю и҆ пита́ющꙋю: * є҆́юже пи́щи, и҆ бл҃года́ти, жи́зни же безсме́ртныѧ наслади́тесѧ всѝ.
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion of Pascha, once:* Having fallen asleep in the flesh as a mortal, O King and Lord, on the third day Thou didst rise again, raising Adam from corruption and abolishing death, O Pascha of incorruption, the salvation of the world![^873]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Exapostilarion of Pascha, once:*  
Having fallen asleep in the flesh as a mortal, O King and Lord, on the third day Thou didst rise again, raising Adam from corruption and abolishing death, O Pascha of incorruption, the salvation of the world![^873]

items.office: ON THE FIFTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇то́мъ твои́мъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, дре́внїѧ клѧ́твы свободи́лъ є҆сѝ на́съ, * и҆ сме́ртїю твое́ю, є҆стество̀ на́ше мꙋ́чащаго дїа́вола оу҆праздни́лъ є҆сѝ: * тѣ́мже вопїе́мъ тѝ: * воскре́сый и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ Гдⷭ҇и, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: Into Samaria didst Thou come, O my all-powerful Savior, and having conversed with the woman, didst ask water to drink, Who for the Hebrews didst gush forth waters from the flinty rock; whom Thou didst receive unto faith, and she now enjoys life in the heavens unto the ages![^874]

provenance.verbatim_source: Into Samaria didst Thou come, O my all-powerful Savior, and having conversed with the woman, didst ask water to drink, Who for the Hebrews didst gush forth waters from the flinty rock; whom Thou didst receive unto faith, and she now enjoys life in the heavens unto the ages![^874]

items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN

items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇то́мъ твои́мъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, дре́внїѧ клѧ́твы свободи́лъ є҆сѝ на́съ, * и҆ сме́ртїю твое́ю, є҆стество̀ на́ше мꙋ́чащаго дїа́вола оу҆праздни́лъ є҆сѝ: * тѣ́мже вопїе́мъ тѝ: * воскре́сый и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ Гдⷭ҇и, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: When the feast was at Mid-point, Thou didst come into the Sanctuary, O Lover of mankind, and didst say: Ye that are filled with thirst, come unto Me and draw living and nourishing water, whereof having food, grace, and immortal life, enjoy ye all![^875]

provenance.verbatim_source: When the feast was at Mid-point, Thou didst come into the Sanctuary, O Lover of mankind, and didst say: Ye that are filled with thirst, come unto Me and draw living and nourishing water, whereof having food, grace, and immortal life, enjoy ye all![^875]

items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion of the Menaion. Then the present Synaxarion:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇то́мъ твои́мъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, дре́внїѧ клѧ́твы свободи́лъ є҆сѝ на́съ, * и҆ сме́ртїю твое́ю, є҆стество̀ на́ше мꙋ́чащаго дїа́вола оу҆праздни́лъ є҆сѝ: * тѣ́мже вопїе́мъ тѝ: * воскре́сый и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ Гдⷭ҇и, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: Thou Who didst endure the Cross and death, and didst rise from the dead, O all-powerful Lord, we glorify Thy Resurrection![^876]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou Who didst endure the Cross and death, and didst rise from the dead, O all-powerful Lord, we glorify Thy Resurrection![^876]
