items.english_text: Without separating from Thy Father's bosom, O only-begotten Word of God, Thou didst come upon the earth for love of mankind, becoming man without change, and Thou didst endure the Cross and death in the flesh, Thou Who art impassible in Godhead; and having arisen from the dead, Thou hast granted immortality unto the human race, as the only Almighty One.

items.english_text: How should we not marvel at your struggles, O holy Martyrs? For encompassed with mortal body, ye conquered the bodiless enemies: the torturers' threats terrified you not, nor did the assaults of torments dismay you; truly worthily were ye glorified by Christ: pray unceasingly that our souls may be saved![^1021]

items.english_text: The co-unoriginate and co-eternal Son and Word of the Father came unto the fountain, the Fountain of healings, and a woman of Samaria came to draw water, whom the Savior seeing, said: Give Me water to drink, and go, call thy husband. But she, speaking as unto a man and not unto God, seeking to hide herself, said: I have no husband. And the Teacher said unto her: Truly hast thou said: I have no husband; for thou hast had five, and now he whom thou hast is not thy husband. And she, marveling at the word, ran into the city and cried unto the peoples, saying: Come, see Christ, Who grants great mercy unto the world![^1022]

But she, speaking as unto a man and not unto God, seeking to hide herself, said: I have no husband. And the Teacher said unto her: Truly hast thou said: I have no husband; for thou hast had five, and now he whom thou hast is not thy husband. items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Налѧцы̀, и҆ оу҆спѣва́й, и҆ црⷭ҇твꙋй, и҆́стины ра́ди, и҆ кро́тости, и҆ пра́вды. Прїиди́те ви́дите чл҃вѣ́ка, и҆́же рече́ ми дне́сь на и҆сто́чницѣ сѣдѧ́й, что̀ сотвори́хъ: Прⷪ҇ро́къ бо и҆́стиннѣйшій є҆́сть и҆ превели́кій, сокрове́ннаѧ и҆ ꙗ҆вле́ннаѧ вѣ́дый всѧ̑. Но да́рꙋй во́дꙋ жи́вꙋ, ю҆́же подае́ши жа́ждꙋщымъ, да не вжа́ждꙋ па́ки во вѣ́ки, Чл҃вѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Come, see a Man Who told me today, sitting at the fountain, what things I have done: for He is a most true and most great Prophet, knowing all things hidden and revealed. But grant living water, which Thou givest unto them that thirst, that I may thirst no more for ever, O Lover of mankind![^1025]

provenance.verbatim_source: Come, see a Man Who told me today, sitting at the fountain, what things I have done: for He is a most true and most great Prophet, knowing all things hidden and revealed. But grant living water, which Thou givest unto them that thirst, that I may thirst no more for ever, O Lover of mankind![^1025]

items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Возлюби́лъ є҆сѝ пра́вдꙋ, и҆ возненави́дѣлъ є҆сѝ беззако́ніе. И҆сто́чникъ приснотекꙋ́щій, Живо́тъ безсме́ртный, Стрꙋѧ̀ неистоща́емаѧ же и҆ нетлѣ́ннаѧ, пꙋтеше́ствовавъ сѣда́ше бли́зъ кла́дѧза, своѧ̑ оу҆ченикѝ посла́въ по бра́шно, бесѣ́доваше женѣ̀ че́рплющей, сїю̀ хотѧ̀ оу҆лови́ти, и҆ просвѣти́ти дꙋшѝ є҆ѧ̀ ѻ҆́чи.
items.english_text: *Verse: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity.*[^1026]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity.*[^1026]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ г҃. Да ра́дꙋетсѧ дне́сь свѣ́тлѡ нб҃о и҆ землѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ Хрⷭ҇то́съ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ воплоща́емь ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣ́къ, да А҆да́ма и҆́зметъ ѿ клѧ́твы всеро́дна, и҆ оу҆дивла́емь є҆́сть чꙋдесы̀ въ Самарі́ю прише́дъ: женѣ́ же предста̀ воды̀ просѧ̀, и҆́же ѡ҆́блаки вода́ми ѡ҆дѣва́ѧй. Тѣ́мже всѝ вѣ́рніи, поклони́мсѧ, на́съ ра́ди во́лею ѡ҆бнища́вшемꙋ, бл҃гоꙋтро́бнымъ совѣ́томъ.
items.english_text: The ever-flowing Fountain, immortal Life, the inexhaustible and incorruptible Stream, having journeyed, sat near the well, having sent His disciples for food, and conversed with the woman drawing water, desiring to ensnare her, and to enlighten the eyes of her soul.[^1027]

provenance.verbatim_source: The ever-flowing Fountain, immortal Life, the inexhaustible and incorruptible Stream, having journeyed, sat near the well, having sent His disciples for food, and conversed with the woman drawing water, desiring to ensnare her, and to enlighten the eyes of her soul.[^1027]

Оу҆боѧ́всѧ твоегѡ̀, Сп҃се, сни́тїѧ а҆́дъ, ме́ртвыѧ ꙗ҆́же и҆мѧ́ше, подава́ше вско́рѣ, пѣсносло́вѧщыѧ твою̀ неизрече́ннꙋю си́лꙋ.
items.english_text: Let heaven and earth rejoice brightly today, for Christ hath appeared, being incarnate as man, that He might deliver Adam from the ancestral curse, and He is marveled at for wonders, having come into Samaria; and He stood before the woman asking water, He Who clothes the clouds with waters. Therefore let all of us the faithful worship Him Who for our sake voluntarily became poor by compassionate counsel.[^1028]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ѳ. Ви́дѣвши и҆з̾ гро́ба воста́вша твоего̀ Сн҃а, Дв҃о, со А҆пⷭ҇лы ѡ҆ не́мъ ра́доваласѧ є҆сѝ, Чⷭ҇таѧ: съ ни́миже тѧ̀ сла́вимъ.
items.english_text: For the sake of the love of Thine image, O Compassionate One, Thou didst stand upon Thy Cross, and the nations melted away: for Thou, O Lover of mankind, art my strength and my praise.[^1030]

provenance.verbatim_source: For the sake of the love of Thine image, O Compassionate One, Thou didst stand upon Thy Cross, and the nations melted away: for Thou, O Lover of mankind, art my strength and my praise.[^1030]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь и҃. І҆рмо́съ: Всѧ̑ дѣла̀ Бж҃їѧ, и҆ всѧ̀ тва́рь, бл҃гослови́те Гдⷭ҇а, ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣ́кѡмъ ѿ землѝ возсїѧ̀ свѣ́тъ, и҆ вселе́ннꙋю всю̀ просвѣтѝ, и҆ жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю мі́рꙋ дарова̀, по́йте лю́дїе, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* All ye works of God, and all creation, bless the Lord: for unto men from the earth hath light shone forth, and hath enlightened the whole universe, and granted eternal life unto the world; hymn, ye people, and exalt Him above all for ever![^1035]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*  
All ye works of God, and all creation, bless the Lord: for unto men from the earth hath light shone forth, and hath enlightened the whole universe, and granted eternal life unto the world; hymn, ye people, and exalt Him above all for ever![^1035]

items.slavonic_text: Є. На Крⷭ҇тѣ́ тѧ ви́дѣвъ разбо́йникъ бл҃горазꙋ́мный, помѧни́ мѧ, взыва́ше, Влⷣко, оу҆диви́всѧ си́лѣ твое́й, и҆ є҆́же па́че оу҆ма̀ твоемꙋ̀ стра́шномꙋ смотре́нїю. Ѡ. Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ жена́мъ, ра́дꙋйтесѧ, глаго́лѧ млⷭ҇тивнѡ, ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣколю́бецъ, Є҆́ѵы ѡ҆ ско́рбь ꙗ҆́кѡ оу҆толи́лъ, и҆ ра́достнотвора̀ чл҃вѣ́ки твои́мъ Воста́нїемъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion [Acrostic letter E]:* Beholding Thee upon the Cross, the wise thief cried aloud: Remember me, O Master! marveling at Thy power and at Thy dread dispensation which surpasses understanding.[^1036]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: П. Дре́вле слѣпо́мꙋ ѿ рожде́нїѧ, ꙗ҆́коже дарова́лъ є҆сѝ свѣ́тъ, Свѣтода́вче І҆и҃се: си́це и҆ мнѣ̀ серде́чныѧ зѣ́ницы ѿве́рзи, разꙋмѣ́ти свѣ́тъ твои́хъ повелѣ́ній.
items.english_text: *Troparion [Acrostic letter O]:* Thou didst appear unto the women, O Christ, saying graciously: Rejoice! as Lover of mankind, since Thou didst assuage the sorrow of Eve, and didst make men glad by Thy Rising.[^1037]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь ѳ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Ка́мень нерꙋкосѣ́чный ѿ несѣко́мыѧ горы̀, тебѐ Дв҃о, краеꙋго́лный ѿсѣче́сѧ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ, совѡкꙋпи́вый разстоѧ̑щаѧсѧ є҆стества̀: тѣ́мъ весели́щесѧ, тѧ̀ Бцⷣе велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion [Acrostic letter P]:* Even as of old Thou didst grant light unto the man blind from birth, O Giver of light, Jesus: so open Thou also the pupils of my heart, that I may understand the light of Thy commandments.[^1038]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Є. Ре́клъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, ꙗ҆́вльсѧ твои̑мъ ст҃ы̑мъ А҆пⷭ҇лѡмъ по Воскрⷭ҇ніи: мі́ръ прете́кше вѣ́рою, проповѣди́те, ꙗ҆́же во мнѣ̀ ви́дѣсте стра̑шнаѧ, и҆ неизрече́ннаѧ та́инства.
items.english_text: Deliver me from the fire of Gehenna and eternal condemnation, O Pure One; calm the fierce storm of my thoughts, and direct me unto the quiet harbor of life.[^1039]

provenance.verbatim_source: Deliver me from the fire of Gehenna and eternal condemnation, O Pure One; calm the fierce storm of my thoughts, and direct me unto the quiet harbor of life.[^1039]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: І. Ви́дѣла є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇та̀ воста́вша, съ жена́ми Мѵроно́сицами, и҆ преложи́вши рыда́ніе въ ра́дость, сего̀ сла́вила є҆сѝ: тѣ́мже велегла́снѡ тѧ̀ Бг҃ороди́тельнице велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* A cornerstone cut without hand from an unhewn mountain, even from thee, O Virgin, was cut: Christ, Who joined together the sundered natures; therefore rejoicing, we magnify thee, O Theotokos![^1040]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: ѿ сла́дкихъ оу҆́стъ жены̀, во́дꙋ піе́мꙋю, сла́дкꙋю и҆стека́ющꙋю, сꙋ́щи ко гра́дѣ пі́юще, и҆ ко кла́дѧзю и҆сточа́ющемꙋ ѻ҆би́лїе воды̀, потща́хꙋсѧ тещѝ ско́рѡ, и҆ И҆сто́чникъ ви́дѣти приснотекꙋ́щій, и҆сгла́ждшыѧ дꙋ́шы козпрохлажда́ющій.
items.english_text: Behold Him of Whom Moses wrote in the Law that He should come, Jesus the Messiah, appearing upon earth for compassion's sake, and speaking with me as a man at the well: truly this is Christ Who comes into the world!—the Samaritan woman appeared, saying unto those in Sychar.[^1045]

provenance.verbatim_source: Behold Him of Whom Moses wrote in the Law that He should come, Jesus the Messiah, appearing upon earth for compassion's sake, and speaking with me as a man at the well: truly this is Christ Who comes into the world!—the Samaritan woman appeared, saying unto those in Sychar.[^1045]

items.slavonic_text: Соѡбра́зный ви́дѧще И҆сто́чникъ, и҆ є҆диноки́дный человѣ́ческагѡ составле́нїѧ, женѣ̀ вопїѧ́хꙋ ко гра́дѣ сꙋ́щи: не ктомꙋ̀ твоеѧ̀ ра́ди бесѣ́ды мы̀ вѣ́ровахомъ, вои́стиннꙋ позна́вше, ꙗ҆́кѡ То́й є҆́сть И҆збавле́нїе и҆ спасені́е мі́рꙋ вѣ́чное.
items.english_text: Drinking from the sweet lips of the woman the sweet running water to be drunk, those in the city, and unto the well pouring forth abundance of water, made haste to run quickly, and to see the ever-flowing Fountain, refreshing parched souls.[^1046]

provenance.verbatim_source: Drinking from the sweet lips of the woman the sweet running water to be drunk, those in the city, and unto the well pouring forth abundance of water, made haste to run quickly, and to see the ever-flowing Fountain, refreshing parched souls.[^1046]

items.english_text: Beholding the Fountain of the same form and identical appearance of human composition, those in the city cried unto the woman: No longer do we believe because of thy speech, having truly known that He is the Redemption and eternal Salvation of the world![^1047]

items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Къ тебѣ̀ возведо́хъ ѻ҆́чи моѝ: Воскрⷭ҇на: Гдⷭ҇и возше́дъ на Крⷭ҇тъ, пра́дѣднею на́шꙋ клѧ́твꙋ потреби́лъ є҆сѝ: и҆ соше́дъ во а҆́дъ, ꙗ҆́же ѿ вѣ́ка оу҆́зники свободи́лъ є҆сѝ, нетлѣ́нїе да́рꙋѧ чл҃вѣ́ческому ро́дꙋ: сегѡ̀ ра́ди пою́ще сла́вимъ, животворя́щее и҆ спаси́телное твоѐ Воста́нїе.
items.english_text: Having found the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well, Jesus asks water of her, He Who covers the earth with clouds. O wonder! He Who is borne upon the Cherubim conversed with a harlot woman, asking water; He Who suspended the earth upon the waters, seeking water; He Who pours out fountains and lakes of waters, desiring truly to draw her who was ensnared by the adversary enemy, and to give her to drink of living water, who was grievously burned in hidden sins, as the only Compassionate One and Lover of mankind.[^1049]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having found the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well, Jesus asks water of her, He Who covers the earth with clouds. O wonder! He Who is borne upon the Cherubim conversed with a harlot woman, asking water; He Who suspended the earth upon the waters, seeking water; He Who pours out fountains and lakes of waters, desiring truly to draw her who was ensnared by the adversary enemy, and to give her to drink of living water, who was grievously burned in hidden sins, as the only Compassionate One and Lover of mankind.[^1049]

items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Поми́лꙋй на́съ Гдⷭ҇и, поми́лꙋй на́съ: Мч҃ениченъ: Же́ртвы ѡ҆дꙋшевлє́нныѧ, всесожже́нїа слове̑снаѧ, Мч҃еницы Гдⷭ҇ни, заколе́нїа соверше́нна Бж҃їа, Бг҃а зна́ющаѧ, и҆ Бг҃омъ зна́ємаѧ ѻ҆вча́та, и҆́хже ѡ҆гра́да волко́мъ неисхо́дна, моли́тесѧ и҆ на́мъ оу҆пасе́нымъ бы́ти съ ва́ми на водѣ̀ оу҆покое́нїа.
items.english_text: Having Thy Cross at all times as a help, O Christ, we easily trample upon the snares of the enemy.[^1050]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having Thy Cross at all times as a help, O Christ, we easily trample upon the snares of the enemy.[^1050]

items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Поми́лꙋй на́съ Гдⷭ҇и, поми́лꙋй на́съ: Мч҃ениченъ: Же́ртвы ѡ҆дꙋшевлє́нныѧ, всесожже́нїа слове̑снаѧ, Мч҃еницы Гдⷭ҇ни, заколе́нїа соверше́нна Бж҃їа, Бг҃а зна́ющаѧ, и҆ Бг҃омъ зна́ємаѧ ѻ҆вча́та, и҆́хже ѡ҆гра́да волко́мъ неисхо́дна, моли́тесѧ и҆ на́мъ оу҆пасе́нымъ бы́ти съ ва́ми на водѣ̀ оу҆покое́нїа.
items.english_text: Living sacrifices, rational whole-burnt offerings, Martyrs of the Lord, perfect slaughterings of God, sheep knowing God and known of God, whose fold cannot be penetrated by wolves: pray that we also may be pastured with you beside the water of rest![^1054]

provenance.verbatim_source: Living sacrifices, rational whole-burnt offerings, Martyrs of the Lord, perfect slaughterings of God, sheep knowing God and known of God, whose fold cannot be penetrated by wolves: pray that we also may be pastured with you beside the water of rest![^1054]

items.slavonic_text: Въ Пѧто́къ ѡ Самаряны́ни на Оу́трени.
items.english_text: Thus saith the Lord unto the Samaritan woman: If thou hadst known the gift of God, and Who it is that saith unto thee: Give Me water to drink: thou wouldest have asked of Him, and He would have given thee to drink, that thou shouldest not thirst for ever, saith the Lord.[^1055]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thus saith the Lord unto the Samaritan woman: If thou hadst known the gift of God, and Who it is that saith unto thee: Give Me water to drink: thou wouldest have asked of Him, and He would have given thee to drink, that thou shouldest not thirst for ever, saith the Lord.[^1055]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: На Крⷭ҇тѣ́ тѧ возвыша́ема, ꙗ҆́кѡ оу҆зрѣ̀ пречⷭ҇таѧ Мт҃и твоѧ̀, Сло́ве Бж҃ій, ма́терски рыда́ющи вѣща́ше: что̀ но́вое и҆ стра́нное сїѐ чꙋ́до Сн҃е мо́й; ка́кѡ Животѐ всѣ́хъ вкꙋша́еши сме́рти, ѡ҆живи́ти оу҆ме́ршыѧ хотѧ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ;
items.english_text: Unto the Cross, O Savior, the Jews nailed Thee, whereby Thou hast brought us from the nations, O Christ our God, having stretched forth Thy palms upon it of Thine own will, and having willed to be pierced with a spear in Thy ribs: glory to the multitude of Thy compassions, O Lover of mankind![^1057]

provenance.verbatim_source: Unto the Cross, O Savior, the Jews nailed Thee, whereby Thou hast brought us from the nations, O Christ our God, having stretched forth Thy palms upon it of Thine own will, and having willed to be pierced with a spear in Thy ribs: glory to the multitude of Thy compassions, O Lover of mankind![^1057]

items.slavonic_text: По в҃-мъ стїхосло́вїи, сѣда́ленъ пра́здника. Гла́съ д҃. Подо́бенъ: Ско́рѡ предварѝ: ѿ кла́дѧза земна́гѡ и҆ тлѣ́ннагѡ, почерпстѝ во́дꙋ ѻ҆бы́чнѡ Самаранѧ́нина прише́дши, живꙋ́ю во́дꙋ почерпѐ: та́мѡ ѡ҆брѣ́тши И҆сто́чникъ сѣдѧ́щій, и҆́дѣже и҆сто́чникъ и҆ кла́дѧзь І҆а́кѡвъ и҆скопа̀, мі́ра пламеннопита́тельныѧ зно́емъ напаѧ́ющій. Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ: то́йже.
items.english_text: *Verse: Marvelous is God in His saints, the God of Israel.*[^1058]

items.slavonic_text: Та́же, Воскрⷭ҇ніе Хрⷭ҇то́во: и҆ ѱало́мъ н҃. Канѡ́нъ Самаранѧ́ни со і҆рмосо́мъ на и҃: и҆ Минен на д҃.
items.english_text: Thy Martyrs, O Lord, in their sufferings received incorruptible crowns from Thee, our God: for having Thy strength, they cast down the torturers, and crushed the impotent insolence of demons: through their prayers save our souls![^1059]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy Martyrs, O Lord, in their sufferings received incorruptible crowns from Thee, our God: for having Thy strength, they cast down the torturers, and crushed the impotent insolence of demons: through their prayers save our souls![^1059]

items.english_text: Beholding Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Word of God, Thy most pure Mother, weeping maternal laments, cried aloud: What new and strange wonder is this, O my Son? How dost Thou taste of death, O Life of all, desiring to make alive those that have died, as Compassionate?[^1060]

items.english_text: Having come to draw water customarily from the earthly and corruptible well, the Samaritan woman drew living water: having found there the Fountain sitting, where Jacob dug the spring and well, giving to drink unto those of the world who are nourished by burning heat.[^1061]

items.slavonic_text: Мч҃ениченъ: Честна̀ сме́рть ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ Гдⷭ҇и: меча́ми бо и҆ ѻ҆гне́мъ, и҆ стꙋде́нїю сокрꙋша́еми, и҆злїѧ́ша кро́вь свою̀, наде́ждꙋ и҆мꙋ́ще на тѧ̀, воспрїѧ́ти трꙋдѡ́въ мздꙋ̀, претерпѣ́ша же и҆ прїѧ́ша ѿ тебѐ Сп҃се ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: Thou hast given a sign unto them that fear Thee, O Lord: Thy precious Cross, whereby Thou hast conquered the principalities and powers of darkness, and hast brought us up unto the ancient blessedness: therefore do we glorify Thy dispensation of love for mankind, O Jesus Almighty, Savior of our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast given a sign unto them that fear Thee, O Lord: Thy precious Cross, whereby Thou hast conquered the principalities and powers of darkness, and hast brought us up unto the ancient blessedness: therefore do we glorify Thy dispensation of love for mankind, O Jesus Almighty, Savior of our souls.

items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ стїхи̑ры. Гла́съ д҃. Подо́бенъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ: Съ почерпа́ломъ почерпстѝ, прише́дши ко кла́дѧзю, почерпа́ло без̾ воды̀ ѡ҆ста́вивши, є҆ди́на ко гра́дꙋ востечѐ, И҆сто́чникъ животекꙋ́щій ѡ҆брѣ́тши, вопїю́щи Самаранѧ́нина, незави́стный: ѿсю́дꙋже почерпѐ спаси́тельнꙋю во́дꙋ, и҆ се́ю прохладѝ се́рдце, и҆ста́явшее страстьмѝ.
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, guide us unto Thy truth, and deliver us from the snares of the enemy: O Thou Who art risen from the dead, raise up us who are fallen into sin, stretching forth Thy hand, O Lord Lover of mankind, through the prayers of Thy saints![^1066]

provenance.verbatim_source: By Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, guide us unto Thy truth, and deliver us from the snares of the enemy: O Thou Who art risen from the dead, raise up us who are fallen into sin, stretching forth Thy hand, O Lord Lover of mankind, through the prayers of Thy saints![^1066]

items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Возлюби́лъ є҆сѝ пра́вдꙋ, и҆ возненави́дѣлъ є҆сѝ беззако́ніе. Стрꙋю̀ и҆нꙋ́ю животекꙋ́щꙋю, ѿ и҆́нагѡ кла́дѧза Самаранѧ́нина почерпѐ, на кла́дѧзѣ ѡ҆брѣ́тши сїю̀ и҆злива́емꙋ, и҆з̾ негѡ́же тлѣ́ннꙋю и҆мѧ́ше по ѻ҆бы́чаю почерпстѝ во́дꙋ, и҆нꙋ́ю земнꙋ́ю: но и҆на́ѧ входа́щаѧ въ се́рдце є҆ѧ̀ показа́сѧ, а҆́ки и҆сто́чникъ и҆ны́й но́вый, страсте́й ѡ҆роша́ющій распале́ніе.
items.english_text: Precious is the death of Thy saints, O Lord: for crushed by swords and fire and frost, they poured out their blood, having hope in Thee to receive the reward of their labors; they endured, and received from Thee, O Savior, great mercy.[^1067]

provenance.verbatim_source: Precious is the death of Thy saints, O Lord: for crushed by swords and fire and frost, they poured out their blood, having hope in Thee to receive the reward of their labors; they endured, and received from Thee, O Savior, great mercy.[^1067]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ и҃: Є҆гда̀ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ во пло́ти Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, за неизрече́нное смотре́нїе, слы́шавши Самаранѧ́нина сло́во тебѐ Чл҃колю́бца, ѡ҆ста́ви почерпа́ло оу҆ стꙋденца̀, и҆ течѐ гл҃ющи сꙋ́щымъ ко гра́дꙋ: прїиди́те ви́дите Сердцевѣ́дца, є҆да̀ се́й є҆́сть ча́емый Хрⷭ҇то́съ, и҆мѣ́ѧй ве́лїю ми́лость;
items.english_text: The Fountain of the principle of life, Jesus our Savior, having come unto the well of the Patriarch Jacob, asked to drink water of the Samaritan woman; and when she objected that the Jews have no dealings with them, the wise Creator led her on with sweet words, rather unto the requesting of the ever-living water, which she having received, proclaimed unto all, saying: Come, see the Knower of secrets and God, Who hath come in the flesh to save man![^1068]

provenance.verbatim_source: The Fountain of the principle of life, Jesus our Savior, having come unto the well of the Patriarch Jacob, asked to drink water of the Samaritan woman; and when she objected that the Jews have no dealings with them, the wise Creator led her on with sweet words, rather unto the requesting of the ever-living water, which she having received, proclaimed unto all, saying: Come, see the Knower of secrets and God, Who hath come in the flesh to save man![^1068]

Therefore making haste, she cried unto those in the city: I have seen a Man Who told me all things whatsoever I did in secret![^1071]

items.english_text: Another living-flowing stream from another well did the Samaritan woman draw, having found it pouring out at the well from which she was wont to draw corruptible, earthly water: but another stream appeared entering into her heart, as another new fountain, bedewing the burning heat of passions.[^1073]

items.slavonic_text: Въ Пѧто́къ ѡ Самаряны́ни Трипѣ́снецъ, є҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе: До́ѯа тѡ̀ Ѳеѡ̀ а҆ми́н, сі́есть: Сла́ва Бг҃ꙋ, а҆ми́нь. Гла́съ д҃. Пѣ́снь є҆. І҆рмо́съ: Оу҆жасо́шасѧ всѧ́чєскаѧ ѡ҆ Бж҃ественнѣй сла́вѣ твое́й: ты́ бо неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ Дв҃о, и҆мѣ́ла є҆сѝ во оу҆тро́бѣ над̾ всѣ́ми Бг҃а: и҆ родила̀ є҆сѝ безлѣ́тнаго Сн҃а, всѣ̑мъ воспѣва́ющымъ тѧ̀ ми́ръ подава́ющаѧ.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Ѯ. Стра́ннѡ ꙗ҆вла́етсѧ жена́мъ А҆́гг҃лъ, внꙋ́трь гро́ба сѣдѧ̀, и҆ возгласѝ: что̀ прїидо́сте ра́нѡ и҆ска́ти; Хрⷭ҇то́съ воскре́се, оу҆мертви́въ сме́рть.
items.english_text: All things were amazed at thy Divine glory: for thou, O Virgin who hast not known wedlock, didst hold in thy womb the God over all, and didst bear the timeless Son, granting peace unto all who hymn thee.[^1076]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: А. Ст҃а́ѧ Всенепоро́чнаѧ, Ст҃а́го во ст҃ы́хъ препочива́ющаго роди́вшаѧ, сегѡ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣла є҆сѝ и҆з̾ гро́ба возсїѧ́вша, ꙗ҆́кѡ жениха̀ и҆з̾ черто́га, пѣ́сньми велича́ла є҆сѝ сегѡ̀ снизхожде́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion [Acrostic letter D]:* Being bound, O Master, and nailed upon the Tree, Thou hast loosed me from the bonds of sin, and hast nailed me unto Thy love: therefore thankfully do I hymn Thy greatness and Thine ineffable power.[^1077]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь и҃. І҆рмо́съ: Ѻ҆́троки бл҃гочести́выѧ въ пещѝ, Рождество̀ Бг҃оро́дичо спасло̀ є҆́сть, тогда̀ оу҆́бѡ ѡ҆бразꙋ́емое, ны́нѣ же дѣ́йствꙋемое, вселе́ннꙋю всю̀ воздвиза́етъ пѣ́ти тебѣ̀: Гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion [Acrostic letter O]:* When Thou didst appear in hades, O Savior, Adam who was condemned of old was loosed from condemnation and long-enduring bonds, crying aloud: Glory to Thy manifold goodness, O Word, Jesus most merciful![^1078]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, Трⷪ҇ченъ: Є. Є҆ди́наго тѧ̀ сла́влю Сꙋщество́мъ, Трⷪ҇цꙋ же проповѣ́дꙋю ли́цы, є҆ди́но Бж҃тво̀: Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ пребезнача́лна, Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а ст҃а́го, вопїѧ̀ всегда̀: Гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion [Acrostic letter X]:* Marvelously an Angel appears unto the women, sitting within the tomb, and cried aloud: Why have ye come early to seek? Christ is risen, having put death to death![^1079]

items.english_text: Even as God appeared from thee, O Virgin, without violating in any way the tokens of virginity, so did He arise, leaving the seals of the stone undisturbed: Whom beholding, thou wast filled with joy, blessing His Divine power for ever![^1086]

items.slavonic_text: А. Горѣ̀ возше́дъ на высотꙋ̀ Крⷭ҇та̀, во́лею Долготерпѣли́ве, привле́клъ є҆сѝ человѣ́ка ѿ про́пастей па́гꙋбы къ свѣ́тꙋ: положи́вжесѧ во гро́бѣ, Жи́знь сы́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ, во гробѣ́хъ спѧ́щыѧ воздви́глъ є҆сѝ, честны́мъ и҆ сла́внымъ Воста́нїемъ твои́мъ. М. Мѵ́ро тебѣ̀ ли́къ же́нскїй приноша́ше, жи́зни Нача́льникꙋ: и҆ ви́дѣвъ тѧ̀ воста́вша, бл҃говѣстѝ оу҆чн҃кѡ́мъ Воста́нїе, со́браннымъ вкꙋ́пѣ и҆ пла́чꙋщымсѧ, и҆́же ви́дѣвше тѧ̀, просвѣще́нїа и҆ ра́дости и҆спо́лнишасѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Let every earth-born mortal leap for joy, enlightened by the Spirit; and let the nature of the bodiless minds keep festival, honoring the sacred festival of the Mother of God, and let it cry aloud: Rejoice, O most blessed Theotokos, Pure Ever-Virgin![^1087]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: И. Сл҃нце Хрⷭ҇тѐ, во а҆́дѣ бы́въ съ Дꙋше́ю, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ, та́мѡ спѧ́щымъ ѡ҆кова́ннымъ ѿ вѣ́ка, тво́й свѣ́тъ возсїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ ст҃ы̑мъ Воскрⷭ҇ніемъ твои́мъ воспѣва́ющихъ твою̀ бл҃гость.
items.english_text: *Troparion [Acrostic letter A]:* Having ascended on high unto the height of the Cross of Thine own will, O Long-suffering One, Thou didst draw man from the chasms of ruin unto the light; and being laid in the tomb, O Christ Who art Life, Thou didst raise up those that slept in the tombs, by Thy precious and glorious Rising.[^1088]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: Н. Ма́ніемъ всѧ̑ носѧ́щаго Бг҃а, Дв҃о, родила̀ є҆сѝ, чл҃вѣ́ка бы́вша за бл҃гоꙋтро́бїе, Бг҃ора́дованнаѧ: є҆го́же прилѣ́жнѡ молѝ, просвѣти́ти на́ша сердца̀, бл҃жа́щихъ тѧ̀ вои́стиннꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Чⷭ҇тꙋю Бг҃ома́терь.
items.english_text: *Troparion [Acrostic letter M]:* The company of women brought myrrh unto Thee, the Author of life; and beholding Thee arisen, they announced the glad tidings of the Rising unto the disciples who were gathered together and weeping, who beholding Thee, were filled with enlightenment and joy.[^1089]

items.slavonic_text: На Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ, поста́вимъ стїхѡ́въ ѕ҃. И҆ пое́мъ стїхи̑ры Самаранѧ́ни г҃: И҆ Минен г҃. Гла́съ а҃: На и҆сто́чникъ прише́лъ є҆сѝ, И҆сто́чниче чꙋде́съ, въ шесты́й ча́съ, Є҆́ѵинъ оу҆лови́ти пло́дъ: Є҆́ѵа бо въ то́й и҆зы́де и҆з̾ раѧ̀, пре́лестїю ѕмі́евою: прибли́жижесѧ Самаранѧ́нина почерпстѝ во́дꙋ, ю҆́же ви́дѣвъ Сп҃съ, речѐ: да́ждь мѝ воды̀ пи́ти, и҆ а҆́зъ воды̀ текꙋ́щїа насыщꙋ́ тѧ. И҆ ко гра́дꙋ те́кши цѣломꙋ́дреннаѧ, наро́дѡмъ возвѣстѝ а҆́бїе; прїиди́те ви́дите Хрⷭ҇та̀ Гдⷭ҇а, Сп҃си́телѧ дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion [Acrostic letter I]:* O Sun, Christ, being in hades with Thy Soul as God, Thou didst cause Thy light to shine upon those that slept there, who had been bound from the ages, and by Thy holy Resurrection Thou didst raise up them that hymn Thy goodness.[^1090]

items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ в҃: На стꙋде́нецъ ꙗ҆́кѡ прїи́де Гдⷭ҇ь, Самаранѧ́нина молѧ́ше Бл҃гоꙋтро́бнаго: пода́ждь мѝ во́дꙋ вѣ́ры, и҆ прїимꙋ̀ кꙋпѣ̑лныѧ во́ды, ра́дованіе и҆ и҆збавле́нїе: Живода́вче Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: Thou didst bear God Who upholds all things by His nod, O Virgin, Who became man for compassion's sake, O Full of the grace of God: entreat Him earnestly to enlighten our hearts who call thee blessed in truth, as the Pure Mother of God.[^1091]

And running into the city, the chaste woman straightway announced unto the peoples: Come, see Christ the Lord, the Savior of our souls![^1092]

items.slavonic_text: Собезнача́льный и҆ соприсносꙋ́щный Сн҃ъ и҆ Сло́во Ѻ҆ц҃ее, на и҆сто́чникъ прїи́де, И҆сто́чникъ и҆сцѣле́ній, и҆ жена̀ ѿ Самарі́и прїи́де почерпстѝ во́дꙋ, ю҆́же ви́дѣвъ Сп҃съ, речѐ: да́ждь мѝ воды̀ пи́ти, и҆ ше́дши пригласѝ твоего̀ мꙋ́жа. Ѻ҆на́ же ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃вѣ́кꙋ гл҃ющи а҆ не Бг҃ꙋ, оу҆таи́ти тща́щисѧ, глаго́лаше: не и҆́мамъ мꙋ́жа. И҆ Оу҆чи́тель къ не́й: И҆́стинꙋ рекла̀ є҆сѝ, не и҆́мамъ мꙋ́жа: пѧ́ть бо и҆мѣ́ла є҆сѝ, и҆ ны́нѣ є҆го́же и҆́маши, нѣ́сть тво́й мꙋ́жъ. Ѻ҆на́ же ѡ҆ глаго́лѣ оу҆диви́вшисѧ, и҆ ко гра́дꙋ те́кши, наро́дѡмъ вопїѧ́ше, гл҃ющи: прїиди́те ви́дите Хрⷭ҇та̀, и҆́же да́рꙋетъ мі́рови ве́лїю млⷭ҇ть.
items.english_text: The co-unoriginate and co-eternal Son and Word of the Father came unto the fountain, the Fountain of healings, and a woman from Samaria came to draw water, whom the Savior seeing, said: Give Me water to drink, and go, call thy husband. But she, speaking as unto a man and not unto God, seeking to hide herself, said: I have no husband. And the Teacher said unto her: Truly hast thou said: I have no husband; for thou hast had five, and now he whom thou hast is not thy husband. And she, marveling at the word, ran into the city and cried unto the peoples, saying: Come, see Christ, Who grants great mercy unto the world![^1094]

provenance.verbatim_source: The co-unoriginate and co-eternal Son and Word of the Father came unto the fountain, the Fountain of healings, and a woman from Samaria came to draw water, whom the Savior seeing, said: Give Me water to drink, and go, call thy husband. But she, speaking as unto a man and not unto God, seeking to hide herself, said: I have no husband. And she, marveling at the word, ran into the city and cried unto the peoples, saying: Come, see Christ, Who grants great mercy unto the world![^1094]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ, гла́съ д҃. И҆́же тебѐ ра́ди, Бг҃оѻте́цъ Прⷪ҇ро́къ Дв҃дъ, пѣ́сненнѡ ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ провозгласѝ, вели́чїѧ тебѣ̀ Сотво́ршемꙋ: предста̀ Цр҃и́ца ѡ҆деснꙋ́ю тебѐ: тѧ́ бо Мт҃рь, хода́таицꙋ живота̀ показа̀, без̾ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ и҆з̾ тебѐ вочеловѣ́читисѧ бл҃говоли́вый Бг҃ъ: да сво́й па́ки ѡ҆бнови́тъ ѡ҆́бразъ и҆стлѣ́вшій страстьмѝ, и҆ заблꙋ́ждшее горовѣ́щное ѡ҆брѣ́тъ ѻ҆вча̀, на ра́мо воспрїи́мъ, ко Ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ принесе́тъ, и҆ своемꙋ̀ хотѣ́нїю, съ нбⷭ҇ными совѡкꙋпи́тъ си́лами, и҆ спасе́тъ, Бцⷣе, мі́ръ, Хрⷭ҇то́съ и҆мѣ́ѧй ве́лїю и҆ бога́тꙋю ми́лость.
items.english_text: Having found the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well, Jesus asks water of her, He Who covers the earth with clouds. O wonder! He Who is borne upon the Cherubim conversed with a harlot woman, asking water; He Who suspended the earth upon the waters, seeking water; He Who pours out fountains and lakes of waters, desiring truly to draw her who was ensnared by the adversary enemy, and to give her to drink of living water, who was grievously burned in hidden sins, as the only Compassionate One and Lover of mankind.[^1095]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having found the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well, Jesus asks water of her, He Who covers the earth with clouds. O wonder! He Who is borne upon the Cherubim conversed with a harlot woman, asking water; He Who suspended the earth upon the waters, seeking water; He Who pours out fountains and lakes of waters, desiring truly to draw her who was ensnared by the adversary enemy, and to give her to drink of living water, who was grievously burned in hidden sins, as the only Compassionate One and Lover of mankind.[^1095]

items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Гдⷭ҇ь воцр҃и́сѧ, въ лѣ́потꙋ ѡ҆блече́сѧ. Дре́ва преслꙋша́нїѧ запреще́нїе разрѣши́лъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, на дре́вѣ крⷭ҇тнѣмъ во́лею пригвозди́всѧ, и҆ во а҆́дъ соше́дъ Си́лне, сме́ртныѧ оу҆́зы ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ растерза́лъ є҆сѝ: тѣ́мже кла́нѧемсѧ є҆́же и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ твоемꙋ̀ Воскрⷭ҇нію, ра́достїю вопїю́ще: всеси́лне Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: David, the Ancestor of God and Prophet, through song proclaimed beforehand concerning thee unto Him Who hath done great things for thee: At Thy right hand stood the Queen. For God, Who was pleased without father to become man from thee, showed thee forth as Mother, the mediatress of life: that He might renew His own image, corrupted by passions, and having found the sheep gone astray upon the mountains, taking it upon His shoulder, He might bring it unto the Father, and by His own will unite it with the heavenly powers, and that Christ, Who hath great and rich mercy, might save the world, O Theotokos![^1096]

provenance.verbatim_source: David, the Ancestor of God and Prophet, through song proclaimed beforehand concerning thee unto Him Who hath done great things for thee: At Thy right hand stood the Queen. For God, Who was pleased without father to become man from thee, showed thee forth as Mother, the mediatress of life: that He might renew His own image, corrupted by passions, and having found the sheep gone astray upon the mountains, taking it upon His shoulder, He might bring it unto the Father, and by His own will unite it with the heavenly powers, and that Christ, Who hath great and rich mercy, might save the world, O Theotokos![^1096]

items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: До́мꙋ твоемꙋ̀ подоба́етъ ст҃ы́ни Гдⷭ҇и, въ долготꙋ̀ дні́й. Гдⷭ҇и, возше́дъ на Крⷭ҇тъ, пра́дѣднею на́шꙋ клѧ́твꙋ потреби́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ соше́дъ во а҆́дъ, ꙗ҆́же ѿ вѣ́ка оу҆́зники свободи́лъ є҆сѝ, нетлѣ́нїе да́рꙋѧ чл҃вѣ́ческому ро́дꙋ, сегѡ̀ ра́ди пою́ще сла́вимъ, животворя́щее и҆ спаси́телное твоѐ Воста́ніе.
items.english_text: Bowing down unceasingly before Thy life-creating Cross, O Christ God, we glorify Thy third-day Resurrection: for thereby hast Thou renewed human nature which had fallen into corruption, O Almighty One, and renewed for us the ascent unto heaven, as the only Good One and Lover of mankind.[^1097]

provenance.verbatim_source: Bowing down unceasingly before Thy life-creating Cross, O Christ God, we glorify Thy third-day Resurrection: for thereby hast Thou renewed human nature which had fallen into corruption, O Almighty One, and renewed for us the ascent unto heaven, as the only Good One and Lover of mankind.[^1097]

items.english_text: O Lord, having ascended the Cross, Thou hast abolished our ancestral curse, and having descended into hades, Thou hast freed the prisoners from the ages, granting incorruption unto the human race: therefore with hymns we glorify Thy life-creating and saving Rising.[^1103]

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lord, having ascended the Cross, Thou hast abolished our ancestral curse, and having descended into hades, Thou hast freed the prisoners from the ages, granting incorruption unto the human race: therefore with hymns we glorify Thy life-creating and saving Rising.[^1103]

items.slavonic_text: Въ Сꙋббѡ́тꙋ ѡ Самаряны́ни на Оу́трени,
items.english_text: When Thou didst appear in the flesh, O Christ God, for Thine ineffable dispensation, the Samaritan woman, hearing the word of Thee the Lover of mankind, left her bucket at the well, and ran, saying unto those in the city: Come, see the Knower of hearts; can this be the expected Christ, Who hath great mercy?[^1104]

items.slavonic_text: По в҃-мъ стїхосло́вїи, сѣда́ленъ. Гла́съ д҃. Подо́бенъ: Вознесы́йсѧ на Крⷭ҇тъ: Да ра́дꙋетсѧ нб҃о, да весела́тсѧ земна̑ѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Хрⷭ҇то́съ ѿ Дв҃ы ꙗ҆ви́сѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃вѣ́къ, и҆зба́ви и҆з̾ и҆стлѣ́нїа всѐ человѣ́чество свое́ю сме́ртїю: чꙋдесы̀ возсїѧ̀ женѣ̀ Самаранѧ́нкѣ воды̀ просѧ́щей, подае́тъ и҆сто́чникъ и҆сцѣле́ній, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ безсме́ртный. Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ, то́йже:
items.english_text: Gazing upon the entrance of the tomb, and not enduring the fiery brilliance of the Angel, the Myrrh-bearing women marveled with trembling, saying: Was He stolen away Who opened Paradise unto the thief? Or is He risen Who even before the Passion proclaimed the Rising? Truly Christ is risen, granting life and resurrection unto those in hades!

provenance.verbatim_source: Gazing upon the entrance of the tomb, and not enduring the fiery brilliance of the Angel, the Myrrh-bearing women marveled with trembling, saying: Was He stolen away Who opened Paradise unto the thief? Or is He risen Who even before the Passion proclaimed the Rising? Truly Christ is risen, granting life and resurrection unto those in hades!

items.slavonic_text: Воскрⷭ҇ніе Хрⷭ҇то́во: ѱало́мъ н҃. Канѡ́нъ ѡ Самаранѧ́ни, на ѕ҃: И҆ ст҃а́гѡ ѡ҆би́тели, на д҃: и҆ Минен на д҃. Конда́къ, и҆ Ѣ҆ѯапостїла́рїй ѡ Самаранѧ́ни.
items.english_text: The mystery hidden from the ages and unknown unto Angels, through thee, O Theotokos, hath been revealed unto those on earth: God incarnate in unconfused union, and of His own will accepting the Cross for our sake, whereby having resurrected the first-formed man, He hath saved our souls from death.[^1107]

provenance.verbatim_source: The mystery hidden from the ages and unknown unto Angels, through thee, O Theotokos, hath been revealed unto those on earth: God incarnate in unconfused union, and of His own will accepting the Cross for our sake, whereby having resurrected the first-formed man, He hath saved our souls from death.[^1107]

items.english_text: Let heaven rejoice, let earthly things be glad, for Christ hath appeared from the Virgin as man, and hath delivered all mankind from corruption by His death; shining forth with wonders unto the Samaritan woman asking water, He grants the fountain of healings, as the only Immortal One.[^1108]

items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ д҃:
items.english_text: Thou Who didst endure the Cross and death, and didst rise from the dead, O Almighty Lord, we glorify Thy Resurrection.[^1114]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou Who didst endure the Cross and death, and didst rise from the dead, O Almighty Lord, we glorify Thy Resurrection.[^1114]

items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тъ претерпѣ́вый и҆ сме́рть, и҆ воскрⷭ҇ый и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ, всеси́льне Гдⷭ҇и, сла́вимъ твоѐ Воскресе́нїе.
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ, Thou hast set us free from the ancient curse; and by Thy death Thou hast abolished the devil who tormented our nature; and by Thy Rising Thou hast filled all things with joy: therefore do we cry unto Thee: O Lord Who didst rise from the dead, glory to Thee![^1115]

provenance.verbatim_source: By Thy Cross, O Christ, Thou hast set us free from the ancient curse; and by Thy death Thou hast abolished the devil who tormented our nature; and by Thy Rising Thou hast filled all things with joy: therefore do we cry unto Thee: O Lord Who didst rise from the dead, glory to Thee![^1115]

items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON SATURDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇то́мъ твои́мъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, дре́внїѧ кла́твы свободи́лъ є҆сѝ на́съ, и҆ сме́ртїю твое́ю, є҆стество̀ на́ше мꙋ́чащаго дїа́вола ᲂу҆праздни́лъ є҆сѝ: Воста́нїемъ же твои́мъ ра́дости всѧ̑ и҆спо́лнилъ є҆сѝ: тѣ́мже вопїе́мъ тѝ: воскрⷭ҇ый и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ Гдⷭ҇и, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, guide us unto Thy truth, and deliver us from the snares of the enemy: O Thou Who didst rise from the dead, raise us up who have fallen into sin, stretching forth Thy hand, O Lord Lover of mankind, by the prayers of Thy saints.[^1116]

provenance.verbatim_source: By Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, guide us unto Thy truth, and deliver us from the snares of the enemy: O Thou Who didst rise from the dead, raise us up who have fallen into sin, stretching forth Thy hand, O Lord Lover of mankind, by the prayers of Thy saints.[^1116]

items.office: ON SATURDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
items.day_or_date: ON SATURDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Твои́мъ Крⷭ҇то́мъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Сп҃се, наста́ви на́съ на и҆́стинꙋ твою̀, и҆ и҆зба́ви ны̀ ѿ сѣ́тей вра́жїихъ: Воскрⷭ҇ый и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ, возста́ви ны̀ па́дшыѧ грѣхо́мъ, просте́ръ рꙋ́кꙋ твою̀ человѣколю́бче Гдⷭ҇и, моли́твами ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ.
items.english_text: Without parting from the Father’s bosom, O only-begotten Word of God, Thou didst come down to earth for love of mankind, becoming man without undergoing change; and Thou didst endure the Cross and death in the flesh, being impassible in Thy Godhead: and having risen from the dead, Thou hast granted immortality unto the human race, as the only Almighty One.[^1117]

provenance.verbatim_source: Without parting from the Father’s bosom, O only-begotten Word of God, Thou didst come down to earth for love of mankind, becoming man without undergoing change; and Thou didst endure the Cross and death in the flesh, being impassible in Thy Godhead: and having risen from the dead, Thou hast granted immortality unto the human race, as the only Almighty One.[^1117]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ ѕ҃:
items.english_text: Jesus our Savior, the Fountain of the principle of life, coming unto the fountain of the Patriarch Jacob, asked water to drink from the Samaritan woman: and when she objected that Jews have no dealings with them, the wise Creator led her by sweet words rather unto asking for ever-flowing water; which having received, she proclaimed unto all, saying: Come, see the Knower of secrets and God, Who came in the flesh to save man![^1118]

provenance.verbatim_source: Jesus our Savior, the Fountain of the principle of life, coming unto the fountain of the Patriarch Jacob, asked water to drink from the Samaritan woman: and when she objected that Jews have no dealings with them, the wise Creator led her by sweet words rather unto asking for ever-flowing water; which having received, she proclaimed unto all, saying: Come, see the Knower of secrets and God, Who came in the flesh to save man![^1118]

items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ д҃. Подо́бенъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ:
items.english_text: Beholding the ever-flowing Fountain sitting at the well, the woman enduring the heat of exceedingly many passions asked to receive the healing water of life poured forth from Him as a torrent, which also she received freely from the Word, and no longer hastens unto an earthly and corruptible well.[^1119]

provenance.verbatim_source: Beholding the ever-flowing Fountain sitting at the well, the woman enduring the heat of exceedingly many passions asked to receive the healing water of life poured forth from Him as a torrent, which also she received freely from the Word, and no longer hastens unto an earthly and corruptible well.[^1119]

items.slavonic_text: И҆сто́чника приснотекꙋ́щаго, сѣдѧ́ща на кла́дязи ви́дѣвши жена̀, терпѧ́щи зно́й премнѡ́гихъ страсте́й, и҆сцѣли́тельнꙋю проша́ше прїѧ́ти во́дꙋ жи́зни, и҆з̾ негѡ̀ и҆злива́емꙋю, а҆́ки пото́къ, ю҆́же и҆ прїя́тъ тꙋ́не ѿ Сло́ва, и҆ не ктомꙋ̀ ко кла́дязю тщи́тсѧ, земно́мꙋ и҆ тлѣ́нномꙋ.
items.english_text: *Verse: Bend Thy bow, and proceed prosperously, and reign, for the sake of truth, and meekness, and righteousness.*[^1120]

items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Наляцы̀, и҆ ᲂу҆спѣва́й, и҆ црⷭ҇твꙋй, и҆́стины ра́ди, и҆ кро́тости, и҆ пра́вды.
items.english_text: While the woman pursued Jewish customs and brought forward her own non-communion, Christ the wise Creator, accustomed to communion of water, by sweet utterances led her to ask for this divine living-flowing water, which having drunk, she came into the city, crying aloud as she announced it.[^1121]

items.day_or_date: ON SATURDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: І҆ꙋде́йскїѧ ѻ҆бы́чаи женѣ̀ гонѧ́щей, и҆ своѐ прилага́ющей неприча́стное, прича́стїю воды̀, привы́кшїй, мꙋ́дрый Содѣ́тель, Хрїсто́съ, сла́дкими провѣща́нми, и҆спроси́ти животекꙋ́щꙋю сїю̀ во́дꙋ Бж҃е́ственнꙋю, ю҆́же пи́вши, ко гра́дꙋ прїи́де, возвѣща́ющи взыва́ла.
items.english_text: *Verse: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity.*[^1122]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity.*[^1122]

items.day_or_date: ON SATURDAY OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN, AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Возлюби́лъ є҆сѝ пра́вдꙋ, и҆ возненави́дѣлъ є҆сѝ беззако́нїе.
items.english_text: Thou hast no drawing-vessel, and the well is very deep; whence then dost Thou give me incorruptible water? The Samaritan woman cried unto Thee, O Christ, supposing Thee to be a man and not God, and marveling at Thy words; whom having given to drink with sweetest sayings, Thou didst cause to confess Thee as the God of all creation.[^1123]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ ѕ҃:
items.english_text: Thus saith the Lord unto the Samaritan woman: If thou hadst known the gift of God, and Who He is that saith unto thee: Give Me water to drink, thou wouldst have asked of Him, and He would have given thee to drink, that thou mightest never thirst unto ages, saith the Lord.[^1124]

items.slavonic_text: ᾌ [А] Просте́ръ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пречт҃ыѧ дла̑ни твоѧ̑, мы́сленнаго распѧ́лъ є҆сѝ А҆мали́ка Бж҃е́ственною си́лою твое́ю, и҆ мі́ръ и҆зба́вилъ є҆сѝ ѿ рабо́ты, Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е на́шъ.
items.english_text: I will sacrifice unto Thee with the voice of praise, O Lord, the Church cries unto Thee, having been cleansed from the blood of demons by the blood that flowed through mercy from Thy side.[^1126]

items.slavonic_text: δ [Д] Сокрꙋши́вый стра́шнымъ сни́тїемъ а҆́да, Хрⷭ҇тѐ, и҆ ꙗ҆́же держа́ше ᲂу҆́зники Бж҃ственною восхи́тивъ си́лою, воскре́слъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ и҆з̾ гро́ба тридне́внѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion [Acrostic letter A]:* Having stretched forth Thine immaculate palms upon the Cross, Thou didst crucify the spiritual Amalek by Thy divine power, and didst deliver the world from bondage, O Christ our God.[^1127]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: Desiring to loose the misfortune of Adam fallen in Eden, O Almighty Lord, Thou didst become incarnate of thee, O All-immaculate One, and wast crucified and buried, and didst rise, saving us who hymn thee with love, O Mary Bride of God.[^1140]

items.slavonic_text: Честны́мъ твои́мъ Крⷭ҇то́мъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ: Воскрⷭ҇нїе даѧ́й ро́дꙋ человѣ́ческомꙋ: Ве́лїе чꙋ́до, неви́димыхъ Содѣ́тель: Вече́рнее поклоне́нїе прино́симъ тебѣ̀:
items.english_text: A great wonder, the Creator of invisible things...

provenance.verbatim_source: A great wonder, the Creator of invisible things...

items.office: SIXTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE BLIND MAN
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE BLIND MAN AND FEAST OF THE ASCENSION
items.day_or_date: SIXTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE BLIND MAN
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ є҃: Бг҃олѣ́пнꙋю и҆ пречт҃ꙋю Ѻ҆трокови́цꙋ почти́мъ, Чт҃нѣ́йшꙋю Херꙋвї́мѡвъ: Содѣ́тель бо всѣ́хъ вочеловѣ́читися восхотѣ́вый, въ ню̀ всели́ся несказа́ннѡ. Ѡ҆ стра́шныхъ веще́й, и҆ пресла́вныхъ та́инствъ! кто́ бы не ᲂу҆диви́лся, сїѐ слы́шавъ; ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ чл҃в́къ быва́етъ, и҆ премѣне́нїѧ въ не́мъ не бы́сть: и҆ дѣ́вства врата̀ про́йде, и҆ ᲂу҆мале́нїе въ не́мъ не ѡ҆ста́вися, ꙗ҆́коже Прⷪ҇ро́къ глаго́летъ: человѣ́къ сїѧ̑ не про́йдетъ когда̀, то́кмѡ є҆ди́нъ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ, и҆мѣ́ѧй ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: Let us honor the God-befitting and all-pure Maiden, more honorable than the Cherubim: for the Creator of all, desiring to become man, took up His dwelling in her ineffably. O dread things and most glorious mysteries! Who would not marvel, hearing this: that God becomes man, and there is no alteration in Him; and He passes through the gates of virginity, and no diminution was left in Him; even as the Prophet saith: Man shall never pass through them, but only the Lord God of Israel, Who hath great mercy![^1151]

provenance.verbatim_source: Let us honor the God-befitting and all-pure Maiden, more honorable than the Cherubim: for the Creator of all, desiring to become man, took up His dwelling in her ineffably. O dread things and most glorious mysteries! Who would not marvel, hearing this: that God becomes man, and there is no alteration in Him; and He passes through the gates of virginity, and no diminution was left in Him; even as the Prophet saith: Man shall never pass through them, but only the Lord God of Israel, Who hath great mercy![^1151]

items.office: SIXTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE BLIND MAN
items.section: At the Aposticha, Resurrection sticheron, Tone 5
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE BLIND MAN AND FEAST OF THE ASCENSION
items.day_or_date: SIXTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE BLIND MAN
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ воскре́сна стїхи́ра гла́съ є҃. Тебѐ воплоще́ннаго Сп҃са Хрⷭ҇та̀, и҆ нб҃съ не разлꙋчи́вшагося, во гла́сѣхъ пѣ́нїй велича́емъ: ꙗ҆́кѡ Крⷭ҇тъ и҆ сме́рть прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ за ро́дъ на́шъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃в́колю́бецъ Гдⷭ҇ь: и҆спрове́ргїй а҆́дѡва врата̀, тридне́внѡ воскре́слъ є҆сѝ, спаса́ѧ дꙋ́шы на́ша.
items.english_text: Thee, Christ the incarnate Savior, Who didst not part from heaven, we magnify with voices of song: for Thou didst accept the Cross and death for our race, as the Lord Lover of mankind; and having overthrown the gates of hades, Thou didst rise on the third day, saving our souls.[^1152]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thee, Christ the incarnate Savior, Who didst not part from heaven, we magnify with voices of song: for Thou didst accept the Cross and death for our race, as the Lord Lover of mankind; and having overthrown the gates of hades, Thou didst rise on the third day, saving our souls.[^1152]

items.day_or_date: SIXTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE BLIND MAN
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Слы́ши дщѝ и҆ ви́ждь, и҆ приклонѝ ᲂу҆́хо твоѐ. Ра́дꙋйсѧ слове́сное Нб҃о, въ не́мже Бг҃ъ воплоти́вся всели́ся, Рꙋ́чко Бж҃е́ственныѧ ма́нны, Свѣ́щниче со́лнца Бж҃їѧ, Горо̀ присѣ́неннаѧ, Черто́же Бг҃овмѣсти́тельный, живопода́тельнаѧ Трапе́зо, златы́й Свѣти́льниче, свѣтоно́сный Раю̀, Кꙋпино̀ неопали́маѧ, Ковче́же ст҃ы́ни, Лѣ́ствице нбⷭ҇наѧ, Ѻ҆́блаче ѡ҆дꙋшевлє́нный, Же́зле ѿ ко́рене, Дѣ́во, І҆ессе́ова возра́стшїй: Хрⷭ҇та̀ молѝ, дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ да́тися ве́лїей ми́лости.
items.english_text: *Verse: I will remember thy name in every generation and generation.*[^1153]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: I will remember thy name in every generation and generation.*[^1153]

items.office: SIXTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE BLIND MAN
items.section: At the Aposticha, Resurrection sticheron, Tone 5
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE BLIND MAN AND FEAST OF THE ASCENSION
items.day_or_date: SIXTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE BLIND MAN
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Лицꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀ помо́лѧтся бога́тїи лю́дстїи. Ра́дꙋйсѧ Сн҃а Бж҃їѧ несказа́ннѡ заче́ншая Всенепоро́чнаѧ, и҆ сегѡ̀ ро́ждшая, пло́ть по на́мъ вои́стиннꙋ ѿ крове́й твои́хъ прїи́мшаго, дꙋ́шꙋ ᲂу҆́мнꙋю же и҆ самовла́стнꙋю и҆мꙋ́щаго, неѡб̾ѧ́днѡ же во А҆да́ма ѡ҆бле́кшагося, ми́лости ра́ди и҆ бл҃гости неизрече́нныѧ, ѿѻнꙋ́дꙋже во двою̀ є҆стествꙋ̀ на́мъ возвѣща́ется, ѻ҆бои́хъ пока́зꙋѧ въ себѣ̀ дѣ́йство, Хрїсто́съ: є҆гѡ́же молѝ, пою́щымъ тѧ̀ да́ти ве́лїю млⷭ҇ть.
items.english_text: Rejoice, Seal of the Prophets, proclamation of the divinely-speaking Apostles: for truly didst thou bear God existing in truth, incarnate for us beyond mind and word; whereby having regained our ancient nobility and attained paradise's sweetness, we honor thee with songs as the cause of such brightness: and being enriched by thee as an acceptable intercessor, O All-holy One, we partake of the ever-existing life of thy Son, Who richly grants great mercy.[^1154]

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, Seal of the Prophets, proclamation of the divinely-speaking Apostles: for truly didst thou bear God existing in truth, incarnate for us beyond mind and word; whereby having regained our ancient nobility and attained paradise's sweetness, we honor thee with songs as the cause of such brightness: and being enriched by thee as an acceptable intercessor, O All-holy One, we partake of the ever-existing life of thy Son, Who richly grants great mercy.[^1154]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ и҃: Пра́вды Со́лнце мы́сленное Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, и҆з̾ ᲂу҆тро́бы свѣ́та лишє́ннаго, твои́мъ пречи́стымъ прикоснове́нїемъ просвѣти́вшее ѻ҆́боюдꙋ, и҆ на́ша ѻ҆́чи дꙋше́вныѧ ѡ҆зари́вшее, сы́ны днѐ покажѝ, да вѣ́рою вопїе́мъ тѝ: мно́гое твоѐ и҆ неизрече́нное, є҆́же на на́съ бл҃гоꙋтро́бїе, Человѣколю́бче, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: *Verse: Hear, O daughter, and see, and incline thine ear.*[^1155]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: Hear, O daughter, and see, and incline thine ear.*[^1155]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ є҃: Хра́мъ и҆ Две́рь є҆сѝ, Пала́та и҆ Прⷭ҇то́лъ Цр҃евъ, Дѣ́во всечт҃на́ѧ: є҆́юже И҆зба́витель мо́й, Хрїсто́съ Гдⷭ҇ь, во тмѣ̀ спѧ́щымъ ꙗ҆ви́ся, Со́лнце сы́й пра́вды, просвѣти́ти хотѧ̀, ꙗ҆́же созда̀ по ѡ҆́бразꙋ своемꙋ̀ рꙋко́ю свое́ю, тѣ́мже Всепѣ́таѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃рне дерзнове́нїе къ немꙋ̀ стѧжа́вшая, непреста́ннѡ молѝ, спасти́ся дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: Rejoice, spiritual Heaven, in which God dwelt, having become incarnate; Jar of divine manna, Candlestick of the divine Sun, overshadowing Mountain, bridal chamber receptive of God, life-giving Table, golden Lampstand, light-bearing Paradise, unburnt Bush, Ark of holiness, heavenly Ladder, living Cloud, Rod from the root of Jesse blossomed forth, O Virgin: entreat Christ that great mercy may be given unto our souls![^1156]

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, spiritual Heaven, in which God dwelt, having become incarnate; Jar of divine manna, Candlestick of the divine Sun, overshadowing Mountain, bridal chamber receptive of God, life-giving Table, golden Lampstand, light-bearing Paradise, unburnt Bush, Ark of holiness, heavenly Ladder, living Cloud, Rod from the root of Jesse blossomed forth, O Virgin: entreat Christ that great mercy may be given unto our souls![^1156]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ про́чее ѻ҆бы́чнѡ.
items.english_text: *Verse: The rich among the people shall entreat thy face.*[^1157]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse: The rich among the people shall entreat thy face.*[^1157]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ про́чее ѻ҆бы́чнѡ.
items.english_text: Rejoice, O All-immaculate One, who didst ineffably conceive the Son of God and didst bear Him, Who truly received flesh like unto ours from thy blood, having a rational and volitional soul, and Who wrapped Himself without change in Adam, for the sake of His mercy and ineffable goodness; whence Christ is proclaimed unto us in two natures, showing forth in Himself the operation of both: Whom entreat to grant great mercy unto them that hymn thee![^1158]

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, O All-immaculate One, who didst ineffably conceive the Son of God and didst bear Him, Who truly received flesh like unto ours from thy blood, having a rational and volitional soul, and Who wrapped Himself without change in Adam, for the sake of His mercy and ineffable goodness; whence Christ is proclaimed unto us in two natures, showing forth in Himself the operation of both: Whom entreat to grant great mercy unto them that hymn thee![^1158]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ про́чее ѻ҆бы́чнѡ.
items.english_text: O Christ God, spiritual Sun of Righteousness, Who by Thy most pure touch didst enlighten both eyes of him who from the womb was deprived of light, and didst illumine our spiritual eyes: show us forth as sons of the day, that with faith we may cry unto Thee: Glory to Thee, O Lover of mankind, for Thy great and ineffable tender compassion toward us![^1159]

provenance.verbatim_source: O Christ God, spiritual Sun of Righteousness, Who by Thy most pure touch didst enlighten both eyes of him who from the womb was deprived of light, and didst illumine our spiritual eyes: show us forth as sons of the day, that with faith we may cry unto Thee: Glory to Thee, O Lover of mankind, for Thy great and ineffable tender compassion toward us![^1159]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ про́чее ѻ҆бы́чнѡ.
items.english_text: Thou art the Temple and the Door, the Palace and the Throne of the King, O all-honored Virgin: through whom my Redeemer, Christ the Lord, appeared unto those sleeping in darkness, being the Sun of Righteousness, desiring to enlighten those whom He fashioned according to His own image with His hand: therefore, O All-hymned One, having acquired maternal boldness toward Him, unceasingly pray that our souls may be saved.[^1160]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou art the Temple and the Door, the Palace and the Throne of the King, O all-honored Virgin: through whom my Redeemer, Christ the Lord, appeared unto those sleeping in darkness, being the Sun of Righteousness, desiring to enlighten those whom He fashioned according to His own image with His hand: therefore, O All-hymned One, having acquired maternal boldness toward Him, unceasingly pray that our souls may be saved.[^1160]

items.english_text: *We set 10 verses, and we sing 3 Resurrection stichera, 4 Eastern stichera, and 2 idiomela of the Blind Man, repeating the first.*[^1161]

items.slavonic_text: Поста́вимъ стїхѡ́въ і҃. И҆ пое́мъ стїхи̑ры воскрⷭ҇ны г҃: восто́чны, д҃, и҆ два̀ самогла̑сна ѡ҆ слѣпцѣ̀, повторѧ́юще є҆ди́нъ.
items.english_text: By Thy precious Cross, O Christ, Thou hast put the devil to shame, and by Thy Resurrection Thou hast blunted the sting of sin, and saved us from the gates of death: we glorify Thee, O Only-begotten One.[^1162]

provenance.verbatim_source: By Thy precious Cross, O Christ, Thou hast put the devil to shame, and by Thy Resurrection Thou hast blunted the sting of sin, and saved us from the gates of death: we glorify Thee, O Only-begotten One.[^1162]

items.slavonic_text: Стїхи̑ры воскрⷭ҇ны, гла́съ є҃:
items.english_text: Giving Resurrection unto the human race, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; the princes of hades were terrified of Him, and the gates of grief were lifted up: for Christ the King of glory entered, saying unto those in bonds: Come forth! and unto those in darkness: Show yourselves![^1163]

provenance.verbatim_source: Giving Resurrection unto the human race, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; the princes of hades were terrified of Him, and the gates of grief were lifted up: for Christ the King of glory entered, saying unto those in bonds: Come forth! and unto those in darkness: Show yourselves![^1163]

items.section: At the Aposticha, Resurrection sticheron, Tone 5
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE BLIND MAN AND FEAST OF THE ASCENSION
items.day_or_date: SIXTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE BLIND MAN
items.slavonic_text: Честны́мъ твои́мъ Крⷭ҇то́мъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, дїа́вола посрами́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ Воскресе́нїемъ твои́мъ жа́ло грѣхо́вное притꙋпи́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ спа́слъ є҆сѝ ны̀ ѿ вра́тъ сме́ртныхъ: сла́вимъ тѧ̀ Є҆диноро́дне.
items.english_text: A great wonder! The Creator of invisible things, having suffered in the flesh for love of mankind, arose immortal: come, families of the nations, let us worship Him; for having been delivered from deceit by His tender compassion, we have learned to sing of one God in three Hypostases.[^1164]

provenance.verbatim_source: A great wonder! The Creator of invisible things, having suffered in the flesh for love of mankind, arose immortal: come, families of the nations, let us worship Him; for having been delivered from deceit by His tender compassion, we have learned to sing of one God in three Hypostases.[^1164]

items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE BLIND MAN AND FEAST OF THE ASCENSION
items.day_or_date: SIXTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE BLIND MAN
items.slavonic_text: Ве́лїе чꙋ́до, неви́димыхъ Содѣ́тель, за человѣколю́бїе пло́тїю пострада́въ, воскре́се Безсме́ртный, прїиди́те ѻ҆те́чествїѧ ꙗ҆зы̑къ, томꙋ̀ поклони́мся: бл҃гоꙋтро́бїемъ бо є҆гѡ̀ ѿ пре́лести и҆зба́вльшеся, въ трїе́хъ ѵ҆поста́сѣхъ, є҆ди́наго Бг҃а пѣ́ти навыко́хомъ.
items.english_text: Evening worship do we offer unto Thee, the Unwaning Light, Who at the end of the ages didst shine forth in the flesh unto the world as in a mirror, and didst descend even unto hades, and didst dispel the darkness there, and didst show the light of the Resurrection unto the nations: O Lord and Giver of light, glory to Thee![^1165]

provenance.verbatim_source: Evening worship do we offer unto Thee, the Unwaning Light, Who at the end of the ages didst shine forth in the flesh unto the world as in a mirror, and didst descend even unto hades, and didst dispel the darkness there, and didst show the light of the Resurrection unto the nations: O Lord and Giver of light, glory to Thee![^1165]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стїхи̑ры А҆нато́лїєвы, гла́съ то́йже.
items.english_text: We glorify Christ, the Author of our salvation: for when He arose from the dead, the world was saved from deceit; the angelic choir rejoices, the deceit of demons flees, fallen Adam hath arisen, the devil is abolished.[^1166]

provenance.verbatim_source: We glorify Christ, the Author of our salvation: for when He arose from the dead, the world was saved from deceit; the angelic choir rejoices, the deceit of demons flees, fallen Adam hath arisen, the devil is abolished.[^1166]

items.office: AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: Other Eastern stichera, the same Tone
items.season_or_tone: SUNDAY OF THE BLIND MAN AND FEAST OF THE ASCENSION
items.day_or_date: SIXTH SUNDAY AFTER PASCHA, OF THE BLIND MAN
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнее поклоне́нїе прино́симъ тебѣ̀ невече́рнемꙋ Свѣ́тꙋ, на коне́цъ вѣкѡ́въ, ꙗ҆́кѡ въ зерца́лѣ пло́тїю возсїѧ́вшемꙋ мі́рови, и҆ да́же до а҆́да низше́дшемꙋ, и҆ та́мѡ сꙋ́щꙋю тмꙋ̀ разрꙋши́вшемꙋ, и҆ свѣ́тъ Воскрⷭ҇нїѧ ꙗ҆зы́кѡмъ показа́вшемꙋ: Свѣтода́вче Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: Those of the guard were instructed by the lawless ones: Conceal the Rising of Christ, and take pieces of silver, and say: While we were asleep, the dead man was stolen from the tomb. Who hath seen, who hath heard that a dead man was ever stolen, especially one anointed and naked, leaving his burial garments in the tomb? Be not deceived, O Jews: learn from the sayings of the Prophets, and understand that He is truly the Redeemer of the world and the Almighty![^1167]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стїхи̑ры самогла̑сны ѡ҆ слѣпо́мъ. Гла́съ в҃:
items.english_text: He that was born blind said unto his own thoughts: Was I born without eyes for the sins of my parents? Was I born as a reproof for the unbelief of the nations? I have no way to ask when it is night, when it is day; my feet cannot endure stumbling upon stones: for I have not seen the sun shining, nor Him in image Who fashioned me; but I pray Thee, O Christ God: Look upon me and have mercy on me!

items.english_text: Passing by from the sanctuary, Jesus found a man blind from birth, and having compassion, He placed clay upon his eyes, and said unto him: Go, wash in Siloam; and having washed, he received his sight, sending up glory unto God. And his neighbors said unto him: Who hath opened thine eyes, which no one among them that see was able to heal? And he, crying aloud, said: A man called Jesus, He said unto me: Wash in Siloam, and I received my sight. He is truly the One of Whom Moses spoke in the Law, Christ the Messiah: He is the Savior of our souls![^1170]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ є҃:
items.english_text: O Lord, passing by on the way, Thou didst find a man blind from birth: and the disciples being astonished, questioned Thee, saying: Teacher, who did sin, this man or his parents, that he was born blind? And Thou, my Savior, didst cry aloud unto them: Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents, but that the works of God should be made manifest in him; I must work the works of Him that sent Me, which no man can work. And having said these things, spitting on the ground and making clay, Thou didst anoint his eyes, saying unto him: Go, wash in the pool of Siloam. And he having washed was made whole, and cried unto Thee: I believe, Lord, and he worshipped Thee: therefore do we also cry: Have mercy on us![^1171]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: In the Red Sea of old an image of the Unwedded Bride was inscribed: there Moses was the parter of the water, and here Gabriel the minister of the wonder; then Israel walked dry-shod through the deep, and now the Virgin hath borne Christ without seed; the sea remained impassable after the passage of Israel, and the Immaculate One remained incorrupt after the birth of Emmanuel: O God Who art and Who wast before, Who hast appeared as man, have mercy on us![^1172]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ, гла́съ то́йже: При́зри на моле́нїѧ твои́хъ ра̑бъ, Всенепоро́чнаѧ, ᲂу҆толя́ющи лю̑таѧ на ны̀ воста̑нїѧ, всѧ́кїѧ ско́рби на́съ и҆змѣня́ющи: тѧ́ бо є҆ди́нꙋ, тве́рдое и҆ и҆звѣ́стное ᲂу҆твержде́нїе и҆́мамы, и҆ твоѐ предста́телство стѧжа́хомъ, да не постыди́мся Влⷣчце, тѧ̀ призыва́ющїи. Потщи́ся на ᲂу҆моле́нїе, тебѣ̀ вѣ́рнѡ вопїю́щихъ: ра́дꙋйся Влⷣчце, всѣ́хъ по́моще, ра́досте и҆ покро́ве, и҆ спасенїе дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: Considering his whole life to be night, the blind man cried unto Thee: O Lord, open mine eyes, O Son of David our Savior, that with all men I also may hymn Thy power![^1174]

provenance.verbatim_source: Considering his whole life to be night, the blind man cried unto Thee: O Lord, open mine eyes, O Son of David our Savior, that with all men I also may hymn Thy power![^1174]

items.slavonic_text: Та́же стїхи̑ры Па́сцѣ, съ припѣ́вы и҆́хъ, и҆щѝ въ Нд҃лю Па́схи на ᲂу҆́тренни: ли́стъ і҃є.
items.english_text: Look upon the supplications of Thy servants, O All-immaculate One, assuaging the fierce uprisings against us, releasing us from every affliction: for thee alone do we possess as a firm and sure foundation, and we have acquired thy patronage, that we who call upon thee may not be put to shame, O Lady. Hasten to the supplication of them that cry unto thee in faith: Rejoice, O Sovereign Lady, help of all, joy and protection, and salvation of our souls![^1175]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ и҃: Пра́вды Со́лнце мы́сленное Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, и҆з̾ ᲂу҆тро́бы свѣ́та лишє́ннаго, твои́мъ пречт҃ымъ прикоснове́нїемъ просвѣти́въ ѻ҆́боюдꙋ, и҆ на́ша ѻ҆́чи дꙋше́вныѧ ѡ҆зари́вшее, сы́ны днѐ покажѝ,
items.english_text: Thee, Christ the incarnate Savior, Who didst not part from heaven, we magnify with voices of song: for Thou didst accept the Cross and death for our race, as the Lord Lover of mankind; and having overthrown the gates of hades, Thou didst rise on the third day, saving our souls.[^1176]

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ра́дꙋйся Две́ре Гдⷭ҇нѧ непроходи́маѧ, ра́дꙋйся Стѣно̀ и҆ Покро́ве притека́ющихъ къ тебѣ̀, ра́дꙋйся неѡбрека́емое Приста́нище, и҆ Неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ, ро́ждшаѧ пло́тїю Творца̀ твоего̀ и҆ Бг҃а: моля́щи не ѡ҆скꙋдѣва́й ѡ҆ воспѣва́ющихъ, и҆ кла́нѧющихсѧ Рождествꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀.
items.english_text: Let us, the faithful, praise and worship the Word, co-unoriginate with the Father and the Spirit, born of the Virgin for our salvation: for He was pleased of His own will to ascend the Cross in the flesh, and to endure death, and to raise up the dead by His glorious Resurrection.[^1181]

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, impassable Gate of the Lord; rejoice, Rampart and Shelter of those who flee unto thee; rejoice, tempest-free Haven, and Unwedded One, who didst bear in the flesh thy Creator and God: cease not to pray for those that hymn and worship thy Birth-giving.[^1182]

items.english_text: Let us praise the Cross of the Lord, let us honor His holy Burial with songs, and let us exceedingly glorify His Resurrection: for as God He raised the dead together with Himself from the tombs, having led captive the dominion of death and the strength of the devil: and light shone forth upon those in hades.[^1184]

items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и, посредѣ́ тѧ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нныхъ пригвозди́ша беззако́ннїи, и҆ копїе́мъ Ребро̀ твоѐ прободо́ша, Ѽ Ми́лостиве! Погребе́нїе же прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, разрꙋши́въ а҆́дѡва врата̀, и҆ воскрⷭ҇лъ є҆сѝ тридне́внѡ: притеко́ша жєны̀ ви́дѣти тѧ̀, и҆ возвѣсти́ша А҆пⷭ҇лѡмъ Воста́нїе: превозноси́мый Сп҃се, є҆го́же пою́тъ А҆́гг҃ли, бл҃гослове́нный Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.

Погребе́нїе же прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, разрꙋши́въ а҆́дѡва врата̀, и҆ воскрⷭ҇лъ є҆сѝ тридне́внѡ: притеко́ша жєны̀ ви́дѣти тѧ̀, и҆ возвѣсти́ша А҆пⷭ҇лѡмъ Воста́нїе: превозноси́мый Сп҃се, є҆го́же пою́тъ А҆́гг҃ли, бл҃гослове́нный Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: Rejoice, holy Mountain and God-trodden; rejoice, living and unburnt Bush; rejoice, only Bridge to God for the world, leading mortals unto eternal life; rejoice, incorruptible Maiden, who without knowing man didst bear the Salvation of our souls.[^1187]

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, holy Mountain and God-trodden; rejoice, living and unburnt Bush; rejoice, only Bridge to God for the world, leading mortals unto eternal life; rejoice, incorruptible Maiden, who without knowing man didst bear the Salvation of our souls.[^1187]

items.english_text: O Lord, the lawless ones nailed Thee in the midst of the condemned, and pierced Thy side with a spear, O Merciful One! And Thou didst accept burial, having shattered the gates of hades, and didst rise on the third day: the women ran to see Thee, and announced the Rising unto the Apostles: O exceedingly exalted Savior, Whom the Angels hymn, O blessed Lord, glory to Thee![^1188]

items.english_text: Thy marvelous mystery, O my Savior, became salvation unto the world: for having risen from the tomb in a manner befitting God, Thou didst raise up the corrupted together with Thyself as God, O Life of all, Lord, glory to Thee![^1190]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: Неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ Мт҃и, Бг҃ороди́тельнице Чⷭ҇таѧ, Є҆́vинꙋ печа́ль ѡ҆ра́довавшаѧ, воспѣва́емъ вѣ́рнїи, и҆ покланя́емся тебѣ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ возвела̀ є҆сѝ на́съ ѿ дре́внїѧ клѧ́твы: и҆ ны́нѣ молѝ непреста́ннѡ, всепѣ́таѧ Прест҃а́ѧ, ко є҆́же спасти́ся на́мъ.
items.english_text: O unwedded Mother, Pure Parent of God, who didst gladden Eve's sorrow with joy: we, the faithful, hymn and worship thee, for thou hast raised us up from the ancient curse; and now pray unceasingly, O all-hymned and Most Holy One, that we may be saved.[^1191]

provenance.verbatim_source: O unwedded Mother, Pure Parent of God, who didst gladden Eve's sorrow with joy: we, the faithful, hymn and worship thee, for thou hast raised us up from the ancient curse; and now pray unceasingly, O all-hymned and Most Holy One, that we may be saved.[^1191]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ а҆́бїе степе́нна, гла́съ є҃. А҆нтїфѡ́нъ а҃: Внегда̀ скорбѣ́ти мнѣ̀, Дв҃дски пою̀ тебѣ̀ Сп҃се мо́й: и҆зба́ви дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ ѿ ꙗ҆зы́ка льсти́вагѡ. Пꙋсты́ннымъ живо́тъ бл҃же́нъ є҆́сть, Бж҃твеннымъ раче́нїемъ воскрила́ющымсѧ. Сла́ва: Ст҃ы́мъ Дх҃омъ, ѡ҆держа́тся всѧ̑ ви́димаѧ же съ неви́димыми, самодержа́венъ бо сы́й, Трⷪ҇цы Є҆ди́нъ є҆́сть нело́жнѡ. И҆ ны́нѣ, то́йже.
items.english_text: The Myrrh-bearing women, perplexed in mind by the angelic vision, yet enlightened in soul by the divine Rising, brought the glad tidings unto the Apostles: Proclaim the Resurrection among the nations, the Lord working together with wonders, granting great mercy unto us.[^1194]

provenance.verbatim_source: The Myrrh-bearing women, perplexed in mind by the angelic vision, yet enlightened in soul by the divine Rising, brought the glad tidings unto the Apostles: Proclaim the Resurrection among the nations, the Lord working together with wonders, granting great mercy unto us.[^1194]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, Трⷪ҇ченъ: Є҆ди́но трїѵпоста́сное Сꙋщество̀ почита́юще вѣ́рнїи, просла́вимъ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀, и҆ Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а пра́ваго, Творца̀ и҆ Гдⷭ҇а и҆ И҆зба́вителѧ всѣ́хъ, є҆ди́наго несозда́ннаго Бг҃а, со безпло́тными взыва́юще: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ Цр҃ю̀.
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* The land whereon the sun never shone nor saw at any time, the deep which the bare breadth of heaven never saw, Israel passed dry-shod, O Lord; and Thou didst bring him into the mountain of Thy holiness, as he praised and sang a song of victory.[^1206]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: Во ᲂу҆тро́бꙋ неискꙋсобра́чнꙋю твою̀ всели́ся, Чⷭ҇таѧ, Гдⷭ҇ь, за милосе́рдїе щедро́тъ, спастѝ хотя̀ человѣ́ка и҆стлѣ́вшаго ко́зньми вра́жїими: того̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ молѝ, гра́дъ се́й спастѝ, ѿ всѧ́кагѡ плѣне́нїѧ, и҆ врагѡ́въ наше́ствїѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having accepted voluntary crucifixion in the flesh, O Savior, Thou didst pour forth blessing and life unto the world, O Master, only All-blessed One and Creator of all: therefore do we bless Thee, singing and glorifying, chanting and singing a song of victory.[^1207]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*  
Having accepted voluntary crucifixion in the flesh, O Savior, Thou didst pour forth blessing and life unto the world, O Master, only All-blessed One and Creator of all: therefore do we bless Thee, singing and glorifying, chanting and singing a song of victory.[^1207]

items.slavonic_text: Спаси́телю Бг҃ꙋ, въ мо́ри лю́ди немо́крыми нога́ми наста́вльшемꙋ, и҆ Фараѡ́на со всево́инствомъ пото́пльшемꙋ, томꙋ̀ є҆ди́номꙋ пои́мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst establish wavering hearts, O Long-suffering One, having shaken all the earth by Thy precious Crucifixion, which Thou didst endure in the flesh.[^1215]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Дви́жимое се́рдце моѐ Гд᷂ⷭи, волна́ми жите́йскими, оу҆твердѝ, ко приста́нище ти́хое наставлѧ́ѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Why seek ye the Lord as dead? He is risen, as He said! the Angel cried unto the women, shining with divine countenance.[^1217]

items.slavonic_text: Коле́блющыхсѧ сердца̀ оу҆тверди́лъ є҆сѝ, зе́млю всю̀ поколеба́въ Долготерпѣли́ве, ч᷂ⷭтны́мъ Распѧ́тїемъ твои́мъ, є҆́же претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ пло́тїю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The man who was of old blind from birth, when he drew near unto Thee, Thou didst heal, O All-compassionate One, as he glorified Thy dispensation and Thy wonders.[^1218]

items.slavonic_text: Что̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ме́ртва и҆́щете Гд᷂ⷭа; воскр҃се ꙗ҆́коже речѐ, А҆́гг҃лъ жена́мъ вѣща́ше, блиста́ѧсѧ бж҃е́ственными зра́комъ.
items.english_text: We worship God the Father, Who is before all beginning, and the Son, and the divine Spirit, the thrice-uncreated Essence, tri-hypostatic, the one God of all.[^1219]

items.slavonic_text: Катава́сіа:
items.english_text: Passing by, the Master and Creator of the ages found sitting upon the way a blind man, who wept and said: In my life I never saw the sun shining, nor the light of the moon giving radiance; therefore do I cry unto Thee: O Thou Who wast born of the Virgin and dost enlighten all things, enlighten me, as Thou art compassionate, that falling down before Thee, I may cry unto Thee, O Master, Christ God: Grant remission of transgressions unto us, for the multitude of Thy mercy, O Lover of mankind![^1223]

provenance.verbatim_source: Passing by, the Master and Creator of the ages found sitting upon the way a blind man, who wept and said: In my life I never saw the sun shining, nor the light of the moon giving radiance; therefore do I cry unto Thee: O Thou Who wast born of the Virgin and dost enlighten all things, enlighten me, as Thou art compassionate, that falling down before Thee, I may cry unto Thee, O Master, Christ God: Grant remission of transgressions unto us, for the multitude of Thy mercy, O Lover of mankind![^1223]

items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and for ever and unto ages of ages. Amen. The same.*[^1224]

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst ascend upon the Tree, O Compassionate One, and didst lift up all men together with Thyself; and Thou didst slay the contending serpent, and didst make alive the creation of Thy hands, as the only God of all.[^1235]

items.slavonic_text: Возне́слсѧ є҆сѝ на дре́во, Ще́дре, и҆ совозне́слъ є҆сѝ всѧ̑ человѣ́ки, и҆ бори́телѧ ѕмї́а оу҆мертви́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ ѡ҆живи́лъ є҆сѝ созда́нїе рꙋкꙋ̀ твое́ю, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ Бг҃ъ всѣ́хъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having opened the eyes of him who had not seen sensible light, Thou didst enlighten the pupils of his soul, and didst cause him to glorify Thee, having recognized Thee as the Creator Who didst appear as man for compassion's sake.[^1238]

items.slavonic_text: Чꙋдеса̀ ве́лїѧ содѣ́ловающаго, Сло́ве, на землѝ, лю́дїе оу҆би́ша тѧ̀ беззако́ннїи: но са́мъ Гд᷂ⷭи, є҆ди́нъ всеси́ленъ сы́й, ꙗ҆́коже предре́клъ є҆сѝ, и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ воскр҃слъ є҆сѝ Хр᷂ⷭтѐ.

items.english_text: How didst thou give birth, O woman full of the grace of God, pure Virgin-Mother, having known no trial of man? How dost thou nourish Him Who nourishes all creation? As He alone knows Himself, the Creator and God of all.[^1240]
