items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of All Saints:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва:
items.english_text: Let us go up with the disciples into the mountain of Galilee, in faith to behold Christ, speaking that He hath received authority over the heights and the depths; let us learn how He teaches to baptize all nations in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, and to abide with the initiates of the mysteries, as He promised, unto the consummation of the age.[^2792]

provenance.verbatim_source: Let us go up with the disciples into the mountain of Galilee, in faith to behold Christ, speaking that He hath received authority over the heights and the depths; let us learn how He teaches to baptize all nations in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, and to abide with the initiates of the mysteries, as He promised, unto the consummation of the age.[^2792]

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of All Saints:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́трѡ | х҃аі
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion of All Saints, Podoben: "Give ear, ye women" (Жены̀ оу҆слы́шите):*[^2793][^2794] The Baptist and Forerunner, the Apostles, Prophets, Martyrs, Hierarchs, Ascetics, and Venerable ones, Hieromartyrs, together with God-loving Women, and all the Righteous, and the ranks of Angels, let us duly bless in hymns, praying to obtain their glory from Christ the Savior.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Exapostilarion of All Saints, Podoben: "Give ear, ye women" (Жены̀ оу҆слы́шите):*[^2793][^2794]
The Baptist and Forerunner, the Apostles, Prophets, Martyrs, Hierarchs, Ascetics, and Venerable ones, Hieromartyrs, together with God-loving Women, and all the Righteous, and the ranks of Angels, let us duly bless in hymns, praying to obtain their glory from Christ the Savior.

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of All Saints:
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆́же горѣ̀ Прославля́емый, бж҃е́ственнѣ ѿ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ Ѻ҆́чїихъ, Пречⷭ҇таѧ, не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́ннѡ, съ до́лними поживѐ: ты́ же сегѡ̀ была̀ є҆сѝ сп҃се́нїѧ хода́таица, ѿ чи́стыхъ твои́хъ крове́й семꙋ̀, Чⷭ҇таѧ, па́че сло́ва пло́ть заимода́вши: є҆го́же молѝ рабѡ́мъ твои̑мъ и҆збавле́нїе да́ти прегрѣше́нїй.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who is glorified on high divinely by the Angels, without departing from the Father's bosom, O Most Pure One, lived ineffably with those below; and thou wast the mediatress of His salvation, having lent flesh beyond speech unto Him from thy pure blood, O Pure One: Whom do thou beseech to grant remission of transgressions unto thy servants.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
He Who is glorified on high divinely by the Angels, without departing from the Father's bosom, O Most Pure One, lived ineffably with those below; and thou wast the mediatress of His salvation, having lent flesh beyond speech unto Him from thy pure blood, O Pure One: Whom do thou beseech to grant remission of transgressions unto thy servants.

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of All Saints:
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и, а҆́ще и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ ме́ртва во гро́бѣ І҆ꙋде́и тѧ̀ положи́ша: но ꙗ҆́кѡ Цр҃ѧ̀ спѧ́ща во́ини тѧ̀ стрежа́хꙋ, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ живота̀ сокро́вище, печа́тїю печа́таша: но воскре́слъ є҆сѝ, и҆ по́далъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: O Lord, although Thou didst stand before the judgment seat, judged by Pilate, yet Thou didst not withdraw from Thy throne, sitting together with the Father; and having risen from the dead, Thou hast freed the world from the servitude of the stranger, as Thou art compassionate and the Lover of mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lord, although Thou didst stand before the judgment seat, judged by Pilate, yet Thou didst not withdraw from Thy throne, sitting together with the Father; and having risen from the dead, Thou hast freed the world from the servitude of the stranger, as Thou art compassionate and the Lover of mankind.

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of All Saints:
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и, ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе на дїа́вола Крⷭ҇тъ тво́й да́лъ є҆сѝ на́мъ: трепе́щетъ бо и҆ трѧсе́тся, не терпѧ̀ взира́ти на си́лꙋ є҆гѡ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ ме́ртвыѧ возставля́етъ, и҆ сме́рть оу҆празднѝ: сегѡ́ ра́ди покланя́емся Погребе́нїю твоемꙋ̀ и҆ Воста́нїю.
items.english_text: O Lord, although the Judeans laid Thee in the tomb as dead, yet the soldiers watched Thee as a sleeping King, and as a treasure of life they sealed Thee with a seal: but Thou didst rise, and didst grant incorruption unto our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lord, although the Judeans laid Thee in the tomb as dead, yet the soldiers watched Thee as a sleeping King, and as a treasure of life they sealed Thee with a seal: but Thou didst rise, and didst grant incorruption unto our souls.

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of All Saints:
items.slavonic_text: А҆́гг҃лъ тво́й Гдⷭ҇и, Воскресе́нїе проповѣ́давый, стра́жи оу҆́бѡ оу҆страшѝ, жена́мъ же возгласѝ глаго́лѧ: что̀ и҆́щете Жива́гѡ съ ме́ртвыми; воскре́се Бг҃ъ сы́й, и҆ вселе́ннѣй жи́знь дарова̀.
items.english_text: O Lord, a weapon against the devil hast Thou given unto us, Thy Cross: for he trembles and shakes, not enduring to look upon its power, for it raises the dead, and hath destroyed death: on this account we worship Thy Burial and Thy Rising.

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lord, a weapon against the devil hast Thou given unto us, Thy Cross: for he trembles and shakes, not enduring to look upon its power, for it raises the dead, and hath destroyed death: on this account we worship Thy Burial and Thy Rising.

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of All Saints:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́на стїхи́ра восто́чнаѧ, тогѡ́же гла́са: Пострада́лъ є҆сѝ Крⷭ҇то́мъ, безстра́стный Бж҃ество́мъ, Погребе́нїе прїя́лъ є҆сѝ тридне́вное, да на́съ свободи́ши ѿ рабо́ты вра́жїѧ, и҆ ѡ҆безсме́ртивъ ѡ҆животвори́ши на́съ, Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, Воскресе́нїемъ твои́мъ, Чл҃вѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Thine Angel, O Lord, having proclaimed the Resurrection, struck terror into the guards, and cried unto the women, saying: Why seek ye the Living among the dead? Risen is He Who is God, and He hath granted life unto the universe.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thine Angel, O Lord, having proclaimed the Resurrection, struck terror into the guards, and cried unto the women, saying: Why seek ye the Living among the dead? Risen is He Who is God, and He hath granted life unto the universe.

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of All Saints:
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Воззва́ша пра́веднїи, и҆ Гдⷭ҇ь оу҆слы́ша и҆́хъ. Съ Прⷪ҇ро́ки А҆́пⷭ҇ли, съ Прпⷣбными Оу҆чи́телїе, со Сщ҃енномч҃нки всѝ Пра́веднїи, и҆ Же́нъ пострада́вшее, и҆ любо́вїю пости́вшееся Ст҃ы́хъ мно́жество, и҆ пра́ведныхъ чи́нове, да восхва́лѧтся сщ҃е́нными пѣ́сньми, ꙗ҆́кѡ го́рнягѡ Црⷭ҇твїѧ наслѣ́дницы, ꙗ҆́кѡ раѧ̀ жи́телїе.
items.english_text: Thou didst suffer through the Cross, being impassible in Thy Godhead; Thou didst accept a three-day Burial, that Thou mightest free us from the servitude of the enemy, and having made us immortal, mightest quicken us, O Christ God, by Thy Resurrection, O Lover of mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst suffer through the Cross, being impassible in Thy Godhead; Thou didst accept a three-day Burial, that Thou mightest free us from the servitude of the enemy, and having made us immortal, mightest quicken us, O Christ God, by Thy Resurrection, O Lover of mankind.

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of All Saints:
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: The Lord hath made marvelous the Saints who are upon the earth: for they received His wounds and sufferings in the flesh, glorying in these, and manifestly adorned with divine adornments: whom let us hymn as unfading blossoms, as unerring stars of the Church, as voluntary whole-burnt offerings.

provenance.verbatim_source: The Lord hath made marvelous the Saints who are upon the earth: for they received His wounds and sufferings in the flesh, glorying in these, and manifestly adorned with divine adornments: whom let us hymn as unfading blossoms, as unerring stars of the Church, as voluntary whole-burnt offerings.

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of All Saints:
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: With the Prophets, let the Apostles; with the Venerable ones, the Teachers; with the Hieromartyrs, all the Righteous, and the multitude of holy Women who suffered and fasted in love, and the ranks of the righteous, be praised in sacred hymns, as heirs of the heavenly Kingdom, as dwellers of Paradise!

provenance.verbatim_source: With the Prophets, let the Apostles; with the Venerable ones, the Teachers; with the Hieromartyrs, all the Righteous, and the multitude of holy Women who suffered and fasted in love, and the ranks of the righteous, be praised in sacred hymns, as heirs of the heavenly Kingdom, as dwellers of Paradise!

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of All Saints:
items.slavonic_text: х҃в | Въ Недѣ́лю всѣ́хъ Ст҃ы́хъ
items.english_text: Those who heavenized the earth with the brightness of virtues, who imitated the death of Christ, who walked the path that mediats immortality, who cleansed the passions of men by the operation of grace, who throughout the whole world valiantly contended with one soul, let the Martyrs be praised![^2796]

provenance.verbatim_source: Those who heavenized the earth with the brightness of virtues, who imitated the death of Christ, who walked the path that mediats immortality, who cleansed the passions of men by the operation of grace, who throughout the whole world valiantly contended with one soul, let the Martyrs be praised![^2796]

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of All Saints:
items.slavonic_text: Славосло́вїе вели́кое. По трист҃о́мъ тропа́рь воскрⷭ҇нъ то́чїю, є҆ктенїѝ. И҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ, и҆ ча́съ пе́рвый въ притво́рѣ. И҆ поꙋче́нїе Стꙋди́тово. И҆ соверше́нный ѿпꙋ́стъ.
items.english_text: Unto the disciples going into the mountain for the earthly Ascension, the Lord presented Himself; and having worshiped Him, and having learned of the authority given everywhere, they are sent forth beneath heaven to proclaim the Resurrection from the dead and the Ascension into heaven: with whom Christ, the God and Savior of our souls, promised without deceit to abide unto the ages.[^2797]

provenance.verbatim_source: Unto the disciples going into the mountain for the earthly Ascension, the Lord presented Himself; and having worshiped Him, and having learned of the authority given everywhere, they are sent forth beneath heaven to proclaim the Resurrection from the dead and the Ascension into heaven: with whom Christ, the God and Savior of our souls, promised without deceit to abide unto the ages.[^2797]

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Прокі́менъ А҆пⷭ҇ла, гла́съ и҃: Помоли́теся, и҆ воздади́те Гдⷭ҇ви Бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ. Стї́хъ: Вѣ́домъ во І҆ꙋде́и Бг҃ъ, во І҆и҃ли ве́лїе и҆́мѧ є҆гѡ̀. И҆ Ст҃ы̑мъ, гла́съ д҃: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Tone, on 4.*[^2798]

provenance.verbatim_source: *At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Tone, on 4.*[^2798]

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: А҆́пⷭ҇лъ ко Є҆вре́ѡмъ, зача́ло т҃л. Ст҃і́и всѝ: А҆ллилꙋ́їа, гла́съ д҃: Воззва́ша пра́веднїи, и҆ Гдⷭ҇ь оу҆слы́ша и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Tree, and vouchsafe all, O only Compassionate One, Thy heavenly Kingdom.

provenance.verbatim_source: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Tree, and vouchsafe all, O only Compassionate One, Thy heavenly Kingdom.

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: А҆́пⷭ҇лъ ко Є҆вре́ѡмъ, зача́ло т҃л. Ст҃і́и всѝ: А҆ллилꙋ́їа, гла́съ д҃: Воззва́ша пра́веднїи, и҆ Гдⷭ҇ь оу҆слы́ша и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: Nailed upon the Tree of Thy will, O our Savior, by the Tree Thou didst deliver Adam from the curse, restoring, as Thou art compassionate, that which was after Thine image, and the dwelling of Paradise.

provenance.verbatim_source: Nailed upon the Tree of Thy will, O our Savior, by the Tree Thou didst deliver Adam from the curse, restoring, as Thou art compassionate, that which was after Thine image, and the dwelling of Paradise.

items.office: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: А҆́пⷭ҇лъ ко Є҆вре́ѡмъ, зача́ло т҃л. Ст҃і́и всѝ: А҆ллилꙋ́їа, гла́съ д҃: Воззва́ша пра́веднїи, и҆ Гдⷭ҇ь оу҆слы́ша и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: Give ear, Adam, and rejoice with Eve, for he that anciently stripped you both, and took you all captive through deception, hath been brought to naught by the Cross of Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source: Give ear, Adam, and rejoice with Eve, for he that anciently stripped you both, and took you all captive through deception, hath been brought to naught by the Cross of Christ.

items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ ѕ҃. Вели́кое та́инство твоегѡ̀ Вочеловѣ́ченїѧ, на Ве́чери возлежáщꙋ тебѣ̀ Та́инникѡмъ, Человѣколю́бче, ѡ҆кры́въ, ре́клъ є҆сѝ: ꙗ҆ди́те Хлѣ́бъ живо́тный, сїѐ є҆́сть Тѣ́ло моѐ: и҆ пі́йте Кро́вь нетлѣ́нныѧ жи́зни. Два́жды.
items.english_text: Revealing the great mystery of Thy Dispensation in the flesh, while reclining at the Supper with the initiates of Thy mysteries, O Lover of mankind, Thou didst say: Eat ye the Bread of life, this is My Body; and drink ye the Blood of incorruptible life. *(Twice)*[^2806]

items.slavonic_text: Напита̀ Гдⷭ҇ь Оу҆ченикѝ своѧ̑ бра́шномъ небе́снымъ, пре́жде Стра́сти да́стъ и҆̀мъ Хлѣ́бъ А҆́гг҃льскїй, па́че ма́нны преди́вный: ѻ҆тцы̀ ва́ши, (речѐ Гдⷭ҇ь) ꙗ҆до́ша ма́ннꙋ въ пꙋсты́ни и҆ оу҆мро́ша, се́й є҆́сть Хлѣ́бъ сходѧ́й съ нб҃сѐ, а҆́ще кто̀ ѿ негѡ̀ ꙗ҆́стъ, не оу҆́мретъ, но жи́въ бꙋ́детъ во вѣ́ки, є҆гѡ́же и҆ на́съ ны́нѣ сподо́би причасти́тися, моли́твы ра́ди твоеѧ̀ Бг҃ома́тере. Два́жды.
items.english_text: The Lord nourished His Disciples with heavenly food; before His Passion He gave them Angelic Bread, marvelous beyond manna: Your fathers, (saith the Lord) did eat manna in the wilderness, and died; this is the Bread which comes down from heaven, that if any man eat thereof, he shall not die, but shall live for ever: of which do Thou now vouchsafe us also to partake, for the sake of the supplications of Thy Mother of God. *(Twice)*[^2807]

items.english_text: Come, ye faithful lovers of the feasts, let us clap our hands today at the salvation-bearing feast for the world, of the Bread of life and the Lamb of God, Who takes away the sins of the world and our transgressions, not in the old leaven of malice...[^2808] of malice, but in the unleavened bread of purity and truth; having purified ourselves, therefore, let us worthily partake of Him, that we may obtain His eternal Kingdom.[^2809]

items.slavonic_text: Ѿ Црⷭ҇твъ книгъ пе́рвыхъ чте́нїе. Глава̀ к҃а. Во дни̑ ѻ҆́ны, прїи́де Дв҃дъ въ цр҃ковь къ А҆хїмеле́хꙋ І҆ере́ю, и҆ оу҆жасе́ся А҆хїмеле́хъ ѡ҆ прише́ствїи є҆гѡ̀. И҆ речѐ є҆мꙋ̀: что̀ сѐ ты̀ є҆ди́нъ є҆сѝ, и҆ нѣ́сть никто́же съ тобо́ю; И҆ речѐ Дв҃дъ І҆ере́еви: Цр҃ь заповѣ́да мѝ глаго́лъ дне́сь, и҆ речѐ ко мнѣ̀: никто́же да оу҆разꙋмѣ́етъ глаго́ла є҆гѡ́же ра́ди а҆́зъ посыла́ю тѧ̀, и҆ ѡ҆ не́мже а҆́зъ заповѣ́даю тѝ. И҆ ѻ҆́троки ѡ҆ста́вихъ, на мѣ́стѣ глаго́лемомъ Є҆лмаўні́емъ. И҆ ны́нѣ а҆́ще сꙋ́ть оу҆ тебѐ пя́ть хлѣ́бы, да́ждь мѝ є҆ли́кѡ и҆́маши. И҆ ѿвѣща̀ І҆ере́й Даві́дови, и҆ речѐ: не сꙋ́ть хлѣ́бы прѡ́сти оу҆ менѐ, но то́чїю хлѣ́бы оу҆ менѐ ст҃і́еннїи, храни́ми тѣ́лѡмъ, и҆́же чи́сти сꙋ́ть ѿ же́нъ, и҆ ті́и ꙗ҆да́тъ я҆̀. И҆ ѿвѣща̀ Даві́дъ І҆ере́еви, и҆ речѐ: и҆ мы̀ ѿ же́нъ воздержа́хомся вчера̀ и҆ тре́тїѧгѡ днѐ: ѿне́лѣже и҆зыдо́хъ а҆́зъ на пꙋ́ть, бы́ша всѝ ѻ҆́троцы ѡ҆чище́ни, и҆ се́й пꙋ́ть нечи́стъ, но ѡ҆свѧти́тися дне́сь сосꙋ́дъ ра́ди мои́хъ. И҆ дадѐ є҆мꙋ̀ І҆ере́й А҆хїмеле́хъ хлѣ́бы предложе́нїѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ не бѣ̀ та́мѡ и҆на́гѡ хлѣ́ба: ті́и бо бѣ́хꙋ є҆ди́ни хлѣ́бы принесе́нни, и҆́хже взѧ́ша пред̾ лице́мъ Гдⷭ҇нимъ, и҆ то́й да́стъ я҆̀ є҆мꙋ̀ въ то́й де́нь.

items.slavonic_text: Ѿ тре́тїихъ книгъ Црⷭ҇кихъ чте́нїе. Глава̀ з҃і. Бы́сть сло́во Гдⷭ҇не къ И҆лїѝ, глаго́лѧ: и҆дѝ ѿсю́дꙋ на восто́къ, и҆ скры́йся въ пото́цѣ Хора́ѳъ, пра́мѡ лицꙋ̀ І҆ѻрда́новꙋ. И҆ бꙋ́деши пи́ти ѿ пото́ка во́дꙋ: и҆ вра́номъ заповѣ́дахъ препита́ти тѧ̀ та́мѡ. И҆ сотворѝ И҆лїа̀ по глаго́лꙋ Гдⷭ҇ню, и҆ сѣ́де при пото́цѣ Хора́ѳъ, пра́мѡ лицꙋ̀ І҆ѻрда́на. И҆ вра́нове приноша́хꙋ є҆мꙋ̀ хлѣ́бы заꙋ́тра, и҆ мя́со къ ве́черꙋ, и҆ ѿ пото́ка пїя́ше во́дꙋ. И҆ бы́сть по дне́хъ и҆ и҆́зсше пото́къ, ꙗ҆́кѡ не бы́сть до́ждь на землѝ. И҆ бы́сть глаго́лъ Гдⷭ҇нь ко И҆лїѝ, глаго́лѧ: воста́ни, и҆ и҆дѝ въ Саре́птꙋ Сїдѡ́нскꙋю, и҆ пребꙋ́ди та́мѡ: сѐ бо заповѣ́дахъ женѣ̀ вдови́цѣ препита́ти тѧ̀. И҆ воста́въ
items.english_text: The Lord said unto Moses: Go down, testify unto this people, and purify them today and tomorrow; and let them wash their garments. And let them be ready against the third day; for on the third day the Lord will come down upon Mount Sinai before all the people. And thou shalt set bounds for the people round about, saying: Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mountain, nor touch anything thereof. Whoever touches the mountain shall surely die. No hand shall touch it, for he shall be stoned with stones, or shot through with a dart; whether it be man or beast, he shall not live. When the voices and the trumpets and the cloud depart from the mountain, they shall go up into the mountain. And Moses went down from the mountain unto the people, and sanctified them, and they washed their garments. And he said unto the people: Be ready; for three days come not near a woman. And it came to pass on the third day, when morning came, there were voices and lightnings, and dark clouds upon Mount Sinai, and the voice of a trumpet sounding loudly; and all the people that were in the camp were afraid. And Moses led the people forth out of the camp to meet God, and they stood before Mount Sinai. And Mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because God descended upon it in fire. And the smoke went up as the smoke of a furnace, and all the people were exceedingly amazed. And the voices of the trumpet sounded exceedingly strong. Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

items.english_text: In those days, David came into the church unto Ahimelech the priest, and Ahimelech was amazed at his coming. And he said unto him: Why art thou thus alone, and there is no man with thee? And David said unto the priest: The king commanded me a matter today, and said unto me: Let no man know the matter for which I send thee, and concerning which I have charged thee. And I have left the young men in the place called Elmaun. And now, if there be under thy hand five loaves of bread, give me whatsoever thou hast. And the priest answered David, and said: There is no common bread under my hand, but only holy bread is under my hand, kept in the body, of those who are clean from women; and these may eat them. And David answered the priest, and said: Truly we have kept ourselves from women yesterday and the third day; since I came forth on the way, all the young men were purified, and though this way is unclean, yet it will be sanctified today for the sake of my vessels. And Ahimelech the priest gave him the Showbread, for there was no other bread there; for those were the only loaves of presentation that had been taken from before the face of the Lord, and he gave them unto David on that day.

items.english_text: The word of the Lord came unto Elijah, saying: Depart hence toward the east, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before the face of the Jordan. And it shall be that thou shalt drink water of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there. And Elijah did according to the word of the Lord, and sat down by the brook Cherith, before the face of the Jordan. And the ravens brought him bread in the morning, and flesh in the evening; and he drank water of the brook. And it came to pass after a while that the brook dried up, because there was no rain upon the earth. And the word of the Lord came unto Elijah, saying: Arise, and go to Zarephath of Sidon, and abide there; for behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee. And he arose and went to Zarephath to the gate of the city; and behold, a widow woman was there gathering sticks; and Elijah called unto her from behind, and said unto her: Bring me now a little water in a vessel, that I may drink. And as she went to take it, Elijah cried after her, and said: Bring me now also a morsel of bread in thine hand. And the woman said: As the Lord my God lives, if there is anything in my storehouse, but only a handful of meal in a jar, and a little oil in a cruse: and behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and prepare it for me and my children, that we may eat it, and die. And Elijah said unto her: Fear not, go in and do according to thy word; but make me thereof a little unleavened cake first, and bring it unto me; and afterward make for thee and thy children. For thus saith the Lord God of Israel: The jar of meal shall not fail, and the cruse of oil shall not diminish, until the day that the Lord God gives rain upon the face of all the earth. And the woman went and did according to the word of Elijah, and gave unto him, and ate herself, and her children. And from that day the jar of meal failed not, and the cruse of oil did not diminish, according to the word of the Lord, which He spoke by the hand of Elijah.[^2813]

items.slavonic_text: И҆мѣ́ѧше ве́тхїй завѣ́тъ, кївѡ́тъ ѡ҆кова́нъ всю́дꙋ зла́томъ: и҆́же взя́тъ ѿ и҆ноплеме́нникъ, не стерпѣ̀ на ка́пищи съ кꙋмі́ромъ привкꙋше́нїа, но и҆зри́нꙋ и҆̀ на зе́млю, и҆ сокрꙋшѝ главꙋ̀ и҆ ѻ҆́бѣ дла̑ни рꙋкꙋ̀ є҆гѡ̀: ты́ же Человѣколю́бче Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е на́шъ, ка́кѡ вни́деши въ ка́пище скве́рныя дꙋшы̀ ѡ҆каѧ́ннымъ;
items.english_text: Before the ark of the shadow, David the Ancestor of God leaped and danced; but we today worship Him as God, Whose humanity the ark prefigured; for instead of the manna, the Godhead is incarnate; instead of the tables of stone, the Lawgiver Christ the Lord is seen hidden, saving our souls.[^2814]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же є҆ди́нъ и҆мѣ́ѧй безсме́ртїе, и҆ въ свѣ́тѣ живы́й непристꙋ́пнѣмъ, ка́кѡ совокꙋпи́шися съ кꙋмі́ромъ тмы̀ грѣхо́вныя; но Ѽ Свѣ́те! просвѣща́ѧй вся́каго человѣ́ка, не сокрꙋшѝ, ни низве́ржи къ тмѣ̀ кромѣ́шнюю те́мныхъ и҆ грѣ́шныхъ дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ, но просвѣтѝ я҆̀ благода́тїю твое́ю, мо́лимся, милосе́рдїа Пꙋчи́но, Хлѣ́бе преесте́ственный.
items.english_text: The Old Testament had an ark overlaid on every side with gold; which, being captured by foreigners, endured not the coexistence with the idol in the temple of false gods, but cast it down to the earth, and shattered its head and both palms of its hands: but Thou, O Christ our God, Lover of mankind, how wilt Thou enter into the temple of the defiled soul of us wretched ones?[^2815]

items.slavonic_text: А҆́гнче неѕло́бивый, взе́млѧй грѣхѝ всего̀ мі́ра: человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди спасенїа, хлѣ́бъ претвори́лъ є҆сѝ въ Пло́ть твою̀: и҆ въ хлѣ́бѣ Бж҃ество̀, Пло́ть и҆ Дꙋ́шꙋ, Бж҃твенною си́лою оу҆таи́лъ є҆сѝ: є҆мꙋ́же всѝ вѣ́рнїи, дне́сь пра́зднственнѡ, съ оу҆миле́нїемъ и҆ вѣ́рою покланя́емся.
items.english_text: O Thou Who alone hast immortality, and dwellest in unapproachable light, how wilt Thou unite Thyself with the idol of the darkness of sin? But O Light that enlightenest every man, shatter not, neither cast down into outer darkness the dark and sinful souls of us, but enlighten them by Thy grace, we pray Thee, O Abyss of compassion, O supernatural Bread![^2816]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ в҃. Та́йнѣй дне́сь ве́чери, и҆ трапе́зѣ Бж҃твеннѣй, со стра́хомъ приближа́емся вѣ́рнїи, хотѧ́ще вкуси́ти И҆сто́чника безсме́ртнагѡ: но тре́петъ и҆ стра́хъ на́съ прїе́млетъ, мно́гихъ ра́ди грѣ́хъ на́шихъ, ѿ ни́хже тобо́ю ѡ҆чи́ститися жела́емъ, мл҃твами Гд҃цы Влⷣчцы на́шеѧ.
items.english_text: O innocent Lamb that takest away the sins of the whole world, for the sake of man's salvation Thou didst change bread into Thy Body; and in the bread Thou didst conceal Godhead, Body, and Soul by divine power: unto Whom all we faithful today festively bow down with compunction and faith.

items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ стїхи̑ры. Гла́съ а҃. Подо́бенъ: Нб҃ныхъ чинѡ́въ: Хлѣ́бъ небе́сный живо́тный воспои́мъ, * съ нб҃сѐ непреста́ннѡ схода́щїй неизрече́ннѡ, * глаго́люще є҆диномꙋ́дреннѡ: * Тѣ́ло Хрⷭ҇то́во, и҆́мже всѝ и҆зба́вихомся, ра́дꙋйся, * и҆ Кро́вь Бж҃твеннаѧ и҆ ст҃а́ѧ, * є҆́юже и҆скꙋпи́хомся.
items.english_text: Unto the Mystical Supper today, and the Divine Table, we faithful draw near with fear, desiring to taste of the immortal Spring; but trembling and fear seize us because of our many sins, from which we desire to be cleansed by Thee, through the prayers of the Sovereign Lady, our Queen.

Ѽ Бж҃твенное и҆ всечестно́е Тѣ́ло и҆ дража́йшее! * вочеловѣ́чша Сло́ва, * спасѝ твоѧ̑ рабы̀ ѿ скорбе́й мно́гихъ и҆ и҆скꙋше́нїй, * и҆ вся́кихъ ѡ҆бстоѧ́нїй, * вѣ́чное Ца́рствїе и҆ жи́знь подаѧ̀, * твоеѧ̀ ра́ди мл҃ти.
items.english_text: At the Supper Thou didst give Thyself unto Thy disciples and friends for food, (O wonder!) and: Eat bread, for this is My Body; and having taken the cup, Thou didst say: Drink ye all of My Blood.

items.slavonic_text: Та́же: Ны́нѣ ѿпꙋща́еши: Трїст҃о́е по Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ: Тропа́рь. Гла́съ з҃: Хлѣ́бъ преесте́ственный, є҆го́же А҆́гг҃ли и҆ А҆рха́гг҃ли трепе́щꙋще ви́дѣти жела́ютъ, дне́сь пра́зднственнѡ на прⷭ҇то́лѣ зри́тся, и҆ человѣ́кѡмъ въ снѣ́дь дае́тся: къ не́мже мы̀ пребога́тꙋю твою̀ ми́лость Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е на́шъ зрѧ́ще, Бг҃а тѧ̀ съ пло́тїю зрѣ́нїемъ ви́дѡвъ оу҆тае́ннаго и҆сповѣ́дꙋемъ гл҃юще: сподо́би на́съ прича́стниками бы́ти, да и҆ жи́зни вѣ́чныѧ наслади́мсѧ.
items.english_text: O Divine, all-honorable, and most precious Body of the incarnate Word, save Thy servants from many afflictions and temptations, and from all tribulations, granting eternal Kingdom and life, for the sake of Thy mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Divine, all-honorable, and most precious Body of the incarnate Word, save Thy servants from many afflictions and temptations, and from all tribulations, granting eternal Kingdom and life, for the sake of Thy mercy!

items.slavonic_text: На Оу҆́трени. На Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь, тропа́рь: Хлѣ́бъ преесте́ственный: три́жды. По а҃-й каѳі́смѣ сѣда́ленъ. Гла́съ з. Па́сха на́ша вели́каѧ и҆ всечестна́ѧ сы́й Хрⷭ҇то́съ, снѣде́нъ бы́сть ꙗ҆́кѡ хлѣ́бъ: закла́вшыся же ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆вча̀, то́й принесе́ся ѡ҆ на́съ же́ртва Бг҃опрїе́мна, є҆гѡ́же пречи́стомꙋ Тѣлꙋ̀, и҆ честнѣ́й Кро́ви благоче́стнѡ покланя́ющеся, оу҆ми́льнѡ глаго́лемъ: всегда̀ съ на́ми са́мъ спребыва́й, и҆ никто́же возмо́жетъ что̀ на ны̀.
items.english_text: O marvelous wonder! The Living and Divine Bread that came down from heaven is willingly given for food at the mystical evening; for having taken bread and blessed it, He gave it, saying unto the disciples: Take, eat, this is My Body; likewise also the cup; therefore let each examine himself, and so let him eat and drink, unto salvation and into life eternal.[^2818]

provenance.verbatim_source: O marvelous wonder! The Living and Divine Bread that came down from heaven is willingly given for food at the mystical evening; for having taken bread and blessed it, He gave it, saying unto the disciples: Take, eat, this is My Body; likewise also the cup; therefore let each examine himself, and so let him eat and drink, unto salvation and into life eternal.[^2818]

items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 7:*[^2819] The supernatural Bread, which Angels and Archangels desire to behold with trembling, today is seen festively upon the altar, and is given unto men for food: beholding Thy most rich mercy toward it, O Christ our God, we confess Thee as God with flesh hidden by the appearance of the species, saying: Vouchsafe us to be partakers, that we may also delight in life eternal.

items.english_text: Christ, being our great and all-honorable Passover, was eaten as bread; and having been slain as a lamb, He was offered for us as an acceptable sacrifice unto God: Whose all-pure Body and precious Blood we piously worship, crying with compunction: Do Thou Thyself abide ever with us, and none shall prevail against us!

items.slavonic_text: По в҃-й каѳі́смѣ, сѣда́ленъ. Гла́съ д҃. Подо́бенъ: Ско́рѡ предварѝ: Хлѣ́бъ нб҃ный и҆ ча́шꙋ взе́мъ, Хрⷭ҇то́съ благословѝ, показꙋ́ѧ Ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ Роди́телю: и҆ дивѧ́щымся Оу҆ченикѡ́мъ, подаѧ́ше глаго́лѧ: ꙗ҆ды́й мою̀ Пло́ть, и҆ пїѧ́й мою̀ Кро́вь, и҆́мать живо́тъ вѣ́чный, и҆ А҆́зъ воскрешꙋ̀ є҆го̀ въ послѣ́днїй де́нь: сегѡ̀ ра́ди мы̀ недосто́йнїи, дне́сь пра́зднственнѡ покланя́емся пречи́стымъ Та́йнамъ Пло́ти и҆ Кро́ве твоеѧ̀, дерзнове́ннѡ вѣ́рꙋюще: ꙗ҆́кѡ ты̀ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇то́съ Сн҃ъ Бг҃а жива́гѡ, прише́дый въ мі́ръ грѣ́шныѧ спастѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Mother of God, Ever-Virgin Mary, behold the Flesh of Thy Son, Christ our God, which having taken from thy womb through the operation of the All-Holy Spirit, He gave unto His disciples at the Mystical Supper, saying: Take, eat, this is My Body; and drink, this is My Blood: Whom do thou beseech with maternal boldness, that He consume not us who partake, but save our souls.[^2821]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O Mother of God, Ever-Virgin Mary, behold the Flesh of Thy Son, Christ our God, which having taken from thy womb through the operation of the All-Holy Spirit, He gave unto His disciples at the Mystical Supper, saying: Take, eat, this is My Body; and drink, this is My Blood: Whom do thou beseech with maternal boldness, that He consume not us who partake, but save our souls.[^2821]

items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ а҃-й. Ве́лїй Гдⷭ҇ь, и҆ хва́ленъ ѕѣлѡ̀, въ гра́дѣ Бг҃а на́шегѡ, въ горѣ̀ ст҃ѣ́й є҆гѡ̀. Стї́хъ в҃-й. Что̀ возда́мъ Гдⷭ҇еви ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ, ꙗ҆̀же воздадѐ ми. Стї́хъ г҃-й. Ча́шꙋ спасенїа прїимꙋ̀, и҆ и҆́мѧ Гдⷭ҇не призовꙋ̀. Стї́хъ д҃-й. Па́мять сотвори́лъ є҆́сть чꙋде́съ свои́хъ, ми́лостивъ Гдⷭ҇ь и҆ ще́дръ, пи́щꙋ да́лъ є҆́сть боя́щымся є҆гѡ̀. Стї́хъ є҃-й. Ѡ҆дождѝ и҆̀мъ ма́ннꙋ ꙗ҆́сти, и҆ хлѣ́бъ нб҃ный дадѐ и҆̀мъ. Стї́хъ ѕ҃-й. Хлѣ́бъ А҆́гг҃лскїй ꙗ҆дѐ чл҃къ, бра́шно посла̀ и҆̀мъ до сы́тїа.
items.english_text: Having taken the heavenly bread and the cup, Christ blessed them, showing them unto the Father Who begat Him; and giving them unto the wondering disciples, He said: He that eats My Flesh and drinks My Blood hath eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day: on this account we, unworthy though we be, today festively worship the all-pure Mysteries of Thy Flesh and Blood, boldly believing that Thou art Christ, the Son of the living God, Who camest into the world to save sinners.

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Without seed, from the Holy Spirit thou didst conceive, and didst bear the Son, Christ our God: Whose most pure Flesh, as our God and Redeemer, we worship prostrate to the face of the earth, desiring to become partakers; and unto thee, as Mother, we flee, O all-pure Mother of God, and speaking with compunction, we pray thee: Receive our prayers, and bear them unto Thy Son and our God, that He may save our souls.

items.english_text: O eternal and unoriginate God, having assumed human nature, Thou didst come into the prepared upper chamber with Thy disciples; where, having completed the old Passover, O our Savior, Thou didst institute the new mystical Passover: for having taken bread, Thou didst change it into Thy Body, and the cup into Blood, and didst give them unto us for food and drink: beholding this Divine Mystery today, we say with compunction: Glory to Thy dispensation, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Землѐ блага́ѧ: бл҃гослове́ннаѧ Бг҃оневѣ́сто, Кла́съ возрасти́вшаѧ неѡра́нный, и҆ спаси́тельный мі́рꙋ: сподо́би мѧ̀ се́й ꙗ҆ды́й спасти́ся.
items.english_text: The Lord said unto the Judeans who came unto Him: My Flesh is food indeed, and My Blood is drink indeed. He that eats My Flesh and drinks My Blood abides in Me, and I in him. As the living Father hath sent Me, and I live because of the Father; so he that eats Me, even he shall live because of Me. This is the Bread that came down from heaven; not as your fathers did eat manna, and died; he that eats this Bread shall live for ever.

items.english_text: Today the Angels are filled with awe, beholding Thee, the incarnate God, concealed within the Mysteries, worshiped with fear by men, and given for food: with them we also, mortals of the earth, hymn Thee, the Sovereign Lover of mankind, saying: Vouchsafe us to partake of Thy most pure Body and Blood, O compassionate Lord!

items.slavonic_text: Катава́сїа. Ѡ҆тве́рзꙋ оу҆ста̀ моѧ̑, и҆ напо́лнятся Дх҃а, и҆ сло́во ѿры́гнꙋ Цр҃и́цѣ Мт҃ри, и҆ ꙗ҆влю́ся свѣ́тлѡ торжествꙋ́ѧ, и҆ воспою̀ ра́дꙋѧся тоѧ̀ чꙋдеса̀.
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* I shall open my mouth, and it shall be filled with the Spirit, and I shall utter speech unto the Queen and Mother; and I shall be seen radiantly keeping festival, and rejoicing I shall sing her wonders!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia:*
I shall open my mouth, and it shall be filled with the Spirit, and I shall utter speech unto the Queen and Mother; and I shall be seen radiantly keeping festival, and rejoicing I shall sing her wonders!

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь г҃. І҆рмо́съ: На ка́мени мѧ̀ вѣ́ры оу҆тверди́въ, разшири́лъ є҆сѝ оу҆ста̀ моѧ̑ на врагѝ моѧ̑, возвесели́ бо сѧ дх҃ъ мо́й внегда̀ пѣ́ти: нѣ́сть ст҃ъ ꙗ҆́коже Бг҃ъ на́шъ, и҆ нѣ́сть пра́веденъ па́че тебѐ Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:*[^2829] Having established me upon the rock of faith, Thou didst open wide my mouth against my enemies; for my spirit rejoiced in chanting: There is none holy as our God, and there is none righteous beside Thee, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*[^2829]
Having established me upon the rock of faith, Thou didst open wide my mouth against my enemies; for my spirit rejoiced in chanting: There is none holy as our God, and there is none righteous beside Thee, O Lord!

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Сподо́би мѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и, твоегѡ̀ Тѣ́ла причасти́тися неосꙋжде́ннѡ, и҆ Кро́ве твоеѧ̀ честны́ѧ, и҆ сла́вити твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Grant me drops of tears, O Christ, that cleanse the defilement of my heart; so that, purified with a good conscience, in faith and fear I may draw near, O Master, to the communion of Thy Divine Gifts!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Grant me drops of tears, O Christ, that cleanse the defilement of my heart; so that, purified with a good conscience, in faith and fear I may draw near, O Master, to the communion of Thy Divine Gifts!

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Катава́сїа: Твоѧ̑ пѣсносло́вцы Бцⷣе, живы́й и҆ незави́стный И҆сто́чниче, ли́къ себѣ̀ совокꙋ́пльшыѧ, дх҃о́внѡ оу҆твердѝ, въ Бж҃твеннѣй твое́й сла́вѣ, вѣнце́въ сла́вы сподо́би.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* May Thy most pure Body and Divine Blood be unto me for the remission of transgressions, and for the communion of the Holy Spirit, and for life eternal, O Lover of mankind, and for the estrangement from passions and griefs!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
May Thy most pure Body and Divine Blood be unto me for the remission of transgressions, and for the communion of the Holy Spirit, and for life eternal, O Lover of mankind, and for the estrangement from passions and griefs!

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ: А҆́гнца и҆ Па́стыря Мт҃и Дв҃о Бцⷣе оу҆молѝ, є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, да спасе́тъ и҆ просвѣти́тъ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Vouchsafe me, O Lord, to partake without condemnation of Thy Body and of Thy precious Blood, and to glorify Thy goodness!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Vouchsafe me, O Lord, to partake without condemnation of Thy Body and of Thy precious Blood, and to glorify Thy goodness!

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Восхотѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, на́съ дѣ́ла вопло́щся, Многоми́лостиве, закла́нъ бы́ти ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆вча̀ грѣ́хъ ра́ди человѣ́ческихъ: тѣ́мже молю́ тя, и҆ моѧ̑ ѡ҆чи́сти прегрѣше́нїа. И҆сцѣлѝ дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ я҆́звы, Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ всего́ мѧ ѡ҆ст҃ѝ: и҆ сподо́би, Влⷣко, ꙗ҆́кѡ да прича́стникъ бꙋ́дꙋ та́йныѧ твоеѧ̀ Бж҃твенныѧ Ве́чери, ѡ҆каѧ́нный.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O most holy Table of the Bread of life, Who for mercy's sake came down from on high and gives new life unto the world: vouchsafe me also now, unworthy though I be, to taste thereof with fear, and to be alive!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O most holy Table of the Bread of life, Who for mercy's sake came down from on high and gives new life unto the world: vouchsafe me also now, unworthy though I be, to taste thereof with fear, and to be alive!

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва:
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* O Mother of God, living and bountiful Fount, do thou spiritually establish the choir gathered in unity, who hymn thee; and in thy divine glory, vouchsafe them crowns of glory!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia:*
O Mother of God, living and bountiful Fount, do thou spiritually establish the choir gathered in unity, who hymn thee; and in thy divine glory, vouchsafe them crowns of glory!

items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва:
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 1, Podoben: "The stone being sealed" (Ка́мени запеча́танꙋ):*[^2830] Eating the lamb with Thy disciples, O Master, according to the commandment of Moses, Thou didst give Thyself, the spotless Lamb, mystically unto us for food, for the remission of sins, and for the sanctification of souls: nourished by which, we pray: Let not the communion of Thy Holy Mysteries be unto us for judgment or condemnation, because of our sins and iniquities!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 1, Podoben: "The stone being sealed" (Ка́мени запеча́танꙋ):*[^2830]
Eating the lamb with Thy disciples, O Master, according to the commandment of Moses, Thou didst give Thyself, the spotless Lamb, mystically unto us for food, for the remission of sins, and for the sanctification of souls: nourished by which, we pray: Let not the communion of Thy Holy Mysteries be unto us for judgment or condemnation, because of our sins and iniquities!

items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Virgin Mother of God, entreat the Lamb and Shepherd, the Son Whom thou didst bear, that He may save and enlighten our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O Virgin Mother of God, entreat the Lamb and Shepherd, the Son Whom thou didst bear, that He may save and enlighten our souls!

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва:
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:*[^2831] Thou didst come from the Virgin, neither an envoy nor an angel, but Thou Thyself incarnate, O Lord, and hast saved me, the whole man: therefore I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*[^2831]
Thou didst come from the Virgin, neither an envoy nor an angel, but Thou Thyself incarnate, O Lord, and hast saved me, the whole man: therefore I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having become incarnate for our sake, O Most Merciful One, Thou didst desire to be slain as a sheep for the sins of men: therefore I pray Thee, cleanse Thou also my transgressions!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having become incarnate for our sake, O Most Merciful One, Thou didst desire to be slain as a sheep for the sins of men: therefore I pray Thee, cleanse Thou also my transgressions!

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Heal the wounds of my soul, O Lord, and sanctify me wholly: and vouchsafe me, wretched that I am, O Master, that I may be a partaker of Thy mystical Divine Supper!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Heal the wounds of my soul, O Lord, and sanctify me wholly: and vouchsafe me, wretched that I am, O Master, that I may be a partaker of Thy mystical Divine Supper!

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Стоѧ̀ и҆ стенѧ̀ со стра́хомъ и҆ тре́петомъ, ѻ҆́чи моѝ серде́чнїи и҆́мамъ горѣ̀, къ тебѣ̀ Сп҃се, на Крⷭ҇тѣ̀ просте́ршꙋ ѿве́рстїи рꙋ́цѣ: и҆́миже да́ждь мѝ пи́щꙋ твоегѡ̀ благоволе́нїа, оу҆твержда́ѧ мѧ̀ и҆ оу҆крѣпля́ѧ къ стра́сѣ твое́мъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Standing and groaning with fear and trembling, I lift up the eyes of my heart on high unto Thee, O Savior, Who didst stretch out Thine open hands upon the Cross: with them grant me the food of Thy good pleasure, confirming me and strengthening me in Thy fear.[^2833]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Standing and groaning with fear and trembling, I lift up the eyes of my heart on high unto Thee, O Savior, Who didst stretch out Thine open hands upon the Cross: with them grant me the food of Thy good pleasure, confirming me and strengthening me in Thy fear.[^2833]

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Катава́сїа: Сѣдѧ́й въ сла́вѣ, на Прⷭ҇то́лѣ Бж҃тва̀, во ѡ҆́блацѣ ле́гцѣ, прїи́де І҆и҃съ пребж҃ественный, нетлѣ́нною дла́нїю, и҆ сп҃сѐ зову́щыѧ: сла́ва Хрⷭ҇тѐ си́лѣ твое́й.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Make Thy compassionate Son merciful unto me, O Sovereign Lady, and preserve me, thy servant, without spot and without blemish, so that, having received the noetic pearl within, I may be sanctified.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Make Thy compassionate Son merciful unto me, O Sovereign Lady, and preserve me, thy servant, without spot and without blemish, so that, having received the noetic pearl within, I may be sanctified.

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь є҃. І҆рмо́съ: Просвѣще́нїе во тмѣ̀ лежа́щихъ, спасе́нїе ѿча́янныхъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Сп҃се мо́й, къ тебѣ̀ оу҆́треннюю, Цр҃ю̀ ми́ра, просвѣти́ мѧ сїя́нїемъ твои́мъ: и҆но́гѡ бо ра́звѣ тебѐ Бг҃а не зна́ю.
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* He Who sits in glory upon the throne of the Godhead, Jesus the most divine, hath come upon a light cloud, and with His incorrupt hand hath saved those who cry: Glory to Thy power, O Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia:*
He Who sits in glory upon the throne of the Godhead, Jesus the most divine, hath come upon a light cloud, and with His incorrupt hand hath saved those who cry: Glory to Thy power, O Christ!

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже предре́клъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, да бꙋ́детъ оу҆́бѡ хꙋдо́мꙋ рабꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀, и҆ въ мнѣ̀ пребꙋ́ди, ꙗ҆́коже ѡ҆бѣща́лся є҆сѝ: сѐ бо Тѣ́ло твоѐ ꙗ҆́мъ Бж҃ественное, и҆ пїю̀ Кро́вь твою̀. Сло́ве Бж҃їй и҆ Бж҃е, оу҆́гль да бꙋ́детъ мнѣ̀ Тѣ́ло твоѐ Бж҃ественное къ просвѣще́нїе помраче́нномꙋ, и҆ ѡ҆чище́нїе ѡ҆скверне́нной дꙋшѝ мое́й, Кро́вь твоѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:*[^2834] O Illumination of them that lie in darkness, Salvation of the despairing, O Christ my Savior, unto Thee I rise early, O King of peace: enlighten me with Thy brightness, for beside Thee I know no other God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*[^2834]
O Illumination of them that lie in darkness, Salvation of the despairing, O Christ my Savior, unto Thee I rise early, O King of peace: enlighten me with Thy brightness, for beside Thee I know no other God!

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Мр҃і́е Мт҃и Бж҃їа, бл҃гоꙋха́нїа чⷭ҇то́е селе́нїе, твои́ми моли́твами сосꙋ́дъ мѧ̀ и҆збра́нъ содѣ́лай: ꙗ҆́кѡ да ст҃ы́хъ Та́инъ причащꙋ́ся Сн҃а твоегѡ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Even as Thou didst say beforehand, O Christ, let it be unto Thy humble servant, and abide in me, as Thou didst promise: for behold, I eat Thy Divine Body, and drink Thy Blood.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Even as Thou didst say beforehand, O Christ, let it be unto Thy humble servant, and abide in me, as Thou didst promise: for behold, I eat Thy Divine Body, and drink Thy Blood.

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валя́ѧся, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Word of God and God, may Thy Divine Body be a burning coal unto me for illumination who am darkened; and may Thy Blood be for cleansing unto my defiled soul!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
O Word of God and God, may Thy Divine Body be a burning coal unto me for illumination who am darkened; and may Thy Blood be for cleansing unto my defiled soul!

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Со стра́хомъ и҆ тре́петомъ пристꙋпи́ти да́ждь мѝ къ Бж҃твеннымъ, Хрⷭ҇тѐ, твои̑мъ Та́йнамъ: и҆́стое же и҆ ст҃о́е Тѣ́ло твоѐ прїя́ти, и҆ и҆́стꙋю и҆ ст҃ꙋ́ю и҆ честнꙋ́ю Кро́вь.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having an utterly defiled soul and unclean lips, I dare not now draw near unto Thee, O Christ, and receive Thy Body: but do Thou show me worthy!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having an utterly defiled soul and unclean lips, I dare not now draw near unto Thee, O Christ, and receive Thy Body: but do Thou show me worthy!

items.office: FEAST OF THE MOST HOLY EUCHARIST: AT MATINS
items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Mary, Mother of God, pure dwelling of sweet fragrance, by thy prayers make me a chosen vessel, that I may partake of the Holy Mysteries of Thy Son!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O Mary, Mother of God, pure dwelling of sweet fragrance, by thy prayers make me a chosen vessel, that I may partake of the Holy Mysteries of Thy Son!

items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ:
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* All things were amazed at thy divine glory: for thou, O Virgin who knewest not wedlock, didst hold in thy womb the God over all, and didst give birth to the timeless Son, granting peace unto all who hymn thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia:*

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ:
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:*[^2835] Wallowing in the abyss of sin, I call upon the unfathomable abyss of Thy compassion: bring me up from corruption, O God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*[^2835]
Wallowing in the abyss of sin, I call upon the unfathomable abyss of Thy compassion: bring me up from corruption, O God!

items.season_or_tone: GREAT FEAST OF HOLY PENTECOST AND ALL SAINTS
items.day_or_date: SUNDAY OF ALL SAINTS: AT THE DIVINE LITURGY
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Sanctify my mind, soul, heart, and body, O Savior, and vouchsafe me, O Master, to approach Thy awesome Mysteries without condemnation!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Sanctify my mind, soul, heart, and body, O Savior, and vouchsafe me, O Master, to approach Thy awesome Mysteries without condemnation!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* May I be estranged from passions, and vouchsafed to receive the increase of Thy grace, and the confirmation of life, for the sake of communion of Thy Holy Mysteries, O Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Grant me to approach Thy Divine Mysteries with fear and trembling, O Christ: and to receive Thy true and holy Body, and Thy true, holy, and precious Blood![^2836]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Grant me to approach Thy Divine Mysteries with fear and trembling, O Christ: and to receive Thy true and holy Body, and Thy true, holy, and precious Blood![^2836]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: Бж҃їе Бж҃е Сло́во ст҃о́е, всего́ мѧ ѡ҆ст҃ѝ, ны́нѣ приходѧ́щаго къ Бж҃е́ственнымъ твои̑мъ Та́йнамъ, ст҃ы́ѧ Мт҃ре твоеѧ̀ молба́ми.

items.slavonic_text: К О Н Д А́ К Ъ. Гла́съ в҃: Сѐ предлежи́тъ Хрⷭ҇то́съ на пи́щꙋ всѣ̑мъ, прїиди́те и҆ припада́юще поклони́мся Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ Бг҃ꙋ, си́ми Та́йнами оу҆тае́нномꙋ, съ оу҆миле́нїемъ взыва́юще: Влⷣко, да не ѡ҆пали́ши на́съ недосто́йныхъ привкуше́нїемъ: но бꙋ́ди попаля́ѧ грѣхѝ, и҆ ѡ҆чища́ѧ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 2:*[^2838] Behold, Christ is set forth as food for all: come, and falling down let us worship Christ God, Who is concealed by these Mysteries, crying out with compunction: O Master, consume not us who are unworthy by our partaking: but do Thou burn away sins, and purify our souls!

items.slavonic_text: Сѷнаѯа́рь въ ст҃ы́й Четверто́къ Є҆ѵхарїсті́и. Въ се́й Четверто́къ, и҆́же и҆ ѕ҃-й по Па́сцѣ, по Недѣ́ли же всѣ́хъ Ст҃ы́хъ а҃-й, нарица́ется: пребо́лшаѧ, пречестнѣ́йшаѧ, и҆ па́че всѣ́хъ, вѣ́ры каѳолі́ческїѧ Та́инствъ, пресовершеннѣ́йшїѧ Та́йны Є҆ѵхарїсті́и, свѣтлѣ́йшїй пра́здникъ ѿ Ри́мскїѧ Це́ркве, помѣ́стнымъ и҆́же въ гра́дѣ Замо́йстѣ собо́ромъ вг҃овѣ́йнѣ и҆ бл҃гоговѣ́йнѣ соверша́ти воспрїѧ́хомъ. Пра́здникъ же се́й нача́ла къ Ри́мѣ, ѿ ст҃ѣ́йшагѡ вселе́нскагѡ Патрїа́рха Оу҆рба́на, тогѡ̀ и҆́мене д҃-гѡ Па́пы Ри́мскагѡ а҃сѯ҃д года оу҆ста́вленъ бы́сть за сїю̀ наипа́че винꙋ̀: занѐ въ та̀ времена̀ нѣ́кїа воста́хꙋ є҆́реси, Та́йнꙋ сїю̀ без̾бо́жнѣ хꙋ́лящыѧ. Къ посрамле́нїе (оу҆́бѡ глаго́летъ Оу҆рба́нъ Па́па,) наипа́че є҆рети́чествꙋющихъ ѕловѣ́рїа и҆ безꙋ́мїа, досто́йнѡ и҆ пра́веднѡ сꙋ́дихомъ, да ѡ҆ се́й (Та́йнѣ Є҆ѵхарїсті́и) воспомина́нїе торже́ственнѣйшее и҆́мамы, а҆́ще бо и҆ пре́жде сегѡ̀, въ де́нь Та́йныѧ Ве́чери Гдⷭ҇ни, въ ѻ҆́нь же са́мъ Хрⷭ҇то́съ сїю̀ Та́йнꙋ оу҆ста́ви, и҆ Оу҆чени́кѡмъ преподадѐ, ѡ҆ не́й па́мѧтствꙋемъ: но поне́же тогда̀ все́й ꙗ҆́же по вселе́ннѣй Це́ркви, ка́ющихсѧ примире́нїемъ, ст҃а́гѡ вели́кагѡ мѵ́ра приꙋготовле́нїемъ, и҆сполне́нїемъ ꙗ҆́же ѡ҆ оу҆мове́нїи но́гъ за́повѣди Хрⷭ҇то́вы, и҆ и҆ны́ми множа́йшими дѣ́лы оу҆пражне́нной бы́вшей, всесоверше́ннагѡ ѡ҆ се́й превели́кой Та́йнѣ соста́вляти торжества̀ нѣ́сть мо́щно: наро́чнѡ оу҆́бѡ на то̀ дѣ́ло де́нь, и҆́же є҆́сть по Ѿда́нїи Пра́здника Пентїко́стїи, є҃-й, си́ є҆́сть Четверто́къ, бы́вше рече́нный ст҃ѣ́йшїй Па́па ѡ҆предѣлѝ и҆ оу҆зако́ни, къ благолѣ́пное самагѡ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀ Гдⷭ҇а въ се́й Та́йнѣ ѿ всѣ́хъ почита́нїе, въ ѡ҆браже́нїе же, (ꙗ҆́коже рече́ся) безсты́днагѡ є҆рети́ческагѡ на сїю̀ дерзнове́нїа, и҆ хꙋлы̀. И҆ сїѧ̀ (кромѣ̀ є҆ще́ и҆ и҆ны́хъ мно́жайшихъ,) первѣ́йшаѧ вина̀ бя́ше ко оу҆ставле́нїю и҆зъ нача́ла Пра́здника сегѡ̀ въ Ри́мстей Це́ркви: къ на́шей же, поне́же тое́яжъ є҆рети́кѡвъ по мно́гихъ мѣ́стѣхъ мно́жашеся безꙋ́мїе, є҆ще́ же да не до конца̀ свѣ́дѣнїе сеѧ̀ Та́йны въ простѣ́йшыхъ оу҆маля́ется, но па́че чрезъ и҆звѣ́стное ке́щи и҆спыта́нїе, что̀ є҆́сть; къ дꙋ́шы и҆ сердца̀ и҆́хъ вкореня́ется, благохи́тростнѡ и҆ благопотре́бнѡ сꙋди́ша, рече́ннагѡ помѣ́стнагѡ собо́ра Ѻ҆тцы̀, ѡ҆ Ри́мскїѧ Це́ркве Пра́здникъ се́й воспрїѧ́ти. Что́ бо; не благосло́внаѧ ли къ семꙋ̀ дѣ́лꙋ вина̀ сꙋ́дится бы́ти та̀, къ не́йже и҆ Златоꙋ́стый І҆ѡа́ннъ, свои́хъ тогда̀ Литꙋргі́ахъ возбꙋжда́ше гла̀: Тре́пѣ є҆́сть коз̾ложе́ннїи, Та́инъ оу҆вѣ́дати чꙋ́до, коли́ко є҆́сть; и҆ почто̀ дано̀ бѣ́; и҆ ка́я ѿ сегѡ̀ ве́щи по́лза; и҆ не довле́ѣ ста̀, но приложѝ па́ки рекїй, ко́е сѐ чꙋ́до: коеѧ̀ ра́ди вины̀ дано̀: и҆ что̀ по́льзꙋетъ ке́щь: Є҆ди́но тѣ́ло (глаго́летъ) быва́емъ оу҆́ды ѿ Пло́ти є҆гѡ̀ и҆ ѿ косте́й є҆гѡ̀, (є҆́же є҆́сть Хрⷭ҇та̀ чрезъ [та́йны,]) оу҆́бѡ да не то́чїю любо́вїю сїѐ бꙋ́демъ, но и҆ само́ю ве́щїю се́й привкуша́емсѧ Пло́ти: сѐ же снѣ́дїю быва́етъ, ю҆́же предадѐ на́мъ, хотя̀ показа́ти жела́нїе, є҆́же къ на́мъ и҆́мать. И҆ па́ки ѿ лица̀ Хрⷭ҇то́ва глаго́летъ: Роди́теле и҆ны́мъ ча́стѣ предаю́тъ ча́да своя̑ къ воскормле́нїю, А҆́зъ же гл҃етъ, не та́кѡ, но Пло́тїю мое́ю пита́ю, и҆ менѐ самаго̀ предлага́ю. Хотя́й бы́ти бра́томъ ва́шымъ, пло́ти ва́съ дѣ́ла и҆ кро́ви приѡбщи́хся: ва́мъ взаи́мъ то́южде Пло́ть и҆ Кро́вь, и҆́миже сро́денъ ва́мъ бы́хъ, предаю̀. Ѽле чꙋде́съ та́инства! Ѽле по́лзы ке́щи! по словесѝ Златоꙋ́стагѡ, не досто́йне ли, да сицево́е Хрⷭ҇та̀ Гдⷭ҇а благодея́нїе свѣтлѣ́йшимъ ѿ на́съ почита́ется Пра́здникомъ; є҆́й, досто́йне: є҆ще́ же тща́тельнѡ въ вся́чески, да сицева́ѧ є҆гѡ̀ къ на́мъ любо́вь, всѣ̑ми да́же до малѣ́йшагѡ оу҆вѣ́дана бꙋ́детъ, а҆ не кра́йнимъ оу҆ нѣ́которыхъ покрыва́ется невѣ́дѣнїемъ. Ѿсю́дꙋ є҆́сть, ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆ ст҃ы́й вселе́нскїй и҆́же къ Трїде́нтѣ Собо́ръ, сицево́е оу҆мышле́нїе ѕѣлѡ̀ похваля́етъ глаго́ля: Благоче́стнѡ и҆ благоговѣ́йнѡ весьма̀ къ Це́рковь Бж҃їю введе́нъ є҆́сть се́й ѻ҆бы́чай, да на вся́къ го́дъ превели́каѧ сїѧ̀ и҆ и҆зба́внаѧ Та́йна, свѣтлѣ́йшимъ воспоминанїемъ и҆ торжество́мъ почита́ется, и҆ да съ літі́ею вг҃олѣ́пнѡ и҆ че́стнѡ, по сто́гнахъ и҆ по мѣ́стѣхъ наро́читыхъ ѡ҆бно́сится. Є҆ще́ же и҆ а҆на́ѳемѣ преда́ти не оу҆сумнѣ́ся сопротивля́ющихся чи́нꙋ семꙋ̀, и҆ глаго́лющихъ: да бы̀ Є҆ѵхарїсті́и Та́йна, нижѐ со́бственнымъ пра́здненствомъ почита́ема, нижѐ въ літі́яхъ по благочестно́мꙋ и҆ ѻ҆́бщемꙋ каѳолі́ческїѧ Це́ркве чи́нꙋ и҆ ѻ҆бы́чаю торже́ственнѣ ѡ҆носи́ма была̀. Что́ бо; не благосло́внаѧ ли къ семꙋ̀ дѣ́лꙋ вина̀ сꙋ́дится бы́ти та̀, къ не́йже и҆ Златоꙋ́стый І҆ѡа́ннъ, свои́хъ тогда̀ Литꙋргі́ахъ возбꙋжда́ше гла̀: Тре́пѣ є҆́сть коз̾ложе́ннїи, Та́инъ оу҆вѣ́дати чꙋ́до, коли́ко є҆́сть; и҆ почто̀ дано̀ бѣ́; и҆ ка́я ѿ сегѡ̀ ве́щи по́лза; и҆ не довле́ѣ ста̀, но приложѝ па́ки рекїй, ко́е сѐ чꙋ́до: коеѧ̀ ра́ди вины̀ дано̀: и҆ что̀ по́льзꙋетъ ке́щь: Є҆ди́но тѣ́ло (глаго́летъ) быва́емъ оу҆́ды ѿ Пло́ти є҆гѡ̀ и҆ ѿ косте́й є҆гѡ̀, (є҆́же є҆́сть Хрⷭ҇та̀ чрезъ [та́йны,]) оу҆́бѡ да не то́чїю любо́вїю сїѐ бꙋ́демъ, но и҆ само́ю ве́щїю се́й привкуша́емсѧ Пло́ти: сѐ же снѣ́дїю быва́етъ, ю҆́же предадѐ на́мъ, хотя̀ показа́ти жела́нїе, є҆́же къ на́мъ и҆́мать. Хотя́й бы́ти бра́томъ ва́шымъ, пло́ти ва́съ дѣ́ла и҆ кро́ви приѡбщи́хся: ва́мъ взаи́мъ то́южде Пло́ть и҆ Кро́вь, и҆́миже сро́денъ ва́мъ бы́хъ, предаю̀. Ѽле чꙋде́съ та́инства! Ѽле по́лзы ке́щи! по словесѝ Златоꙋ́стагѡ, не досто́йне ли, да сицево́е Хрⷭ҇та̀ Гдⷭ҇а благодея́нїе свѣтлѣ́йшимъ ѿ на́съ почита́ется Пра́здникомъ; є҆́й, досто́йне: є҆ще́ же тща́тельнѡ въ вся́чески, да сицева́ѧ є҆гѡ̀ къ на́мъ любо́вь, всѣ̑ми да́же до малѣ́йшагѡ оу҆вѣ́дана бꙋ́детъ, а҆ не кра́йнимъ оу҆ нѣ́которыхъ покрыва́ется невѣ́дѣнїемъ. items.english_text: On this Thursday, which is also the sixth Thursday after Pascha, and the first Thursday after the Sunday of All Saints, is named the greatest, most honorable, and surpassing all the Mysteries of the Catholic faith, the most perfect Mystery of the Eucharist, the most radiant feast which we have received from the Roman Church to celebrate in a God-pleasing and devout manner, by the local Council held in the city of Zamość. This feast was instituted in the beginning at Rome by the most holy Ecumenical Patriarch Urban, the fourth Pope of Rome of that name, in the year 1264, principally for this reason: because in those times certain heresies arose, impiously blaspheming this Mystery. For the confounding (saith Pope Urban) principally of the malicious faith and folly of the heretics, we have judged it worthy and righteous that we should keep a most solemn remembrance of this Mystery of the Eucharist; for although even before this, on the day of the Mystical Supper of the Lord, on which Christ Himself instituted this Mystery and delivered it unto the disciples, we make commemoration of it: yet because at that time the whole Church throughout the world was occupied with the reconciliation of penitents, the confection of the holy great chrism, the fulfillment of the commandment of Christ concerning the washing of feet, and very many other matters, it was not possible to establish a complete and perfect solemnity concerning this great Mystery: on which account expressly for that purpose the day which is the fifth after the Apodosis of the Feast of Pentecost, that is to say Thursday, was determined and decreed by the aforementioned most holy Pope, for the honorable veneration of Christ the Lord Himself in this Mystery by all men, and for the overthrow (as was said) of the shameless heretical boldness and blasphemy. And this (besides still other very many reasons) was the primary cause for the institution of this Feast from the beginning in the Roman Church. And in our Church, since the folly of the same heretics was multiplying in many places, and moreover lest the knowledge of this Mystery should utterly diminish among the simpler people, but rather through accurate inquiry into the matter, as to what it is, should be rooted in their souls and hearts, the Fathers of the aforementioned local Council wisely and expediently judged that this Feast should be received from the Roman Church.

Is not that judged to be a worthy reason for this matter, unto which even John Chrysostom stirred up his hearers in his Liturgies at that time, saying: It is necessary, beloved, to understand the miracle of the Mysteries, what it is, and for what purpose it was given, and what profit comes of this matter; and he was not content with this, but added again, saying what this miracle is, and for what cause it was given, and what profit the matter hath: One body (he saith) we become, members of His Flesh and of His bones, (which is of Christ through the Mysteries), so that not only in love may we be this, but in very deed we partake of this Flesh: and this comes about through the food which He delivered unto us, wishing to show the longing which He hath toward us. And again he saith in the person of Christ: Parents often deliver their own children unto others to be nursed; but I (saith He) do not so, but I feed you with Mine own Flesh, and I offer Myself. Desiring to be your Brother, for your sake I partook of flesh and blood: and in turn I deliver unto you that same Flesh and Blood, whereby I became kin unto you. O wonders of the mystery! O profit of the matter! According to the word of Chrysostom, is it not worthy that such a benefaction of Christ the Lord should be honored by us with a most radiant Feast? Yea, it is worthy: and moreover carefully in every way, so that such His love toward us may be known by all even unto the least, and not covered with extreme ignorance among some. Hence it is that even the holy Ecumenical Council held at Trent greatly praises such a design, saying: Most piously and devoutly was this custom introduced into the Church of God, that every year this most great and saving Mystery should be honored with the most radiant commemoration and solemnity, and should be carried around with a litiya in a God-befitting and honorable manner through public squares and distinguished places.[^2840] Moreover, it did not hesitate to deliver unto anathema those who oppose this order, and who say: that the Mystery of the Eucharist should neither be honored with its own feast, nor carried around solemnly in litany-processions according to the pious and common order and custom of the Catholic Church. Let those who have loved the curse draw this down upon themselves, sons of disobedience of disobedience; but we, being children of the Catholic Church, piously and devoutly honor Christ the Lord Who is secretly present in this Mystery, so that having inherited the blessing, we may be vouchsafed to behold Him openly, face to face in heaven: unto Whom be glory unto the ages. Amen.[^2841]

items.slavonic_text: Прича́стїе, Хрⷭ҇тѐ, безсме́ртныхъ ны́нѣ твои́хъ Та́инъ, молю̀, да бꙋ́детъ мѝ и҆сто́чникъ благи́хъ, свѣ́тъ, живо́тъ и҆ безстра́стїе, къ преспѣва́нїю и҆ оу҆множе́нїю добродѣ́тели Бж҃твеннѣ́йшїѧ хода́тайственно, є҆ди́не Бл҃же: ꙗ҆́кѡ да сла́влю тѧ̀. Да и҆зба́влюсѧ ѿ страсте́й, врагѡ́въ, нꙋ́ждъ, и҆ вся́кїѧ ско́рби, съ тре́петомъ, любо́вїю, и҆ благоговѣ́нїемъ, Человѣколю́бче, пристꙋпа́ю ны́нѣ къ твои̑мъ безсме́ртнымъ и҆ Бж҃твеннымъ Та́йнамъ, поя̀ тебѣ̀: благослове́нъ є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е ѻ҆тє́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* May the communion of Thine immortal Mysteries now, I pray Thee, O Christ, be unto me a fount of good things, light, life, and dispassion, mediating the progress and multiplication of most divine virtue, O only Good One: that I may glorify Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь и҃. І҆рмо́съ: Ѽ подо́бїи зла́тѣ небре́гше, треблаже́ннїи ю҆́ношы, неизмѣ́нный и҆ живы́й Бж҃їй ѻ҆́бразъ ви́дѣвше, средѣ̀ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ воспѣва́хꙋ: ѡ҆сщ҃ествова́ннаѧ да пое́тъ Гдⷭ҇а вся̀ тва́рь, и҆ превозно́ситъ во вся̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O wretched soul, O passionate soul, be dismayed beholding the most glorious Mysteries; sighing, weep, smiting thy breast, crying and saying: O God, cleanse me even as the prodigal!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* May Thy Body and Thy most precious Blood, O my Savior, be unto me as fire and as light, burning up the fuel of sin and consuming the thorns of passions, and wholly enlightening me who worship Thy Godhead!

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ди́вное чꙋ́до! Исто́чникъ жи́зни, на престо́лѣ зри́тсѧ, и҆ человѣ́кѡмъ въ снѣ́дь дае́тсѧ: весели́сѧ Це́ркви Бж҃ественная, хлѣ́бомъ Пло́ти Хрⷭ҇то́вы преꙋкраше́ннаѧ, возопі́имъ вѣ́рнїи, Їѡа́нна Бг҃осло́ва и҆мꙋ́ще чинонача́льника: Сло́во Пло́ть бы́сть: и҆ всели́сѧ въ ны̀, и҆ ви́дѣхомъ сла́вꙋ є҆гѡ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆диноро́днагѡ ѿ Оу҃ц҃а̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* O marvelous wonder! The Fount of life is beheld upon the throne, and is given unto men for food: rejoice, O divine Church, adorned with the bread of the Flesh of Christ; let us cry aloud, ye faithful, having John the Theologian as leader: The Word was made Flesh, and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, the glory as of the Only-begotten of the Father!

provenance.verbatim_source:

The Fount of life is beheld upon the throne, and is given unto men for food: rejoice, O divine Church, adorned with the bread of the Flesh of Christ; let us cry aloud, ye faithful, having John the Theologian as leader: The Word was made Flesh, and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, the glory as of the Only-begotten of the Father!

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ди́вное чꙋ́до! И҆́же въ ма́ннѣ прѡѡбразꙋ́емый, Бг҃ъ и҆́стинный, ѿ Бг҃а и҆́стинна рожде́нный, воспрїе́мъ чл҃вѣ́чєскїѧ пло́ти є҆стество̀: весели́сѧ дне́сь ро́де человѣ́чь, ви́дѧй Бг҃а въ пло́ти себѐ тебѣ̀ даю́ща, возопі́й весели́сѧ, и҆ оу҆се́рднѡ Бг҃а благодарѧ̀: и҆ Сло́во Пло́ть бы́сть, и҆ всели́сѧ въ ны̀, и҆ ви́дѣхомъ сла́вꙋ є҆гѡ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆диноро́днагѡ ѿ Оу҃ц҃а̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* O marvelous wonder! He Who was prefigured in the manna, the True God, born of the True God, having assumed the nature of human flesh: rejoice this day, O human race, beholding God in the flesh giving Himself unto thee; cry aloud, rejoice, and fervently giving thanks unto God: The Word was made Flesh, and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, the glory as of the Only-begotten of the Father!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
O marvelous wonder! He Who was prefigured in the manna, the True God, born of the True God, having assumed the nature of human flesh: rejoice this day, O human race, beholding God in the flesh giving Himself unto thee; cry aloud, rejoice, and fervently giving thanks unto God: The Word was made Flesh, and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, the glory as of the Only-begotten of the Father!

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ди́вное чꙋ́до! закла̀ Премꙋ́дрость своѧ̑ же́ртвєннаѧ, и҆ черпа̀ въ ча́ши свое́й вїно̀, и҆ оу҆гото́ва свою̀ трапе́зꙋ, всѣ́хъ къ себѣ̀ созыва́ющи: прїиди́те ꙗ҆ди́те мо́й Хлѣ́бъ, и҆ пі́йте вїно̀ є҆́же черпа́хъ ва́мъ, весели́тесѧ ца́рїе, благодари́те ст҃и́телїе: и҆ Сло́во Пло́ть бы́сть, и҆ всели́сѧ въ ны̀, и҆ ви́дѣхомъ сла́вꙋ є҆гѡ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆диноро́днагѡ ѿ Оу҃ц҃а̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* O marvelous wonder! Wisdom hath slain Her beasts of sacrifice, and mingled Her wine in Her cup, and prepared Her table, summoning all unto Herself: Come, eat My Bread, and drink the wine which I have mingled for you; rejoice, ye kings; give thanks, ye hierarchs: The Word was made Flesh, and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, the glory as of the Only-begotten of the Father![^2851]

provenance.verbatim_source:

O marvelous wonder! Wisdom hath slain Her beasts of sacrifice, and mingled Her wine in Her cup, and prepared Her table, summoning all unto Herself: Come, eat My Bread, and drink the wine which I have mingled for you; rejoice, ye kings; give thanks, ye hierarchs: The Word was made Flesh, and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, the glory as of the Only-begotten of the Father![^2851]

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ди́вное чꙋ́до! И҆́же на горѣ̀ Сїна́йстѣй, съ Мѡѷсе́емъ глаго́лавый въ кꙋпинѣ̀ неѡпали́мѣй, и҆ скрижа̑ли зако́нныѧ написа́вый: є҆гѡ́же гла́съ гро́ма, трꙋ́бъ и҆ мо́лнїй, оу҆страшѝ сы́ны І҆и҃лєвы, преше́дшыѧ мо́ре по сꙋ́хꙋ, Се́й дне́сь Бж҃етвеннѡ въ Хлѣ́бѣ оу҆таи́сѧ, и҆ въ снѣ́дь подава́етсѧ всѣ̑мъ, А҆́гнецъ, Бг҃ъ, и҆ Сп҃си́тель.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* O marvelous wonder! He Who upon Mount Sinai spoke with Moses in the unburnt bush, and wrote the tablets of the law, Whose voice of thunder, trumpets, and lightning terrified the sons of Israel, who crossed the sea on dry land: He this day is divinely concealed in the Bread, and is given unto all for food: the Lamb, God, and Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source:

O marvelous wonder! He Who upon Mount Sinai spoke with Moses in the unburnt bush, and wrote the tablets of the law, Whose voice of thunder, trumpets, and lightning terrified the sons of Israel, who crossed the sea on dry land: He this day is divinely concealed in the Bread, and is given unto all for food: the Lamb, God, and Savior!

items.slavonic_text: На літꙋргі́и пое́мъ а҆нтїфѡ́ны сїѧ̀: А҆нтїфѡ́нъ а҃: Ѱало́мъ к҃в, гла́съ в҃. Стíхъ а҃: Гдⷭ҇ь пасе́тъ мѧ̀, и҆ ничто́же мѧ̀ лиши́тъ, на мѣ́стѣ зла́чнѣ, та́мѡ всели́ мѧ. Мл҃твами Бц҃ы Сп҃се спаси́ на́съ. Стíхъ в҃: А҆́ще бо пойдꙋ̀ посредѣ̀ сѣ́ни сме́ртныѧ, не оу҆бою́сѧ ѕла̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ ты̀ со мно́ю є҆сѝ. Мл҃твами Бц҃ы Сп҃се спаси́ на́съ.
items.english_text: I am the living Bread, the Bread that came down from heaven, said the Lord unto the Jews who came unto Him: If ye eat not the Flesh of the Son of man, and drink His Blood, ye have no life in you; he that eats My Flesh, and drinks My Blood, hath eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day!

items.slavonic_text: Слꙋ́жба
items.english_text: *Sticheron (continued):*[^2863] The Lord hath made a remembrance of His wonders, for the sake of His mercy and loving-kindness; in these Mysteries of His Body and Blood, He gave His Body for food, and Blood for drink. O great power, and works of the Lord, sought out in all His desires! Holy and awesome is His name, which is above every name, that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things on earth, and things under the earth![^2864]

items.slavonic_text: Па́мѧть сотвори́лъ є҆́сть чꙋде́съ свои́хъ Гдⷭ҇ь, ми́лости своеѧ̀ ра́ди и҆ благоꙋтро́бїа, въ си́хъ Та́йнахъ Пло́ти и҆ Кро́ве своеѧ̀, Пло́ть свою̀ дадѐ въ снѣ́дь, и҆ Кро́вь въ питїѐ. Ѽ ве́лїа си́ла, и҆ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇нѧ, и҆зы́скана въ всѣ́хъ во́лѧхъ є҆гѡ̀! ст҃о и҆ стра́шно и҆́мѧ є҆гѡ̀, є҆́же є҆́сть па́че всѧ́кагѡ и҆́мене: да ѡ҆ и҆́мени І҆и҃совомъ всѧ́кое колѣ́но покланѧ́етсѧ, нбⷭ҇ныхъ, и҆ земны́хъ, и҆ преиспо́днихъ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Unto the Mystical Supper this day, and the Divine Table, let us draw near with fear, ye faithful, desiring to taste of the immortal Fount; but trembling and fear seize us, because of our many sins, from which we desire to be cleansed through Thee, by the prayers of the Mother of God our Lady.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
Unto the Mystical Supper this day, and the Divine Table, let us draw near with fear, ye faithful, desiring to taste of the immortal Fount; but trembling and fear seize us, because of our many sins, from which we desire to be cleansed through Thee, by the prayers of the Mother of God our Lady.

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: гла́съ то́йже. Є҆го́же безсѣ́меннѡ родила̀ є҆сѝ Пречи́стаѧ Дв҃о, Се́й неиспы́таннѡ дне́сь на престо́лѣ пра́зднественнѡ зри́тсѧ, и҆ въ снѣ́дь вѣ̑рнымъ дае́тсѧ: А҆́ггли съ тре́петомъ, и҆ человѣ́цы, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ꙋ и҆́стинномꙋ покланѧ́ютсѧ, є҆го́же Ма́терними твои́ми моли́твами оу҆молѝ: ꙗ҆́кѡ да не ѡ҆пали́тъ на́съ грѣ̑хъ ра́ди на́шихъ, но поми́лꙋетъ и҆ спасе́тъ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_text: I am the living Bread that came down from heaven; if anyone eat, he shall not die, but shall live for ever; and the Bread which I will give is My true Flesh, which I gave for the life of the world; I am the living Bread, the Bread that comes down from heaven; if anyone eat of it, he shall not die, but hath eternal life.

provenance.verbatim_source: I am the living Bread that came down from heaven; if anyone eat, he shall not die, but shall live for ever; and the Bread which I will give is My true Flesh, which I gave for the life of the world; I am the living Bread, the Bread that comes down from heaven; if anyone eat of it, he shall not die, but hath eternal life.

items.office: ON THE SAME THURSDAY EVENING
items.section: At the Liturgy we sing these Antiphons:*[^2853]

items.day_or_date: ON THE SAME THURSDAY EVENING
items.slavonic_text: Прокі́менъ. Гла́съ з҃. Кто̀ Бг҃ъ ве́лїй, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ на́шъ, ты̀ є҆сѝ Бг҃ъ творѧ́й чꙋдеса̀. Стíхъ а҃: Сказа́лъ є҆сѝ въ лю́дехъ си́лꙋ твою̀. Стíхъ в҃: И҆ рѣ́хъ: ны́нѣ нача́хъ, сїѧ̀ и҆змѣ́на десни́цы Вы́шнѧгѡ. Стíхъ г҃: Помѧнꙋ́хъ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇нѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ помѧнꙋ̀ ѿ нача́ла чꙋдеса̀ твоѧ̑. И҆ па́ки: Кто̀ Бг҃ъ ве́лїй, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ на́шъ, ты̀ є҆сѝ Бг҃ъ творѧ́й чꙋдеса̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion, the same Tone:* He Whom thou didst bear without seed, O all-pure Virgin, He is seen mysteriously this day upon the throne in festival, and is given unto the faithful for food: Angels with trembling, and men as unto the True God bow down; Whom do thou entreat by thy maternal prayers, that He burn us not because of our sins, but have mercy and save our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion, the same Tone:*
He Whom thou didst bear without seed, O all-pure Virgin, He is seen mysteriously this day upon the throne in festival, and is given unto the faithful for food: Angels with trembling, and men as unto the True God bow down; Whom do thou entreat by thy maternal prayers, that He burn us not because of our sins, but have mercy and save our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Стíхъ: Что̀ возда́мъ Гдⷭ҇и ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ, ꙗ҆́же воздаде́ ми: Ѽ чꙋ́до пресла́вное! * ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ невмѣсти́мый пе́рвѣе, въ чре́вѣ Дв҃ы вмѣще́нъ, * дне́сь же въ крꙋпи́цы ма́лой хлѣ́ба затворе́нный, * ѿ человѣ̑къ поклоне́нїе пра́зднественнѡ прїе́млетъ: * є҆го́же мы̀ со А҆́гг҃лы и҆ А҆рха́гг҃лы воспое́мъ, * Спаси́телѧ дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.

items.slavonic_text: Стíхъ: Ча́шꙋ спасе́нїѧ прїимꙋ̀, и҆ и҆́мѧ Гдⷭ҇не призовꙋ̀: Ты̀ є҆сѝ А҆рхїере́й по чи́нꙋ Мелхі́седековꙋ, * приносѧ́й Бг҃ꙋ Оу҃ц҃ꙋ̀ Хлѣ́бъ * и҆ вїно̀ же́ртвꙋ Себѐ, * грѣ̑хъ ра́ди на́шихъ, * Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е Сп҃се на́шъ, * тебѣ́ же И҆́стинномꙋ Бг҃ꙋ, * съ всѧ́кимъ благодаре́нїемъ покланѧ́емсѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thou art a High Priest according to the order of Melchizedek, offering unto God the Father bread and wine as a sacrifice of Thyself, for the sake of our sins, O Christ God our Savior; and unto Thee, the True God, with all thanksgiving we bow down.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: И҆́мже ѻ҆́бразомъ жела́етъ є҆ле́нь на и҆сто́чники водны̑ѧ, си́це жела́етъ дꙋша̀ моѧ̀ къ тебѣ́ Бж҃е, и҆́же да́лъ є҆сѝ на́мъ Пло́ть свою̀ въ снѣ́дь: и҆ пита́еши на́съ а҆́лчꙋщихъ Хлѣ́бомъ Бж҃етвеннымъ, и҆ напа́еши на́съ жа́ждꙋщихъ дꙋша́ми, вїно́мъ пречи́стыѧ Кро́ве твоеѧ̀: тѣ́мже дне́сь кла́нѧющесѧ пра́зднественнѡ, тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тꙋ Бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ вочеловѣ́чшемсѧ, пострада́вшꙋ на Крⷭ҇тѣ̀, и҆ оу҆ме́ршꙋ спасе́нїѧ на́шегѡ ра́ди, воскрⷭ҇шꙋ въ тре́тїй де́нь, возне́сшемсѧ на нб҃о, и҆ сѣдѧ́щꙋ ѡ҆деснꙋ́ю Оу҃ц҃а̀, тебѣ̀ припа́даемъ и҆ оу҆ми́льнѡ глаго́лемъ: спаси́ на́съ милосе́рдїѧ ра́ди твоегѡ̀.
items.english_text: Come, ye faithful lovers of the feasts, let us clap our hands this day for the world-saving triumph of the living Bread, and of the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of the world and transgressions; not in the leaven of ancient malice, but in the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth; having cleansed ourselves, therefore, let us worthily partake of Him, that we may obtain His eternal Kingdom.

provenance.verbatim_source: Come, ye faithful lovers of the feasts, let us clap our hands this day for the world-saving triumph of the living Bread, and of the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of the world and transgressions; not in the leaven of ancient malice, but in the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth; having cleansed ourselves, therefore, let us worthily partake of Him, that we may obtain His eternal Kingdom.

items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Isaac, giving blessing unto his son Jacob the Patriarch, confirmed him with abundance of corn and wine, and unto this blessing the Patriarch joined also the primogeniture of sons: in like manner also did our Savior Christ the Lord, giving unto us the supernatural Bread, and wine from the true vine; for having taken bread into His divine hands, He said: Take, eat, this is My Body; drink of the cup, for this is My Blood, poured out for the whole world.[^2874]

items.english_text: *Sticheron:* As the hart desires the fountains of waters, so desires my soul after Thee, O God, Who hast given us Thy Flesh for food, and dost feed us who hunger with Divine Bread, and dost give drink unto our thirsting souls with the wine of Thy most pure Blood: therefore this day bowing down in festival unto Thee, O Christ our God, Who becamest incarnate, didst suffer upon the Cross, and didst die for the sake of our salvation, didst rise on the third day, didst ascend into heaven, and sittest at the right hand of the Father, unto Thee we fall down and with compunction say: Save us for the sake of Thy tender mercy![^2875]

items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ, стїхи̑ры самогла́сны. Гла́съ в҃:
items.english_text: Come, all ye ends of the earth, and standing this day in the temple of the Lord, let us fall prostrate upon the face of the earth with humility, even as John the Theologian beheld the four and twenty elders falling down before Him Who sits upon the throne and Lives unto ages of ages: for this was the Lamb of God sitting upon the throne, Whom beholding this day in the Most Holy Mysteries, invisible, yet visible unto the faithful by faith: confessing Him as God and the Word incarnate, with fear and trembling let us bow down unto Him.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ ѕ҃: А҆́зъ є҆́смь Хлѣ́бъ живо́тный, соше́дый съ нб҃сѐ: да а҆́ще кто̀ снѣ́сть ѿ негѡ̀, не оу҆́мретъ, но жи́въ бꙋ́детъ во вѣ́ки: и҆ Хлѣ́бъ є҆го́же а҆́зъ да́мъ, и҆́стиннаѧ Пло́ть моѧ̀ є҆́сть, ю҆́же а҆́зъ да́мъ за живо́тъ мі́ра: а҆́зъ є҆́смь Хлѣ́бъ живо́тный, Хлѣ́бъ сходѧ́й съ нб҃сѐ, да а҆́ще кто̀ ѿ негѡ̀ ꙗ҆́стъ, не оу҆́мретъ, но и҆́матъ живо́тъ вѣ́чный.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Shout with joy, ye people, unto God Who loves mankind, for the Mighty One hath done great things for us, at His Mystical Supper, giving unto all heavenly Bread for the salvation of our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ ѕ҃: А҆́зъ є҆́смь Хлѣ́бъ живо́тный, соше́дый съ нб҃сѐ: да а҆́ще кто̀ снѣ́сть ѿ негѡ̀, не оу҆́мретъ, но жи́въ бꙋ́детъ во вѣ́ки: и҆ Хлѣ́бъ є҆го́же а҆́зъ да́мъ, и҆́стиннаѧ Пло́ть моѧ̀ є҆́сть, ю҆́же а҆́зъ да́мъ за живо́тъ мі́ра: а҆́зъ є҆́смь Хлѣ́бъ живо́тный, Хлѣ́бъ сходѧ́й съ нб҃сѐ, да а҆́ще кто̀ ѿ негѡ̀ ꙗ҆́стъ, не оу҆́мретъ, но и҆́матъ живо́тъ вѣ́чный.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Let all the earth bow down unto God Who lives in these Mysteries, thanking His tender mercy, that as supernatural Bread from the heavens, He gives food unto His beloved, whom He hath redeemed with His Blood.
